lib.frr

FRR / OSPF / BGP / RIP / PIM grading helpers.

Every get_* function registers one command through grade.test() -- so it follows the two-pass contract of Grade.grade() (placeholder result on the registration pass, real output afterwards) -- and hands the text to a pure parse_* function. The parsers are unit-tested on captured FRR 9 output in tests/test_frr.py; the labs run on the FRR 10.3 of Debian 13 since 2026-11-19, whose output they read the same (the OSPF, BGP, RIP, multicast and OSPFv3 labs reach full marks on it). The OSPF and RIP helpers parse the text output of vtysh (show ip rip and show ip rip status have no json form), the BGP helpers its json output (show bgp ipv4 unicast ... json). On the placeholder output every parser returns its empty shape ({}/[]), never an exception. What a RIP router really announces on a link is read by the passive probe of lib/rip.py. The PIM / IGMP / MSDP / MLD helpers parse the json output of pimd and pim6d; what multicast traffic really reaches a host is read by lib/mcast.py. The OSPFv3 helpers (end of the file) parse the json output of ospf6d (show ipv6 ospf6 ... json) and the text of show ipv6 ospf6 border-routers; the BGP helpers take afi='ipv6' for the IPv6 unicast address family.

Pass allow_error=True when the router may not run OSPF/BGP/RIP yet (vtysh then exits non-zero and the error would otherwise be recorded in the archive).

   1"""FRR / OSPF / BGP / RIP / PIM grading helpers.
   2
   3Every ``get_*`` function registers one command through ``grade.test()`` -- so it
   4follows the two-pass contract of ``Grade.grade()`` (placeholder result on the
   5registration pass, real output afterwards) -- and hands the text to a pure
   6``parse_*`` function.  The parsers are unit-tested on captured FRR 9 output in
   7``tests/test_frr.py``; the labs run on the FRR 10.3 of Debian 13 since 2026-11-19, whose output
   8they read the same (the OSPF, BGP, RIP, multicast and OSPFv3 labs reach full marks on it).  The OSPF and RIP helpers parse the text output of ``vtysh``
   9(``show ip rip`` and ``show ip rip status`` have no json form), the BGP helpers its
  10``json`` output (``show bgp ipv4 unicast ... json``).  On the placeholder output
  11every parser returns its empty shape (``{}``/``[]``), never an exception.  What a
  12RIP router really announces on a link is read by the passive probe of ``lib/rip.py``.
  13The PIM / IGMP / MSDP / MLD helpers parse the ``json`` output of pimd and pim6d; what
  14multicast traffic really reaches a host is read by ``lib/mcast.py``.  The OSPFv3 helpers (end
  15of the file) parse the ``json`` output of ospf6d (``show ipv6 ospf6 ... json``) and the text of
  16``show ipv6 ospf6 border-routers``; the BGP helpers take ``afi='ipv6'`` for the IPv6 unicast
  17address family.
  18
  19Pass ``allow_error=True`` when the router may not run OSPF/BGP/RIP yet (``vtysh``
  20then exits non-zero and the error would otherwise be recorded in the archive).
  21"""
  22import json
  23import re
  24from ipaddress import IPv4Address, IPv4Network, ip_address, ip_network
  25from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
  26
  27from SRE.lib_sre import Grade0
  28
  29_IPV4_RE = re.compile(r'^\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3}$')
  30
  31#: kernel route protocol values that mean "installed by ospfd" (name from
  32#: /etc/iproute2/rt_protos.d/frr.conf, or the raw number when that file is missing)
  33OSPF_ROUTE_PROTOCOLS = ('ospf', '188')
  34#: kernel route protocol values that mean "installed by bgpd"
  35BGP_ROUTE_PROTOCOLS = ('bgp', '186')
  36#: kernel route protocol values that mean "installed by ripd" / "by ripngd"
  37RIP_ROUTE_PROTOCOLS = ('rip', '189')
  38RIPNG_ROUTE_PROTOCOLS = ('ripng', '190')
  39
  40
  41def _test(grade: Grade0, machine_name: str, command: str, step: int, allow_error: bool):
  42    if allow_error:
  43        return grade.test(machine_name, command, step=step, allow_error=True)
  44    return grade.test(machine_name, command, step=step)

  47def normalize_area(area: str) -> str:
  48    """Return an OSPF area id in dotted form: ``'1'`` -> ``'0.0.0.1'``, ``'0.0.0.1'`` unchanged."""
  49    area = str(area).strip()
  50    if area.isdigit():
  51        return str(IPv4Address(int(area)))
  52    return area
  53
  54
  55def is_ospf_protocol(protocol) -> bool:
  56    """True when a kernel route ``protocol`` field (``ip -j route``) denotes an OSPF route."""
  57    return str(protocol) in OSPF_ROUTE_PROTOCOLS
  58
  59
  60def is_bgp_protocol(protocol) -> bool:
  61    """True when a kernel route ``protocol`` field (``ip -j route``) denotes a BGP route."""
  62    return str(protocol) in BGP_ROUTE_PROTOCOLS
  63
  64
  65def is_rip_protocol(protocol) -> bool:
  66    """True when a kernel route ``protocol`` field (``ip -j route``) denotes a RIP route."""
  67    return str(protocol) in RIP_ROUTE_PROTOCOLS
  68
  69
  70def is_ripng_protocol(protocol) -> bool:
  71    """True when a kernel route ``protocol`` field (``ip -j -6 route``) denotes a RIPng route."""
  72    return str(protocol) in RIPNG_ROUTE_PROTOCOLS

  76# show ip ospf interface
  77# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  78
  79def parse_ospf_interfaces(output: str) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
  80    """Parse the text of ``show ip ospf interface`` (see :func:`get_ospf_interfaces`)."""
  81    result: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
  82    current: Dict[str, Any] | None = None
  83
  84    for line in output.splitlines():
  85        # Interface header: "ethX is up"
  86        m = re.match(r'^(\S+) is (up|down)', line)
  87        if m:
  88            current = {
  89                'state': m.group(2),
  90                'ospf_enabled': True,
  91                'mtu': None, 'bandwidth': None,
  92                'internet_address': None, 'broadcast': None, 'area': None,
  93                'router_id': None, 'network_type': None, 'cost': None,
  94                'ospf_state': None, 'priority': None, 'passive': False,
  95                'hello_interval': None, 'dead_interval': None, 'retransmit_interval': None,
  96                'neighbor_count': None, 'adjacent_neighbor_count': None,
  97                'dr_id': None, 'dr_address': None,
  98                'bdr_id': None, 'bdr_address': None,
  99            }
 100            result[m.group(1)] = current
 101            continue
 102
 103        if current is None:
 104            continue
 105
 106        if 'OSPF not enabled on this interface' in line:
 107            current['ospf_enabled'] = False
 108            continue
 109
 110        # ifindex 13, MTU 1500 bytes, BW 10000 Mbit <UP,LOWER_UP,BROADCAST,RUNNING,MULTICAST>
 111        m = re.search(r'MTU (\d+) bytes,\s*BW (\d+) Mbit', line)
 112        if m:
 113            current['mtu'] = int(m.group(1))
 114            current['bandwidth'] = int(m.group(2))
 115            continue
 116
 117        # Internet Address 10.150.180.224/28, Broadcast 10.150.180.239, Area 0.0.0.0
 118        m = re.search(r'Internet Address (\S+?),\s*Broadcast (\S+?),\s*Area (\S+)', line)
 119        if m:
 120            current['internet_address'] = m.group(1)
 121            current['broadcast'] = m.group(2)
 122            current['area'] = m.group(3)
 123            continue
 124
 125        # Internet Address 10.0.0.1/30, Area 0.0.0.0   (point-to-point, no broadcast)
 126        m = re.search(r'Internet Address (\S+?),\s*Area (\S+)', line)
 127        if m:
 128            current['internet_address'] = m.group(1)
 129            current['area'] = m.group(2)
 130            continue
 131
 132        # Router ID 10.150.180.224, Network Type BROADCAST, Cost: 10
 133        m = re.search(r'Router ID (\S+?),\s*Network Type (\S+?),\s*Cost:\s*(\d+)', line)
 134        if m:
 135            current['router_id'] = m.group(1)
 136            current['network_type'] = m.group(2)
 137            current['cost'] = int(m.group(3))
 138            continue
 139
 140        # Transmit Delay is 1 sec, State Backup, Priority 1
 141        m = re.search(r'State (\S+?),\s*Priority (\d+)', line)
 142        if m:
 143            current['ospf_state'] = m.group(1).rstrip(',')
 144            current['priority'] = int(m.group(2))
 145            continue
 146
 147        # Designated Router (ID) 172.23.52.228 Interface Address 10.150.180.230/28
 148        m = re.search(r'Designated Router \(ID\) (\S+)\s+Interface Address (\S+)', line)
 149        if m and 'Backup' not in line:
 150            current['dr_id'] = m.group(1)
 151            current['dr_address'] = m.group(2)
 152            continue
 153
 154        # Backup Designated Router (ID) 10.150.180.224, Interface Address 10.150.180.224
 155        m = re.search(r'Backup Designated Router \(ID\) (\S+?),\s*Interface Address (\S+)', line)
 156        if m:
 157            current['bdr_id'] = m.group(1)
 158            current['bdr_address'] = m.group(2)
 159            continue
 160
 161        # Timer intervals configured, Hello 10s, Dead 40s, Wait 40s, Retransmit 5
 162        m = re.search(r'Hello (\d+)s,\s*Dead (\d+)s,.*Retransmit (\d+)', line)
 163        if m:
 164            current['hello_interval'] = int(m.group(1))
 165            current['dead_interval'] = int(m.group(2))
 166            current['retransmit_interval'] = int(m.group(3))
 167            continue
 168
 169        # No Hellos (Passive interface)
 170        if 'No Hellos (Passive interface)' in line:
 171            current['passive'] = True
 172            continue
 173
 174        # Neighbor Count is 1, Adjacent neighbor count is 1
 175        m = re.search(r'Neighbor Count is (\d+),\s*Adjacent neighbor count is (\d+)', line)
 176        if m:
 177            current['neighbor_count'] = int(m.group(1))
 178            current['adjacent_neighbor_count'] = int(m.group(2))
 179            continue
 180
 181    return result
 182

 184def get_ospf_interfaces(grade: Grade0, machine_name: str, step: int = 1,
 185                        allow_error: bool = False) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
 186    """Run 'vtysh -c "show ip ospf interface"' and parse the output.
 187
 188    Returns a dict mapping interface name -> dict of parsed fields:
 189      state            : 'up' | 'down'
 190      ospf_enabled     : bool  (False for "OSPF not enabled on this interface" entries)
 191      mtu              : int
 192      bandwidth        : int   (Mbit, the "BW" field: interface speed or `bandwidth` setting)
 193      internet_address : str  e.g. '10.150.180.224/28'
 194      broadcast        : str  e.g. '10.150.180.239'
 195      area             : str  e.g. '0.0.0.0'
 196      router_id        : str
 197      network_type     : str  e.g. 'BROADCAST'
 198      cost             : int
 199      ospf_state       : str  e.g. 'Backup', 'DR', 'DROther'
 200      priority         : int
 201      passive          : bool ("No Hellos (Passive interface)")
 202      hello_interval   : int  (seconds)
 203      dead_interval    : int  (seconds)
 204      retransmit_interval : int (seconds)
 205      neighbor_count          : int
 206      adjacent_neighbor_count : int
 207      dr_id            : str | None
 208      dr_address       : str | None
 209      bdr_id           : str | None
 210      bdr_address      : str | None
 211
 212    Returns {} on error or empty output.
 213    """
 214    output, code = _test(grade, machine_name, 'vtysh -c "show ip ospf interface"', step, allow_error)
 215    if code != 0 or not output:
 216        return {}
 217    return parse_ospf_interfaces(output)

 221# show ip ospf neighbor
 222# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 223
 224def parse_ospf_neighbors(output: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
 225    """Parse the text of ``show ip ospf neighbor``.
 226
 227    Data rows look like (the "Up Time" column exists in FRR >= 7.5 only)::
 228
 229        Neighbor ID     Pri State           Up Time         Dead Time Address         Interface                        RXmtL RqstL DBsmL
 230        10.0.0.2          1 Full/DR         2m34s             36.245s 10.0.12.2       eth0:10.0.12.1                       0     0     0
 231
 232    Rows are parsed from the end (three counters, interface, address, dead time) so
 233    both layouts work.  Non-data lines are skipped.
 234    """
 235    result: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
 236    for line in output.splitlines():
 237        fields = line.split()
 238        if len(fields) < 9 or not _IPV4_RE.match(fields[0]):
 239            continue
 240        state, _, role = fields[2].partition('/')
 241        interface, _, local_address = fields[-4].partition(':')
 242        try:
 243            priority: Optional[int] = int(fields[1])
 244        except ValueError:
 245            priority = None
 246        result.append({
 247            'neighbor_id': fields[0],
 248            'priority': priority,
 249            'state': state,
 250            'role': role or None,
 251            'up_time': fields[3] if len(fields) >= 10 else None,
 252            'dead_time': fields[-6],
 253            'address': fields[-5],
 254            'interface': interface,
 255            'local_address': local_address or None,
 256        })
 257    return result
 258
 259
 260def get_ospf_neighbors(grade: Grade0, machine_name: str, step: int = 1,
 261                       allow_error: bool = False) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
 262    """Run 'vtysh -c "show ip ospf neighbor"' and return one dict per neighbour:
 263    ``neighbor_id, priority, state ('Full', '2-Way', ...), role ('DR', 'Backup',
 264    'DROther', '-'), up_time, dead_time, address, interface, local_address``.
 265    Returns [] on error or empty output."""
 266    output, code = _test(grade, machine_name, 'vtysh -c "show ip ospf neighbor"', step, allow_error)
 267    if code != 0 or not output:
 268        return []
 269    return parse_ospf_neighbors(output)
 270

 272def find_neighbor(neighbors: List[Dict[str, Any]], neighbor_id: str = None, interface: str = None,
 273                  address: str = None) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
 274    """Return the first neighbour of :func:`get_ospf_neighbors` matching every given criterion."""
 275    for n in neighbors:
 276        if neighbor_id is not None and n['neighbor_id'] != str(neighbor_id):
 277            continue
 278        if interface is not None and n['interface'] != interface:
 279            continue
 280        if address is not None and n['address'] != str(address):
 281            continue
 282        return n
 283    return None
 284
 285
 286def neighbor_is_full(neighbors: List[Dict[str, Any]], neighbor_id: str = None, interface: str = None,
 287                     address: str = None) -> bool:
 288    """True when a neighbour matching the criteria exists and is in state Full."""
 289    n = find_neighbor(neighbors, neighbor_id=neighbor_id, interface=interface, address=address)
 290    return n is not None and n['state'] == 'Full'

 297def parse_ospf_info(output: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 298    """Parse the text of ``show ip ospf``.
 299
 300    Returns ``{}`` when no router id is found (OSPF not running), else::
 301
 302        {'router_id': '10.0.0.4', 'abr': True, 'asbr': False,
 303         'areas': {'0.0.0.0': {'type': 'backbone', 'no_summary': False, 'interfaces': 3,
 304                               'active_interfaces': 3, 'full_neighbors': 2,
 305                               'authentication': 'no'}, ...}}
 306
 307    ``type`` is ``'backbone'``, ``'stub'``, ``'nssa'`` or ``'normal'``;
 308    ``authentication`` is ``'no'``, ``'simple password'`` or ``'message digest'``.
 309    """
 310    info: Dict[str, Any] = {'router_id': None, 'abr': False, 'asbr': False, 'areas': {}}
 311    current: Dict[str, Any] | None = None
 312
 313    for line in output.splitlines():
 314        m = re.search(r'OSPF Routing Process, Router ID:\s*(\S+)', line)
 315        if m:
 316            info['router_id'] = m.group(1)
 317            continue
 318        if 'This router is an ABR' in line:
 319            info['abr'] = True
 320            continue
 321        if 'This router is an ASBR' in line:
 322            info['asbr'] = True
 323            continue
 324        m = re.match(r'^\s*Area ID:\s*(\S+)(?:\s*\((.*?)\))?', line)
 325        if m:
 326            desc = (m.group(2) or '').strip()
 327            low = desc.lower()
 328            if low.startswith('backbone'):
 329                area_type = 'backbone'
 330            elif low.startswith('stub'):
 331                area_type = 'stub'
 332            elif low.startswith('nssa'):
 333                area_type = 'nssa'
 334            else:
 335                area_type = 'normal'
 336            current = {
 337                'type': area_type,
 338                'no_summary': 'no summary' in low,
 339                'interfaces': None, 'active_interfaces': None,
 340                'full_neighbors': None, 'authentication': None,
 341            }
 342            info['areas'][m.group(1)] = current
 343            continue
 344        if current is None:
 345            continue
 346        m = re.search(r'Number of interfaces in this area:\s*Total:\s*(\d+),\s*Active:\s*(\d+)', line)
 347        if m:
 348            current['interfaces'] = int(m.group(1))
 349            current['active_interfaces'] = int(m.group(2))
 350            continue
 351        m = re.search(r'Number of fully adjacent neighbors in this area:\s*(\d+)', line)
 352        if m:
 353            current['full_neighbors'] = int(m.group(1))
 354            continue
 355        m = re.search(r'Area has (.+?) authentication', line)
 356        if m:
 357            current['authentication'] = m.group(1).strip()
 358            continue
 359
 360    if info['router_id'] is None:
 361        return {}
 362    return info
 363
 364
 365def get_ospf_info(grade: Grade0, machine_name: str, step: int = 1, allow_error: bool = False) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 366    """Run 'vtysh -c "show ip ospf"' and return the router-level state (see :func:`parse_ospf_info`).
 367    Returns {} when OSPF is not running."""
 368    output, code = _test(grade, machine_name, 'vtysh -c "show ip ospf"', step, allow_error)
 369    if code != 0 or not output:
 370        return {}
 371    return parse_ospf_info(output)

 374def router_id_map(grade: Grade0, machine_names, step: int = 1, allow_error: bool = True) -> Dict[str, str]:
 375    """Return ``{router_id: machine_name}`` for every machine whose OSPF process answers."""
 376    result: Dict[str, str] = {}
 377    for m in machine_names:
 378        rid = get_ospf_info(grade, m, step=step, allow_error=allow_error).get('router_id')
 379        if rid:
 380            result[rid] = m
 381    return result

 384# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 385# show ip ospf route
 386# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 387
 388# "N IA 10.0.5.0/24 [30] area: 0.0.0.0", "D IA 10.37.4.0/22 Discard entry",
 389# "N E2 203.0.113.0/24 [10/20] tag: 0" and, in the router table, "R 1.1.1.1 IA [400] area: 0.0.0.2, ASBR"
 390# (the type marker follows the router id there).
 391_OSPF_ROUTE_RE = re.compile(
 392    r'^(?P<kind>[NRD])\s+(?P<type>IA|E1|E2|N1|N2)?\s*'
 393    r'(?P<dest>\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3}(?:/\d{1,2})?)\s+'
 394    r'(?:(?P<type2>IA|E1|E2|N1|N2)\s+)?'
 395    r'(?:\[(?P<cost>\d+)(?:/(?P<ext_cost>\d+))?\]|(?P<discard>Discard entry))'
 396    r'(?P<rest>.*)$'
 397)
 398
 399
 400def parse_ospf_routes(output: str) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
 401    """Parse the text of ``show ip ospf route``.
 402
 403    Network entries (``N``) and discard entries (``D``, created by ``area range``) are
 404    keyed by prefix, router entries (``R``) by router id::
 405
 406        {'10.0.5.0/24': {'kind': 'N', 'type': 'IA', 'cost': 30, 'ext_cost': None, 'tag': None,
 407                         'area': '0.0.0.0', 'abr': False, 'asbr': False,
 408                         'nexthops': [('10.0.12.3', 'eth0')]},
 409         '203.0.113.0/24': {'kind': 'N', 'type': 'E2', 'cost': 10, 'ext_cost': 20, 'tag': 0, ...},
 410         '10.0.0.3': {'kind': 'R', 'type': 'intra', 'cost': 10, 'area': '0.0.0.0', 'abr': True, ...}}
 411
 412    ``type`` is ``'intra'`` for plain intra-area entries, ``'IA'``, ``'E1'``, ``'E2'``,
 413    ``'N1'`` or ``'N2'``.  ``nexthops`` holds ``(ip, interface)`` pairs, ``ip`` being
 414    ``None`` for ``directly attached to`` entries.
 415    """
 416    result: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
 417    current: Dict[str, Any] | None = None
 418
 419    for line in output.splitlines():
 420        m = _OSPF_ROUTE_RE.match(line.strip())
 421        if m:
 422            rest = m.group('rest') or ''
 423            area_m = re.search(r'area:\s*(\S+?)(?:,|\s|$)', rest)
 424            tag_m = re.search(r'tag:\s*(\d+)', rest)
 425            current = {
 426                'kind': m.group('kind'),
 427                'type': m.group('type') or m.group('type2') or 'intra',
 428                'cost': int(m.group('cost')) if m.group('cost') else None,
 429                'ext_cost': int(m.group('ext_cost')) if m.group('ext_cost') else None,
 430                'tag': int(tag_m.group(1)) if tag_m else None,
 431                'area': area_m.group(1) if area_m else None,
 432                'abr': 'ABR' in rest,
 433                'asbr': 'ASBR' in rest,
 434                'discard': bool(m.group('discard')),
 435                'nexthops': [],
 436            }
 437            result[m.group('dest')] = current
 438            continue
 439        if current is None:
 440            continue
 441        m = re.search(r'via (\S+?),\s*(\S+)', line)
 442        if m:
 443            current['nexthops'].append((m.group(1), m.group(2)))
 444            continue
 445        m = re.search(r'directly attached to (\S+)', line)
 446        if m:
 447            current['nexthops'].append((None, m.group(1)))
 448            continue
 449
 450    return result
 451
 452
 453def get_ospf_routes(grade: Grade0, machine_name: str, step: int = 1, allow_error: bool = False) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
 454    """Run 'vtysh -c "show ip ospf route"' and parse it (see :func:`parse_ospf_routes`).
 455    Returns {} on error or empty output."""
 456    output, code = _test(grade, machine_name, 'vtysh -c "show ip ospf route"', step, allow_error)
 457    if code != 0 or not output:
 458        return {}
 459    return parse_ospf_routes(output)
 460

 462# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 463# show ip ospf database external json  (type 5 LSAs)
 464# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 465
 466def _external_lsa_entries(data: Any) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
 467    """Every dict of *data* (nested lists / dicts, whatever the grouping keys of the FRR
 468    version) that describes one AS-external LSA."""
 469    found: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
 470    if isinstance(data, dict):
 471        if 'linkStateId' in data and 'advertisingRouter' in data:
 472            return [data]
 473        for value in data.values():
 474            found += _external_lsa_entries(value)
 475    elif isinstance(data, list):
 476        for value in data:
 477            found += _external_lsa_entries(value)
 478    return found
 479
 480
 481def _mask_length(value) -> Optional[int]:
 482    """``32``, ``'32'``, ``'/32'`` or ``'255.255.255.255'`` → 32."""
 483    if value is None:
 484        return None
 485    text = str(value).strip().lstrip('/')
 486    if '.' in text:
 487        try:
 488            return IPv4Network(f"0.0.0.0/{text}").prefixlen
 489        except ValueError:
 490            return None
 491    return _int_or_none(text)
 492
 493
 494def parse_ospf_external_lsas(data: Any) -> Dict[tuple, Dict[str, Any]]:
 495    """Parse the JSON of ``show ip ospf database external``.
 496
 497    Returns ``{(prefix, advertising router): {'prefix': '172.20.5.53/32', 'adv_router':
 498    '10.0.32.2', 'metric_type': 1 | 2, 'metric': 10, 'forward': '0.0.0.0', 'tag': 0,
 499    'age': 12}}`` (``{}`` without OSPF or without external LSA)."""
 500    result: Dict[tuple, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
 501    for e in _external_lsa_entries(data):
 502        length = _mask_length(e.get('networkMask'))
 503        lsid = e.get('linkStateId')
 504        try:
 505            prefix = str(IPv4Network(f"{lsid}/{length if length is not None else 32}", strict=False))
 506        except ValueError:
 507            continue
 508        mtype = str(e.get('metricType') or '')
 509        m = re.search(r'E?([12])', mtype)
 510        metric_type = int(m.group(1)) if m else None
 511        adv = str(e.get('advertisingRouter'))
 512        result[(prefix, adv)] = {
 513            'prefix': prefix, 'adv_router': adv, 'metric_type': metric_type,
 514            'metric': _int_or_none(e.get('metric')),
 515            'forward': e.get('forwardAddress'),
 516            'tag': _int_or_none(e.get('externalRouteTag', e.get('routeTag'))),
 517            'age': _int_or_none(e.get('lsaAge')),
 518        }
 519    return result
 520
 521
 522def get_ospf_external_lsas(grade: Grade0, machine_name: str, step: int = 1,
 523                           allow_error: bool = True) -> Dict[tuple, Dict[str, Any]]:
 524    """The AS-external LSAs in the database of *machine_name* (see
 525    :func:`parse_ospf_external_lsas`)."""
 526    return parse_ospf_external_lsas(_vtysh_json(grade, machine_name, 'show ip ospf database external', step,
 527                                                allow_error))
 528

 530# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 531# ip -j route  (kernel routing table)
 532# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 533
 534def parse_kernel_routes(output: str, ipv6: bool = False) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
 535    """Parse the JSON of ``ip -j route`` (``ip -j -6 route`` with ``ipv6=True``).
 536
 537    Returns ``{prefix: {'protocol': str, 'metric': int, 'scope': str | None,
 538    'nexthops': [(gateway | None, dev)], 'labels': [[int]], 'type': 'unicast' | 'blackhole' | ...}}``; ``default`` becomes
 539    ``0.0.0.0/0`` (``::/0``) and host routes get ``/32`` (``/128``).  ECMP routes list every
 540    next hop.  ``labels`` holds, for each next hop in the same order, the MPLS label stack it
 541    pushes (``encap mpls 16003/16005`` → ``[16003, 16005]``; ``[]`` without encapsulation).
 542    When the same prefix appears several times (different metrics, or ``fe80::/64`` on every
 543    interface) the first entry wins.
 544    """
 545    try:
 546        routes = json.loads(output)
 547    except (ValueError, TypeError):
 548        return {}
 549    if not isinstance(routes, list):
 550        return {}
 551    result: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
 552    for r in routes:
 553        if not isinstance(r, dict):
 554            continue
 555        dst = r.get('dst')
 556        if not dst:
 557            continue
 558        if dst == 'default':
 559            dst = '::/0' if ipv6 else '0.0.0.0/0'
 560        elif '/' not in dst:
 561            dst += '/128' if ipv6 or ':' in dst else '/32'
 562        if dst in result:
 563            continue
 564        if isinstance(r.get('nexthops'), list):
 565            hops = [n for n in r['nexthops'] if isinstance(n, dict)]
 566        else:
 567            hops = [r]
 568        result[dst] = {
 569            'protocol': str(r.get('protocol', '')),
 570            'metric': int(r.get('metric', 0) or 0),
 571            'scope': r.get('scope'),
 572            'nexthops': [(n.get('gateway'), n.get('dev')) for n in hops],
 573            'labels': [_encap_labels(n.get('encap')) for n in hops],
 574            'type': r.get('type') or 'unicast',     # 'blackhole' / 'unreachable' / 'prohibit': no device
 575        }
 576    return result
 577
 578
 579def _encap_labels(encap) -> List[int]:
 580    """The label stack of an ``encap`` object of ``ip -j route`` (``{"encap_type": "mpls",
 581    "dst": "16003/16005"}``); ``[]`` for no or another encapsulation."""
 582    if not isinstance(encap, dict) or encap.get('encap_type') != 'mpls':
 583        return []
 584    labels = []
 585    for part in str(encap.get('dst') or '').split('/'):
 586        value = _int_or_none(part)
 587        if value is not None:
 588            labels.append(value)
 589    return labels
 590
 591
 592def kernel_route_labels(routes: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]], prefix) -> List[List[int]]:
 593    """The label stacks pushed by the next hops of ``prefix`` in a :func:`parse_kernel_routes`
 594    result (``[]`` when the prefix is absent)."""
 595    entry = routes.get(str(prefix))
 596    return list(entry.get('labels', [])) if entry else []
 597
 598
 599def get_kernel_routes(grade: Grade0, machine_name: str, step: int = 1, allow_error: bool = False,
 600                      ipv6: bool = False, vrf: str = None) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
 601    """Run 'ip -j route' ('ip -j -6 route' with ``ipv6=True``; ``vrf``: the table of that VRF
 602    device, ``ip -j route show vrf X``) and parse it (see :func:`parse_kernel_routes`). Returns {}
 603    on error."""
 604    command = 'ip -j -6 route' if ipv6 else 'ip -j route'
 605    if vrf:
 606        command += f' show vrf {vrf}'
 607    output, code = _test(grade, machine_name, command, step, allow_error)
 608    if code != 0 or not output:
 609        return {}
 610    return parse_kernel_routes(output, ipv6=ipv6)
 611
 612
 613def kernel_route_gateways(routes: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]], prefix, ospf_only: bool = True,
 614                          protocols=None) -> List[str]:
 615    """Return the gateway list of ``prefix`` in a :func:`parse_kernel_routes` result.
 616
 617    ``[]`` when the prefix is absent or when its protocol is not accepted: by default
 618    only OSPF routes are (``ospf_only``); ``protocols`` (e.g. ``BGP_ROUTE_PROTOCOLS``)
 619    replaces that filter, ``ospf_only=False`` and ``protocols=None`` accept any route.
 620    """
 621    entry = routes.get(str(prefix))
 622    if entry is None:
 623        return []
 624    if protocols is not None:
 625        if str(entry['protocol']) not in protocols:
 626            return []
 627    elif ospf_only and not is_ospf_protocol(entry['protocol']):
 628        return []
 629    return [gw for gw, _dev in entry['nexthops'] if gw]

 662
 663def _empty_bgp_neighbor_config() -> Dict[str, Any]:
 664    return {
 665        'remote_as': None, 'peer_group': None, 'description': None, 'update_source': None,
 666        'timers': None, 'shutdown': False, 'password': None, 'ebgp_multihop': None,
 667        'next_hop_self': False, 'route_reflector_client': False, 'default_originate': False,
 668        'default_originate_route_map': None, 'route_map_in': None, 'route_map_out': None,
 669        'prefix_list_in': None, 'prefix_list_out': None, 'filter_list_in': None, 'filter_list_out': None,
 670        'soft_reconfiguration': False, 'send_community': True, 'activate': None,
 671        'interface': False,
 672        # BGP operations: maximum-prefix (address family), GTSM, BFD, graceful shutdown
 673        'maximum_prefix': None, 'maximum_prefix_out': None, 'ttl_security': None,
 674        'bfd': False, 'bfd_profile': None, 'graceful_shutdown': False,
 675    }
 676
 677
 678#: neighbour statements that belong to an address family (``address-family X unicast`` block,
 679#: or the IPv4 unicast family at router level): the per-family view of ``router_bgp``
 680_BGP_AF_NEIGHBOR_KEYS = ('activate', 'next_hop_self', 'route_reflector_client', 'default_originate',
 681                         'default_originate_route_map', 'route_map_in', 'route_map_out', 'prefix_list_in',
 682                         'prefix_list_out', 'filter_list_in', 'filter_list_out', 'soft_reconfiguration',
 683                         'send_community', 'maximum_prefix', 'maximum_prefix_out')
 684
 685
 686def _empty_bgp_af_config() -> Dict[str, Any]:
 687    return {'neighbors': {}, 'networks': [], 'aggregate_addresses': [], 'redistribute': [],
 688            'maximum_paths': None, 'maximum_paths_ibgp': None, 'dampening': None}
 689
 690
 691def _empty_router_bgp_config() -> Dict[str, Any]:
 692    return {
 693        'present': False, 'as': None, 'router_id': None, 'ebgp_requires_policy': True,
 694        'network_import_check': True, 'default_ipv4_unicast': True, 'bestpath': [], 'cluster_id': None,
 695        'default_local_preference': None, 'timers': None, 'neighbors': {}, 'networks': [],
 696        'aggregate_addresses': [], 'redistribute': [], 'address_families': {},
 697        'confederation_identifier': None, 'confederation_peers': [], 'graceful_shutdown': False,
 698        'maximum_paths': None, 'maximum_paths_ibgp': None, 'dampening': None,
 699    }
 700
 701
 702#: values of a bare ``bgp dampening`` (half-life and max-suppress in minutes, the penalties): FRR
 703#: prints the statement without its values when they are these defaults
 704BGP_DAMPENING_DEFAULTS = (15, 750, 2000, 60)
 705
 706
 707def _parse_router_bgp_line(rb: Dict[str, Any], words: List[str], neighbor_cfg, af: str = None) -> None:
 708    """Apply one indented ``router bgp`` statement (router level or address-family) to ``rb``.
 709
 710    *af* is the address family of the enclosing ``address-family`` block (``'ipv6 unicast'``),
 711    ``None`` at router level: the family statements found there (``network``, ``neighbor X
 712    route-map``...) belong to IPv4 unicast.  They are applied to the merged view (the
 713    neighbour / router keys, as before) and to ``rb['address_families'][family]``."""
 714    if not words:
 715        return
 716    negated = words[0] == 'no'
 717    w = words[1:] if negated else words
 718    if not w:
 719        return
 720    if w[0] in ('address-family', 'exit-address-family'):
 721        return
 722    family = af or 'ipv4 unicast'
 723
 724    def af_cfg() -> Dict[str, Any]:
 725        return rb['address_families'].setdefault(family, _empty_bgp_af_config())
 726
 727    if w[0] == 'neighbor' and len(w) >= 3:
 728        n = neighbor_cfg(w[1])
 729        kw, arg = w[2], (w[3] if len(w) >= 4 else None)
 730        if kw == 'interface':
 731            # unnumbered peer: ``neighbor eth0 interface [remote-as external|internal|N]``
 732            n['interface'] = not negated
 733            if len(w) >= 5 and w[3] == 'remote-as':
 734                n['remote_as'] = int(w[4]) if w[4].isdigit() else w[4]
 735            return
 736        before = {k: n[k] for k in _BGP_AF_NEIGHBOR_KEYS}
 737        _apply_bgp_neighbor_keyword(n, w, kw, arg, negated)
 738        changed = {k: n[k] for k in _BGP_AF_NEIGHBOR_KEYS if n[k] != before[k]}
 739        if changed or kw in ('activate', 'send-community'):
 740            per_af = af_cfg()['neighbors'].setdefault(w[1], {})
 741            per_af.update(changed)
 742            if kw == 'activate':
 743                per_af['activate'] = not negated
 744        return
 745    _apply_bgp_router_keyword(rb, w, negated, af_cfg)
 746
 747
 748def _apply_bgp_neighbor_keyword(n: Dict[str, Any], w: List[str], kw: str, arg, negated: bool) -> None:
 749    """One ``neighbor PEER <kw> ...`` statement applied to the merged neighbour config *n*."""
 750    if kw == 'remote-as' and arg:
 751        n['remote_as'] = int(arg) if arg.isdigit() else arg
 752    elif kw == 'peer-group' and arg:
 753        n['peer_group'] = arg
 754    elif kw == 'description':
 755        n['description'] = " ".join(w[3:]) or None
 756    elif kw == 'update-source' and arg:
 757        n['update_source'] = arg
 758    elif kw == 'timers' and len(w) >= 5 and w[3].isdigit() and w[4].isdigit():
 759        n['timers'] = (int(w[3]), int(w[4]))
 760    elif kw == 'shutdown':
 761        n['shutdown'] = not negated
 762    elif kw == 'password':
 763        n['password'] = None if negated else arg
 764    elif kw == 'ebgp-multihop':
 765        n['ebgp_multihop'] = None if negated else (int(arg) if arg and arg.isdigit() else 255)
 766    elif kw == 'next-hop-self':
 767        n['next_hop_self'] = not negated
 768    elif kw == 'route-reflector-client':
 769        n['route_reflector_client'] = not negated
 770    elif kw == 'default-originate':
 771        n['default_originate'] = not negated
 772        if not negated and len(w) >= 5 and w[3] == 'route-map':
 773            n['default_originate_route_map'] = w[4]
 774    elif kw == 'route-map' and len(w) >= 5 and w[4] in ('in', 'out'):
 775        n[f'route_map_{w[4]}'] = None if negated else w[3]
 776    elif kw == 'prefix-list' and len(w) >= 5 and w[4] in ('in', 'out'):
 777        n[f'prefix_list_{w[4]}'] = None if negated else w[3]
 778    elif kw == 'filter-list' and len(w) >= 5 and w[4] in ('in', 'out'):
 779        n[f'filter_list_{w[4]}'] = None if negated else w[3]
 780    elif kw == 'soft-reconfiguration':
 781        n['soft_reconfiguration'] = not negated
 782    elif kw == 'send-community':
 783        n['send_community'] = not negated
 784    elif kw == 'activate':
 785        n['activate'] = not negated
 786    elif kw == 'maximum-prefix':
 787        n['maximum_prefix'] = None if negated else _maximum_prefix(w[3:])
 788    elif kw == 'maximum-prefix-out':
 789        n['maximum_prefix_out'] = None if negated else _int_or_none(arg)
 790    elif kw == 'ttl-security':
 791        # neighbor X ttl-security hops N
 792        n['ttl_security'] = None if negated else (_int_or_none(w[4]) if len(w) >= 5 and w[3] == 'hops' else None)
 793    elif kw == 'bfd':
 794        if len(w) >= 5 and w[3] == 'profile':
 795            n['bfd_profile'] = None if negated else w[4]
 796            if not negated:
 797                n['bfd'] = True
 798        else:
 799            n['bfd'] = not negated
 800            if negated:
 801                n['bfd_profile'] = None
 802    elif kw == 'graceful-shutdown':
 803        n['graceful_shutdown'] = not negated
 804
 805
 806def _maximum_prefix(words: List[str]) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
 807    """``N [THRESHOLD] [warning-only | restart MIN] [force]`` (the words after ``maximum-prefix``) ->
 808    ``{'limit', 'threshold', 'warning_only', 'restart', 'force'}`` (threshold / restart ``None`` when
 809    not given; FRR's default threshold is 75 %)."""
 810    if not words or not words[0].isdigit():
 811        return None
 812    result = {'limit': int(words[0]), 'threshold': None, 'warning_only': False, 'restart': None, 'force': False}
 813    rest = words[1:]
 814    if rest and rest[0].isdigit():
 815        result['threshold'] = int(rest[0])
 816        rest = rest[1:]
 817    for i, word in enumerate(rest):
 818        if word == 'warning-only':
 819            result['warning_only'] = True
 820        elif word == 'restart' and i + 1 < len(rest):
 821            result['restart'] = _int_or_none(rest[i + 1])
 822        elif word == 'force':
 823            result['force'] = True
 824    return result
 825
 826
 827def _apply_bgp_router_keyword(rb: Dict[str, Any], w: List[str], negated: bool, af_cfg) -> None:
 828    """A ``router bgp`` statement that is not a neighbour one; *af_cfg* returns the per-family
 829    view for the family statements (``network``, ``aggregate-address``, ``redistribute``)."""
 830    if w[0] == 'bgp' and len(w) >= 2:
 831        if w[1] == 'router-id' and len(w) >= 3:
 832            rb['router_id'] = None if negated else w[2]
 833        elif w[1] == 'ebgp-requires-policy':
 834            rb['ebgp_requires_policy'] = not negated
 835        elif w[1] == 'network' and len(w) >= 3 and w[2] == 'import-check':
 836            rb['network_import_check'] = not negated
 837        elif w[1] == 'default' and len(w) >= 3 and w[2] == 'ipv4-unicast':
 838            rb['default_ipv4_unicast'] = not negated
 839        elif w[1] == 'default' and len(w) >= 4 and w[2] == 'local-preference':
 840            rb['default_local_preference'] = None if negated else int(w[3])
 841        elif w[1] == 'bestpath' and len(w) >= 3:
 842            rb['bestpath'].append(" ".join(w[2:]))
 843        elif w[1] == 'cluster-id' and len(w) >= 3:
 844            rb['cluster_id'] = None if negated else w[2]
 845        elif w[1] == 'confederation' and len(w) >= 3 and w[2] == 'identifier':
 846            rb['confederation_identifier'] = None if negated else (_int_or_none(w[3]) if len(w) >= 4 else None)
 847        elif w[1] == 'confederation' and len(w) >= 3 and w[2] == 'peers':
 848            peers = [int(x) for x in w[3:] if x.isdigit()]
 849            if negated:
 850                rb['confederation_peers'] = [x for x in rb['confederation_peers'] if x not in peers] if peers else []
 851            else:
 852                rb['confederation_peers'] += [x for x in peers if x not in rb['confederation_peers']]
 853        elif w[1] == 'graceful-shutdown':
 854            rb['graceful_shutdown'] = not negated
 855        elif w[1] == 'dampening':
 856            values = None
 857            if not negated:
 858                numbers = [int(x) for x in w[2:6] if x.isdigit()]
 859                values = tuple(numbers) if len(numbers) == 4 else BGP_DAMPENING_DEFAULTS
 860            rb['dampening'] = values
 861            af_cfg()['dampening'] = values
 862        return
 863    if w[0] == 'maximum-paths' and len(w) >= 2:
 864        key = 'maximum_paths_ibgp' if w[1] == 'ibgp' else 'maximum_paths'
 865        value = w[2] if key == 'maximum_paths_ibgp' and len(w) >= 3 else w[1]
 866        number = None if negated else _int_or_none(value)
 867        rb[key] = number
 868        af_cfg()[key] = number
 869        return
 870    if w[0] == 'network' and len(w) >= 2:
 871        for target in (rb, af_cfg()):
 872            if negated:
 873                if w[1] in target['networks']:
 874                    target['networks'].remove(w[1])
 875            else:
 876                target['networks'].append(w[1])
 877    elif w[0] == 'aggregate-address' and len(w) >= 2 and not negated:
 878        rb['aggregate_addresses'].append((w[1], w[2:]))
 879        af_cfg()['aggregate_addresses'].append((w[1], w[2:]))
 880    elif w[0] == 'redistribute' and len(w) >= 2 and not negated:
 881        rb['redistribute'].append(w[1])
 882        af_cfg()['redistribute'].append(w[1])
 883    elif w[0] == 'timers' and len(w) >= 4 and w[1] == 'bgp' and w[2].isdigit() and w[3].isdigit():
 884        rb['timers'] = (int(w[2]), int(w[3]))
 885
 886
 887def parse_frr_config(text: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 888    """Parse an FRR configuration (``show running-config`` or ``frr.conf``).
 889
 890    Returns::
 891
 892        {'hostname': str | None,
 893         'static_routes': [(prefix, nexthop)],       # nexthop may be 'blackhole' / 'Null0'
 894         'router_ospf': {'present': bool, 'router_id': str | None,
 895                         'networks': [(prefix, area)], 'passive_interfaces': [...],
 896                         'passive_default': bool,
 897                         'areas': {area: {'stub', 'nssa', 'no_summary', 'ranges': [prefix],
 898                                          'authentication', 'default_cost'}},
 899                         'redistribute': [protocol, ...],
 900                         'default_information_originate': bool,
 901                         'default_information_always': bool,
 902                         'auto_cost_reference_bandwidth': int | None},
 903         'interfaces': {name: {'cost', 'priority', 'hello_interval', 'dead_interval',
 904                               'authentication' ('message-digest' | 'simple' | 'null' | 'key-chain'),
 905                               'message_digest_keys': {id: key}, 'authentication_key',
 906                               'area', 'bandwidth', 'passive' (True/False/None), 'network_type',
 907                               'addresses': ['10.0.0.1/32', ...]}},
 908         'router_bgp': {'present': bool, 'as': int | None, 'router_id': str | None,
 909                        'ebgp_requires_policy': bool, 'network_import_check': bool,
 910                        'default_ipv4_unicast': bool, 'bestpath': ['compare-routerid', ...],
 911                        'cluster_id', 'default_local_preference', 'timers': (keepalive, hold) | None,
 912                        'neighbors': {peer: {'remote_as': int | str | None, 'peer_group', 'description',
 913                                             'update_source', 'timers': (keepalive, hold) | None,
 914                                             'shutdown': bool, 'password', 'ebgp_multihop': int | None,
 915                                             'next_hop_self': bool, 'route_reflector_client': bool,
 916                                             'default_originate': bool, 'default_originate_route_map',
 917                                             'route_map_in', 'route_map_out', 'prefix_list_in',
 918                                             'prefix_list_out', 'filter_list_in', 'filter_list_out',
 919                                             'soft_reconfiguration': bool, 'send_community': bool,
 920                                             'activate': bool | None}},
 921                        'networks': [prefix], 'aggregate_addresses': [(prefix, [option, ...])],
 922                        'redistribute': [protocol, ...]},
 923         'prefix_lists': {name: [{'seq': int | None, 'action': 'permit' | 'deny', 'prefix': str,
 924                                  'ge': int | None, 'le': int | None}]},
 925         'route_maps': {name: [{'seq': int, 'action': 'permit' | 'deny',
 926                                'match': ['ip address prefix-list P', ...],
 927                                'set': ['local-preference 200', ...]}]},
 928         'as_path_lists': {name: [(seq | None, action, regexp)]},
 929         'community_lists': {name: [(seq | None, action, 'community ...')]},
 930         # IPv6 (separate keys: the IPv4 ones above are unchanged)
 931         'static_routes6': [(prefix, nexthop)],      # ``ipv6 route P blackhole`` -> (P, 'blackhole')
 932         'prefix_lists6': {name: [...same entries as prefix_lists...]},
 933         'router_ospf6': {'present': bool, 'router_id': str | None,
 934                          'areas': {area: {'stub', 'nssa', 'no_summary', 'ranges': [prefix], ...}},
 935                          'redistribute': [protocol, ...], 'default_information_originate': bool,
 936                          'default_information_always': bool,
 937                          'interface_areas': {ifname: area}},   # old ``interface X area A`` form
 938         # MPLS
 939         'access_lists': {name: [{'seq': int | None, 'action': 'permit' | 'deny', 'prefix': str,
 940                                  'exact': bool}]},
 941         'mpls_ldp': {'present': bool, 'router_id': str | None,
 942                      'transport_address': str | None,     # IPv4 family
 943                      'interfaces': [ifname],              # IPv4 family
 944                      'label_allocate': str | None,        # 'host-routes' | 'for ACL'
 945                      'label_advertise': [str],            # 'for ACL' | 'to ACL' | ...
 946                      'explicit_null': bool},
 947         # the BGP instances of the VRFs (``router bgp AS vrf NAME``): the keys of router_bgp
 948         # plus their VPN export / import (IPv4 unicast family)
 949         'router_bgp_vrfs': {vrf: {...router_bgp keys..., 'vpn': {'rd': str | None,
 950                                   'rt_import': [str], 'rt_export': [str], 'label': str | None,
 951                                   'export_vpn': bool, 'import_vpn': bool,
 952                                   'route_map_export': str | None, 'route_map_import': str | None}}},
 953         # EVPN: the ``vrf NAME`` blocks of zebra (their L3VNI)
 954         'vrfs': {vrf: {'vni': int | None}},
 955         }
 956
 957    The ``address-family l2vpn evpn`` statements of ``router bgp`` and of the VRF instances go
 958    to ``address_families['l2vpn evpn']`` (read it with :func:`evpn_family`): ``advertise_all_vni``,
 959    ``advertise_ipv4_unicast``, ``autort_rfc8365``, ``rd`` / ``rt_import`` / ``rt_export`` (the
 960    L3VNI of a VRF instance) and ``vnis`` (the ``vni N`` blocks with their own RD and RTs);
 961    ``bgp_neighbor_activated(router_bgp, peer, 'l2vpn evpn')`` tells whether a neighbour is
 962    active in the family.
 963
 964    ``router_ospf`` also gets ``'capability_opaque': bool``, ``'ti_lfa': None | 'link' |
 965    'node'`` (``fast-reroute ti-lfa [node-protection]``) and ``'segment_routing': {'enabled':
 966    bool, 'srgb': (low, high) | None, 'srlb': (low, high) | None, 'node_msd': int | None,
 967    'prefixes': {prefix: {'index': int, 'no_php': bool, 'explicit_null': bool}}}``.
 968
 969    Interfaces also get ``'addresses6'`` (``ipv6 address``) and ``'ospf6'``: ``{'area', 'cost',
 970    'passive', 'mtu_ignore', 'priority', 'hello_interval', 'dead_interval', 'network_type',
 971    'authentication': {'key_id', 'hash_algo', 'key'} | {'keychain'} | None}`` (``ipv6 ospf6 ...``).
 972    ``router_bgp['address_families']`` is the per-family view of ``router bgp``:
 973    ``{'ipv4 unicast' | 'ipv6 unicast': {'neighbors': {peer: {'activate', 'route_map_in', ...
 974    only the keys set in that family}}, 'networks', 'aggregate_addresses', 'redistribute'}}``
 975    (router-level family statements count for IPv4 unicast); :func:`bgp_neighbor_activated`
 976    tells whether a neighbour is active in a family.  An unnumbered neighbour
 977    (``neighbor eth0 interface remote-as external``) has ``'interface': True``.
 978
 979    BGP operations: a neighbour also has ``'maximum_prefix'`` (``None`` or ``{'limit', 'threshold',
 980    'warning_only', 'restart', 'force'}``), ``'maximum_prefix_out'``, ``'ttl_security'`` (the hops of
 981    GTSM), ``'bfd'`` / ``'bfd_profile'`` and ``'graceful_shutdown'``; ``router_bgp`` has
 982    ``'confederation_identifier'``, ``'confederation_peers'`` (ASNs), ``'graceful_shutdown'`` (the
 983    global form), ``'maximum_paths'`` / ``'maximum_paths_ibgp'`` and ``'dampening'`` (``(half-life,
 984    reuse, suppress, max-suppress)``, :data:`BGP_DAMPENING_DEFAULTS` for a bare ``bgp dampening``),
 985    the last three also in their family's view; ``cfg['rpki']`` = ``{'present', 'cache_servers':
 986    [{'mode', 'host', 'port', 'preference'}], 'polling_period', 'retry_interval',
 987    'expire_interval'}``.
 988
 989    Area ids are normalised to dotted form (``area 1`` -> ``'0.0.0.1'``).  Both the
 990    router-level ``passive-interface X`` and the interface-level ``ip ospf passive``
 991    syntaxes are recognised; ``interfaces[X]['passive']`` reflects only the
 992    interface-level statement, ``router_ospf['passive_interfaces']`` the router-level one.
 993    In ``router bgp`` the statements of the ``address-family ipv4 unicast`` block and the
 994    router-level ones are merged (FRR moves ``network``, ``next-hop-self``, ``route-map``...
 995    into the address-family block in ``show running-config``).
 996    """
 997    cfg: Dict[str, Any] = {
 998        'hostname': None,
 999        'static_routes': [],
1000        'router_ospf': {
1001            'present': False, 'router_id': None, 'networks': [], 'passive_interfaces': [],
1002            'passive_default': False, 'areas': {}, 'redistribute': [],
1003            'default_information_originate': False, 'default_information_always': False,
1004            'auto_cost_reference_bandwidth': None,
1005            'capability_opaque': False, 'ti_lfa': None,
1006            'segment_routing': {'enabled': False, 'srgb': None, 'srlb': None, 'node_msd': None, 'prefixes': {}},
1007        },
1008        'interfaces': {},
1009        'router_bgp': _empty_router_bgp_config(),
1010        'prefix_lists': {},
1011        'route_maps': {},
1012        'as_path_lists': {},
1013        'community_lists': {},
1014        'static_routes6': [],
1015        'prefix_lists6': {},
1016        'router_ospf6': _empty_router_ospf6_config(),
1017        'access_lists': {},
1018        'mpls_ldp': {'present': False, 'router_id': None, 'transport_address': None, 'interfaces': [],
1019                     'label_allocate': None, 'label_advertise': [], 'explicit_null': False},
1020        'router_bgp_vrfs': {},
1021        'router_isis': _empty_router_isis_config(),
1022        'bfd': {'profiles': {}},
1023        'vrfs': {},
1024        'rpki': {'present': False, 'cache_servers': [], 'polling_period': None, 'retry_interval': None,
1025                 'expire_interval': None},
1026    }
1027    # 'router_ospf' | 'router_ospf6' | 'router_bgp' | 'interface' | 'route_map' | 'mpls_ldp' |
1028    # 'router_isis' | 'bfd' | 'vrf' | 'rpki' | 'other' | None
1029    section: Optional[str] = None
1030    ri = cfg['router_isis']
1031    bfd_profile: Dict[str, Any] | None = None   # the open ``profile NAME`` block of bfd
1032    iface: Dict[str, Any] | None = None
1033    rm_entry: Dict[str, Any] | None = None
1034    bgp_af: Optional[str] = None   # address family of the open ``address-family`` block of router bgp
1035    ldp_af: Optional[str] = None   # address family of the open ``address-family`` block of mpls ldp
1036    ro = cfg['router_ospf']
1037    ro6 = cfg['router_ospf6']
1038    rb = cfg['router_bgp']
1039    ml = cfg['mpls_ldp']
1040    vrb: Dict[str, Any] | None = None   # the open ``router bgp AS vrf NAME`` block
1041    vrf_cfg: Dict[str, Any] | None = None   # the open ``vrf NAME`` block (its L3VNI)
1042    evpn_vni: Dict[str, Any] | None = None  # the open ``vni N`` block of ``address-family l2vpn evpn``
1043
1044    def vrf_neighbor_cfg(peer: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
1045        if peer not in vrb['neighbors']:
1046            vrb['neighbors'][peer] = _empty_bgp_neighbor_config()
1047        return vrb['neighbors'][peer]
1048
1049    def neighbor_cfg(peer: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
1050        if peer not in rb['neighbors']:
1051            rb['neighbors'][peer] = _empty_bgp_neighbor_config()
1052        return rb['neighbors'][peer]
1053
1054    def seq_of(w: List[str]):
1055        """Return (seq, rest) for a 'seq N ...' prefix of the word list."""
1056        if len(w) >= 2 and w[0] == 'seq' and w[1].isdigit():
1057            return int(w[1]), w[2:]
1058        return None, w
1059
1060    def area_cfg(area: str, router: Dict[str, Any] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
1061        router = ro if router is None else router
1062        key = normalize_area(area)
1063        if key not in router['areas']:
1064            router['areas'][key] = _empty_area_config()
1065        return router['areas'][key]
1066
1067    def prefix_list_entry(words: List[str], target: Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]]) -> None:
1068        # (ip|ipv6) prefix-list NAME [seq N] permit|deny PREFIX [ge X] [le Y]
1069        seq, rest = seq_of(words[3:])
1070        if len(rest) >= 2 and rest[0] in ('permit', 'deny'):
1071            entry = {'seq': seq, 'action': rest[0], 'prefix': rest[1], 'ge': None, 'le': None}
1072            for i in range(2, len(rest) - 1):
1073                if rest[i] in ('ge', 'le') and rest[i + 1].isdigit():
1074                    entry[rest[i]] = int(rest[i + 1])
1075            target.setdefault(words[2], []).append(entry)
1076
1077    for raw in text.splitlines():
1078        line = raw.rstrip()
1079        if not line.strip() or line.strip() == '!':
1080            continue
1081        stripped = line.strip()
1082        words = stripped.split()
1083
1084        if not line[0].isspace():
1085            # top-level line: opens a section or is a global statement
1086            if stripped in ('exit', 'end', 'exit-address-family'):
1087                section, iface, rm_entry = None, None, None
1088                continue
1089            if words[0] == 'interface' and len(words) >= 2:
1090                section = 'interface'
1091                iface = cfg['interfaces'].setdefault(words[1], _empty_interface_config())
1092                continue
1093            if words[0] == 'router' and len(words) >= 2 and words[1] == 'ospf':
1094                section = 'router_ospf'
1095                iface = None
1096                ro['present'] = True
1097                continue
1098            if words[0] == 'router' and len(words) >= 2 and words[1] == 'ospf6':
1099                section, iface = 'router_ospf6', None
1100                ro6['present'] = True
1101                continue
1102            if words[0] == 'router' and len(words) >= 5 and words[1] == 'bgp' and words[3] == 'vrf':
1103                section, iface, bgp_af = 'router_bgp_vrf', None, None
1104                vrb = cfg['router_bgp_vrfs'].setdefault(words[4], _empty_router_bgp_vrf_config())
1105                vrb['present'] = True
1106                vrb['as'] = int(words[2]) if words[2].isdigit() else words[2]
1107                continue
1108            if words[0] == 'router' and len(words) >= 3 and words[1] == 'bgp':
1109                section, iface, bgp_af = 'router_bgp', None, None
1110                rb['present'] = True
1111                rb['as'] = int(words[2]) if words[2].isdigit() else words[2]
1112                continue
1113            if words[0] == 'route-map' and len(words) >= 4 and words[2] in ('permit', 'deny'):
1114                section, iface = 'route_map', None
1115                rm_entry = {'seq': int(words[3]) if words[3].isdigit() else words[3], 'action': words[2],
1116                            'match': [], 'set': []}
1117                cfg['route_maps'].setdefault(words[1], []).append(rm_entry)
1118                continue
1119            if words[:2] == ['mpls', 'ldp']:
1120                section, iface, ldp_af = 'mpls_ldp', None, None
1121                ml['present'] = True
1122                continue
1123            if words[:2] == ['router', 'isis'] and len(words) >= 3:
1124                section, iface = 'router_isis', None
1125                ri['present'] = True
1126                ri['name'] = words[2]
1127                continue
1128            if words == ['bfd']:
1129                section, iface, bfd_profile = 'bfd', None, None
1130                continue
1131            if words == ['rpki']:
1132                section, iface = 'rpki', None
1133                cfg['rpki']['present'] = True
1134                continue
1135            if words[0] == 'vrf' and len(words) >= 2:
1136                section, iface = 'vrf', None
1137                vrf_cfg = cfg['vrfs'].setdefault(words[1], {'vni': None})
1138                continue
1139            if words[0] == 'router' or words[0] in ('vrf', 'route-map', 'key', 'line', 'segment-routing'):
1140                section, iface = 'other', None
1141                continue
1142            section, iface, rm_entry = None, None, None
1143            if words[0] == 'hostname' and len(words) >= 2:
1144                cfg['hostname'] = words[1]
1145            elif words[0] == 'access-list' and len(words) >= 4:
1146                # access-list NAME [seq N] permit|deny PREFIX [exact-match]
1147                seq, rest = seq_of(words[2:])
1148                if len(rest) >= 2 and rest[0] in ('permit', 'deny'):
1149                    cfg['access_lists'].setdefault(words[1], []).append(
1150                        {'seq': seq, 'action': rest[0], 'prefix': rest[1], 'exact': 'exact-match' in rest[2:]})
1151            elif words[0] == 'ip' and len(words) >= 4 and words[1] == 'route':
1152                cfg['static_routes'].append((words[2], words[3]))
1153            elif words[0] == 'ipv6' and len(words) >= 4 and words[1] == 'route':
1154                cfg['static_routes6'].append((words[2], words[3]))
1155            elif words[:2] == ['ip', 'prefix-list'] and len(words) >= 5:
1156                prefix_list_entry(words, cfg['prefix_lists'])
1157            elif words[:2] == ['ipv6', 'prefix-list'] and len(words) >= 5:
1158                prefix_list_entry(words, cfg['prefix_lists6'])
1159            elif words[:3] == ['bgp', 'as-path', 'access-list'] and len(words) >= 6:
1160                # bgp as-path access-list NAME [seq N] permit|deny REGEXP
1161                seq, rest = seq_of(words[4:])
1162                if len(rest) >= 2 and rest[0] in ('permit', 'deny'):
1163                    cfg['as_path_lists'].setdefault(words[3], []).append((seq, rest[0], " ".join(rest[1:])))
1164            elif words[:2] == ['bgp', 'community-list'] and len(words) >= 5:
1165                # bgp community-list [standard|expanded] NAME [seq N] permit|deny COMMUNITY...
1166                rest = words[2:]
1167                if rest and rest[0] in ('standard', 'expanded'):
1168                    rest = rest[1:]
1169                if len(rest) >= 3:
1170                    name = rest[0]
1171                    seq, rest2 = seq_of(rest[1:])
1172                    if len(rest2) >= 2 and rest2[0] in ('permit', 'deny'):
1173                        cfg['community_lists'].setdefault(name, []).append((seq, rest2[0], " ".join(rest2[1:])))
1174            continue
1175
1176        # indented line: belongs to the current section
1177        if section == 'interface' and iface is not None:
1178            if words[:2] == ['ip', 'ospf'] and len(words) >= 3:
1179                sub = words[2]
1180                arg = words[3] if len(words) >= 4 else None
1181                if sub == 'cost' and arg:
1182                    iface['cost'] = int(arg)
1183                elif sub == 'priority' and arg:
1184                    iface['priority'] = int(arg)
1185                elif sub == 'hello-interval' and arg:
1186                    iface['hello_interval'] = int(arg)
1187                elif sub == 'dead-interval' and arg:
1188                    iface['dead_interval'] = int(arg) if arg.isdigit() else arg
1189                elif sub == 'authentication':
1190                    iface['authentication'] = arg if arg else 'simple'
1191                elif sub == 'authentication-key' and arg:
1192                    iface['authentication_key'] = arg
1193                elif sub == 'message-digest-key' and len(words) >= 6 and words[4] == 'md5':
1194                    iface['message_digest_keys'][int(arg)] = words[5]
1195                elif sub == 'area' and arg:
1196                    iface['area'] = normalize_area(arg)
1197                elif sub == 'passive':
1198                    iface['passive'] = True
1199                elif sub == 'network' and arg:
1200                    iface['network_type'] = arg
1201            elif words[:3] == ['no', 'ip', 'ospf'] and len(words) >= 4 and words[3] == 'passive':
1202                iface['passive'] = False
1203            elif words[0] == 'bandwidth' and len(words) >= 2:
1204                iface['bandwidth'] = int(words[1])
1205            elif words[:2] == ['ip', 'address'] and len(words) >= 3:
1206                iface['addresses'].append(words[2])
1207            elif words == ['ip', 'pim']:
1208                iface['pim'] = True
1209            elif words == ['ip', 'igmp']:
1210                iface['igmp'] = True
1211            elif words[:4] == ['ip', 'multicast', 'boundary', 'oil'] and len(words) >= 5:
1212                iface['multicast_boundary'] = words[4]
1213            elif words[:2] == ['ipv6', 'address'] and len(words) >= 3:
1214                iface['addresses6'].append(words[2])
1215            elif words[:2] == ['ipv6', 'ospf6'] and len(words) >= 3:
1216                _parse_ospf6_interface_line(iface['ospf6'], words[2:], negated=False)
1217            elif words[:3] == ['no', 'ipv6', 'ospf6'] and len(words) >= 4:
1218                _parse_ospf6_interface_line(iface['ospf6'], words[3:], negated=True)
1219            elif words[0] == 'isis' or words[1:3] == ['router', 'isis']:
1220                _parse_isis_interface_line(iface['isis'], words, negated=False)
1221            elif words[0] == 'no' and len(words) >= 2 and (words[1] == 'isis' or words[2:4] == ['router', 'isis']):
1222                _parse_isis_interface_line(iface['isis'], words[1:], negated=True)
1223            continue
1224
1225        if section == 'router_isis':
1226            _parse_router_isis_line(ri, words)
1227            continue
1228
1229        if section == 'rpki':
1230            _parse_rpki_line(cfg['rpki'], words)
1231            continue
1232
1233        if section == 'bfd':
1234            if words[0] in ('profile', 'peer') and len(words) >= 2:
1235                bfd_profile = cfg['bfd']['profiles'].setdefault(words[1], {}) if words[0] == 'profile' else None
1236            elif words == ['exit']:
1237                bfd_profile = None
1238            else:
1239                _parse_bfd_line(cfg['bfd'], bfd_profile, words)
1240            continue
1241
1242        if section == 'mpls_ldp':
1243            if words[0] == 'address-family' and len(words) >= 2:
1244                ldp_af = words[1]
1245            elif words[0] == 'exit-address-family':
1246                ldp_af = None
1247            elif words[0] == 'router-id' and len(words) >= 2:
1248                ml['router_id'] = words[1]
1249            elif ldp_af == 'ipv4':
1250                if words[:2] == ['discovery', 'transport-address'] and len(words) >= 3:
1251                    ml['transport_address'] = words[2]
1252                elif words[0] == 'interface' and len(words) >= 2:
1253                    ml['interfaces'].append(words[1])
1254                elif words[:3] == ['label', 'local', 'allocate'] and len(words) >= 4:
1255                    ml['label_allocate'] = " ".join(words[3:])
1256                elif words[:3] == ['label', 'local', 'advertise']:
1257                    if 'explicit-null' in words:
1258                        ml['explicit_null'] = True
1259                    elif len(words) >= 4:
1260                        ml['label_advertise'].append(" ".join(words[3:]))
1261            continue
1262
1263        if section == 'route_map' and rm_entry is not None:
1264            if words[0] == 'match' and len(words) >= 2:
1265                rm_entry['match'].append(" ".join(words[1:]))
1266            elif words[0] == 'set' and len(words) >= 2:
1267                rm_entry['set'].append(" ".join(words[1:]))
1268            continue
1269
1270        if section == 'vrf' and vrf_cfg is not None:
1271            if words[0] == 'vni' and len(words) >= 2 and words[1].isdigit():
1272                vrf_cfg['vni'] = int(words[1])
1273            elif words[:2] == ['no', 'vni']:
1274                vrf_cfg['vni'] = None
1275            continue
1276
1277        if section == 'router_bgp_vrf' and vrb is not None:
1278            if words[0] == 'address-family' and len(words) >= 2:
1279                bgp_af = " ".join(words[1:3]) if len(words) >= 3 else f"{words[1]} unicast"
1280                evpn_vni = None
1281            elif words[0] == 'exit-address-family':
1282                bgp_af, evpn_vni = None, None
1283            if bgp_af == 'l2vpn evpn':
1284                handled, evpn_vni = _parse_evpn_line(vrb, words, evpn_vni)
1285                if handled:
1286                    continue
1287            if not _parse_bgp_vpn_line(vrb['vpn'], words):
1288                _parse_router_bgp_line(vrb, words, vrf_neighbor_cfg, af=bgp_af)
1289            continue
1290
1291        if section == 'router_bgp':
1292            if words[0] == 'address-family' and len(words) >= 2:
1293                bgp_af = " ".join(words[1:3]) if len(words) >= 3 else f"{words[1]} unicast"
1294                evpn_vni = None
1295            elif words[0] == 'exit-address-family':
1296                bgp_af, evpn_vni = None, None
1297            if bgp_af == 'l2vpn evpn':
1298                handled, evpn_vni = _parse_evpn_line(rb, words, evpn_vni)
1299                if handled:
1300                    continue
1301            _parse_router_bgp_line(rb, words, neighbor_cfg, af=bgp_af)
1302            continue
1303
1304        if section == 'router_ospf6':
1305            if words[:2] == ['ospf6', 'router-id'] and len(words) >= 3:
1306                ro6['router_id'] = words[2]
1307            elif words[0] == 'area' and len(words) >= 3:
1308                a = area_cfg(words[1], ro6)
1309                kw = words[2]
1310                if kw == 'stub':
1311                    a['stub'] = True
1312                    a['no_summary'] = 'no-summary' in words[3:]
1313                elif kw == 'nssa':
1314                    a['nssa'] = True
1315                    a['no_summary'] = 'no-summary' in words[3:]
1316                elif kw == 'range' and len(words) >= 4:
1317                    a['ranges'].append(words[3])
1318            elif words[0] == 'redistribute' and len(words) >= 2:
1319                ro6['redistribute'].append(words[1])
1320            elif words[:2] == ['default-information', 'originate']:
1321                ro6['default_information_originate'] = True
1322                ro6['default_information_always'] = 'always' in words[2:]
1323            elif words[0] == 'interface' and len(words) >= 4 and words[2] == 'area':
1324                ro6['interface_areas'][words[1]] = normalize_area(words[3])
1325            continue
1326
1327        if section == 'router_ospf':
1328            if words[0] in ('ospf', 'router-id') and 'router-id' in words:
1329                ro['router_id'] = words[-1]
1330            elif words[0] == 'network' and len(words) >= 4 and words[2] == 'area':
1331                ro['networks'].append((words[1], normalize_area(words[3])))
1332            elif words[0] == 'passive-interface' and len(words) >= 2:
1333                if words[1] == 'default':
1334                    ro['passive_default'] = True
1335                else:
1336                    ro['passive_interfaces'].append(words[1])
1337            elif words[0] == 'no' and len(words) >= 3 and words[1] == 'passive-interface':
1338                if words[2] in ro['passive_interfaces']:
1339                    ro['passive_interfaces'].remove(words[2])
1340            elif words[0] == 'area' and len(words) >= 3:
1341                a = area_cfg(words[1])
1342                kw = words[2]
1343                if kw == 'stub':
1344                    a['stub'] = True
1345                    a['no_summary'] = 'no-summary' in words[3:]
1346                elif kw == 'nssa':
1347                    a['nssa'] = True
1348                    a['no_summary'] = 'no-summary' in words[3:]
1349                elif kw == 'range' and len(words) >= 4:
1350                    a['ranges'].append(words[3])
1351                elif kw == 'authentication':
1352                    a['authentication'] = words[3] if len(words) >= 4 else 'simple'
1353                elif kw == 'default-cost' and len(words) >= 4:
1354                    a['default_cost'] = int(words[3])
1355            elif words[0] == 'redistribute' and len(words) >= 2:
1356                ro['redistribute'].append(words[1])
1357            elif words[:2] == ['default-information', 'originate']:
1358                ro['default_information_originate'] = True
1359                ro['default_information_always'] = 'always' in words[2:]
1360            elif words[:2] == ['auto-cost', 'reference-bandwidth'] and len(words) >= 3:
1361                ro['auto_cost_reference_bandwidth'] = int(words[2])
1362            elif words[:2] == ['capability', 'opaque']:
1363                ro['capability_opaque'] = True
1364            elif words[:2] == ['fast-reroute', 'ti-lfa']:
1365                ro['ti_lfa'] = 'node' if 'node-protection' in words else 'link'
1366            elif words[0] == 'segment-routing' and len(words) >= 2:
1367                _parse_ospf_sr_line(ro['segment_routing'], words[1:])
1368            continue
1369
1370    return cfg
1371
1372
1373def _parse_rpki_line(rpki: Dict[str, Any], words: List[str]) -> None:
1374    """One statement of the ``rpki`` block: ``rpki cache tcp HOST PORT [source A] preference N``,
1375    ``rpki polling_period N`` (also the ``retry_interval`` / ``expire_interval`` timers)."""
1376    negated = words[0] == 'no'
1377    w = words[1:] if negated else words
1378    if len(w) < 3 or w[0] != 'rpki':
1379        return
1380    if w[1] == 'cache':
1381        rest = w[2:]
1382        mode = 'tcp'
1383        if rest and rest[0] in ('tcp', 'ssh'):
1384            mode, rest = rest[0], rest[1:]
1385        if len(rest) < 2:
1386            return
1387        server = {'mode': mode, 'host': rest[0], 'port': _int_or_none(rest[1]), 'preference': None}
1388        if 'preference' in rest[:-1]:
1389            server['preference'] = _int_or_none(rest[rest.index('preference') + 1])
1390        rpki['cache_servers'] = [s for s in rpki['cache_servers']
1391                                 if (s['host'], s['port']) != (server['host'], server['port'])]
1392        if not negated:
1393            rpki['cache_servers'].append(server)
1394    elif w[1] in ('polling_period', 'retry_interval', 'expire_interval'):
1395        rpki[w[1]] = None if negated else _int_or_none(w[2])
1396
