1398def _empty_router_bgp_vrf_config() -> Dict[str, Any]:
1399    cfg = _empty_router_bgp_config()
1400    cfg['vpn'] = {'rd': None, 'rt_import': [], 'rt_export': [], 'label': None, 'export_vpn': False,
1401                  'import_vpn': False, 'route_map_export': None, 'route_map_import': None}
1402    return cfg
1403
1404
1405def _parse_bgp_vpn_line(vpn: Dict[str, Any], words: List[str]) -> bool:
1406    """A VPN statement of the IPv4 unicast family of a VRF instance applied to *vpn* (``rd vpn
1407    export``, ``rt vpn both|import|export``, ``label vpn export``, ``export vpn``, ``import vpn``,
1408    their ``no`` forms); False for any other statement."""
1409    negated = bool(words) and words[0] == 'no'
1410    w = words[1:] if negated else words
1411    if w[:3] == ['rd', 'vpn', 'export']:
1412        vpn['rd'] = None if negated else (w[3] if len(w) >= 4 else None)
1413    elif w[:2] == ['rt', 'vpn'] and len(w) >= 3 and w[2] in ('both', 'import', 'export'):
1414        keys = ['rt_import', 'rt_export'] if w[2] == 'both' else [f"rt_{w[2]}"]
1415        for key in keys:
1416            if negated:
1417                vpn[key] = [x for x in vpn[key] if x not in w[3:]] if w[3:] else []
1418            else:
1419                vpn[key] = list(w[3:])
1420    elif w[:3] == ['label', 'vpn', 'export']:
1421        vpn['label'] = None if negated else (w[3] if len(w) >= 4 else None)
1422    elif w == ['export', 'vpn']:
1423        vpn['export_vpn'] = not negated
1424    elif w == ['import', 'vpn']:
1425        vpn['import_vpn'] = not negated
1426    elif w[:2] == ['route-map', 'vpn'] and len(w) >= 3 and w[2] in ('export', 'import'):
1427        vpn[f"route_map_{w[2]}"] = None if negated else (w[3] if len(w) >= 4 else None)
1428    else:
1429        return False
1430    return True
1431
1432
1433def _parse_ospf_sr_line(sr: Dict[str, Any], w: List[str]) -> None:
1434    """``segment-routing <w...>`` of ``router ospf`` applied to *sr*."""
1435    def block(i: int):
1436        if len(w) > i + 2 and w[i + 1].isdigit() and w[i + 2].isdigit():
1437            return int(w[i + 1]), int(w[i + 2])
1438        return None
1439    if w[0] == 'on':
1440        sr['enabled'] = True
1441    elif w[0] in ('global-block', 'local-block'):
1442        for i, word in enumerate(w):
1443            if word == 'global-block':
1444                sr['srgb'] = block(i)
1445            elif word == 'local-block':
1446                sr['srlb'] = block(i)
1447    elif w[0] == 'node-msd' and len(w) >= 2 and w[1].isdigit():
1448        sr['node_msd'] = int(w[1])
1449    elif w[0] == 'prefix' and len(w) >= 4 and w[2] == 'index' and w[3].isdigit():
1450        sr['prefixes'][w[1]] = {'index': int(w[3]), 'no_php': 'no-php-flag' in w[4:],
1451                                'explicit_null': 'explicit-null' in w[4:]}
1452
1453
1454def _parse_ospf6_interface_line(o6: Dict[str, Any], w: List[str], negated: bool) -> None:
1455    """``ipv6 ospf6 <w...>`` (or its ``no`` form) of an interface block applied to *o6*."""
1456    sub = w[0]
1457    arg = w[1] if len(w) >= 2 else None
1458    if sub == 'area':
1459        o6['area'] = None if negated or not arg else normalize_area(arg)
1460    elif sub == 'passive':
1461        o6['passive'] = not negated
1462    elif sub == 'mtu-ignore':
1463        o6['mtu_ignore'] = not negated
1464    elif sub in ('cost', 'priority', 'hello-interval', 'dead-interval'):
1465        key = sub.replace('-', '_')
1466        o6[key] = None if negated or not (arg and arg.isdigit()) else int(arg)
1467    elif sub == 'network':
1468        o6['network_type'] = None if negated else arg
1469    elif sub == 'authentication':
1470        if negated:
1471            o6['authentication'] = None
1472        elif arg == 'keychain' and len(w) >= 3:
1473            o6['authentication'] = {'keychain': w[2]}
1474        else:
1475            # ipv6 ospf6 authentication key-id N hash-algo ALGO key KEY
1476            auth = {'key_id': None, 'hash_algo': None, 'key': None}
1477            for i in range(1, len(w) - 1):
1478                if w[i] == 'key-id' and w[i + 1].isdigit():
1479                    auth['key_id'] = int(w[i + 1])
1480                elif w[i] == 'hash-algo':
1481                    auth['hash_algo'] = w[i + 1]
1482                elif w[i] == 'key':
1483                    auth['key'] = w[i + 1]
1484            o6['authentication'] = auth
1485
1486
1487def bgp_neighbor_activated(router_bgp: Dict[str, Any], peer, afi: str = 'ipv4') -> bool:
1488    """Whether the neighbour *peer* of a ``router_bgp`` of :func:`parse_frr_config` is active in
1489    the unicast family *afi* (``'ipv4'``, ``'ipv6'``) or in the family named in full (``'ipv4
1490    vpn'``): an explicit ``[no] neighbor X activate`` of that family wins; else IPv4 unicast
1491    follows ``bgp default ipv4-unicast`` (on by default in FRR's traditional profile) and the
1492    other families are off."""
1493    peer = str(peer)
1494    if peer not in (router_bgp or {}).get('neighbors', {}):
1495        return False
1496    family = afi if ' ' in afi else f"{afi} unicast"
1497    per_af = router_bgp.get('address_families', {}).get(family, {}).get('neighbors', {}).get(peer, {})
1498    if per_af.get('activate') is not None:
1499        return bool(per_af['activate'])
1500    return afi == 'ipv4' and bool(router_bgp.get('default_ipv4_unicast', True))
1501
1502
1503def prefix_list_permits(prefix_lists: Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]], name: str, prefix) -> Optional[bool]:
1504    """How the prefix-list *name* of :func:`parse_frr_config` treats *prefix* (an address or a
1505    network): True for permit, False for deny (the first matching entry in ``seq`` order, an
1506    implicit deny when none matches), ``None`` when the list does not exist.  An address is the
1507    host prefix (/32 or /128), which is how pimd matches a group."""
1508    entries = prefix_lists.get(name)
1509    if entries is None:
1510        return None
1511    try:
1512        target = ip_network(str(prefix), strict=False)
1513    except ValueError:
1514        return False
1515    ordered = sorted(entries, key=lambda e: (e['seq'] is None, e['seq'] if isinstance(e['seq'], int) else 0))
1516    for entry in ordered:
1517        try:
1518            network = ip_network(entry['prefix'], strict=False)
1519        except ValueError:
1520            continue
1521        if network.version != target.version or not target.subnet_of(network):
1522            continue
1523        low = entry['ge'] if entry['ge'] is not None else network.prefixlen
1524        high = entry['le'] if entry['le'] is not None else (network.max_prefixlen if entry['ge'] is not None
1525                                                            else network.prefixlen)
1526        if low <= target.prefixlen <= high:
1527            return entry['action'] == 'permit'
1528    return False
1529

1531def get_frr_running_config(grade: Grade0, machine_name: str, step: int = 1, allow_error: bool = False) -> Dict[str, Any]:
1532    """Run 'vtysh -c "show running-config"' and parse it (see :func:`parse_frr_config`).
1533    Returns {} on error or empty output."""
1534    output, code = _test(grade, machine_name, 'vtysh -c "show running-config"', step, allow_error)
1535    if code != 0 or not output:
1536        return {}
1537    return parse_frr_config(output)

1540def expected_auto_cost(reference_bandwidth: int, interface_bandwidth: int) -> int:
1541    """OSPF cost FRR computes for an interface: ``round(reference / bandwidth)`` clamped to
1542    ``[1, 65535]`` (both in Mbit/s; the default reference is 100000 and a veth reports 10000,
1543    hence the default cost of 10)."""
1544    if not interface_bandwidth:
1545        return 10
1546    cost = int(reference_bandwidth / interface_bandwidth + 0.5)
1547    return max(1, min(65535, cost))
1548

1550# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

1552# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1553
1554def _vtysh_json(grade: Grade0, machine_name: str, command: str, step: int = 1, allow_error: bool = False) -> Any:
1555    """Run ``vtysh -c "<command> json"`` and return the decoded JSON object.
1556
1557    Returns ``{}`` on the registration-pass placeholder, on a non-zero exit code, when
1558    BGP is not configured (``% ...`` error line) or when the output is not a JSON object.
1559    """
1560    output, code = _test(grade, machine_name, f'vtysh -c "{command} json"', step, allow_error)
1561    if code != 0 or not output:
1562        return {}
1563    start = output.find('{')
1564    if start < 0:
1565        return {}
1566    try:
1567        data = json.loads(output[start:])
1568    except (ValueError, TypeError):
1569        return {}
1570    return data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}

1573def _int_or_none(value) -> Optional[int]:
1574    try:
1575        return int(value)
1576    except (TypeError, ValueError):
1577        return None

1580def _afi_safi(afi: str) -> str:
1581    """``'ipv4'`` / ``'ipv6'`` -> the ``show bgp`` keywords of that unicast family."""
1582    if afi not in ('ipv4', 'ipv6'):
1583        raise ValueError(f"afi must be 'ipv4' or 'ipv6', not {afi!r}")
1584    return f"{afi} unicast"

1587def _af_key(afi: str) -> str:
1588    """``'ipv4'`` -> ``'ipv4Unicast'`` (the key of a family in the json of bgpd)."""
1589    return 'ipv6Unicast' if afi == 'ipv6' else 'ipv4Unicast'

1591
1592def as_list_from_string(path) -> List[int]:
1593    """``'65100 65000'`` -> ``[65100, 65000]`` (AS sets ``{65100,65000}`` keep their members, and so
1594    do the confederation segments ``(65101 65102)``: see :func:`confed_as_list_from_string`)."""
1595    if not path:
1596        return []
1597    return [int(tok) for tok in re.findall(r'\d+', str(path))]
1598
1599
1600def confed_as_list_from_string(path) -> List[int]:
1601    """The member ASes of a confederation crossed by a path: the numbers between parentheses
1602    (``'(65101 65102) 64500'`` -> ``[65101, 65102]``; ``[]`` outside a confederation)."""
1603    if not path:
1604        return []
1605    return [int(tok) for seg in re.findall(r'\(([^)]*)\)', str(path)) for tok in re.findall(r'\d+', seg)]
1606
1607
1608#: the validation states of a path (``rpki`` of :func:`parse_bgp_routes` / :func:`parse_bgp_prefix`)
1609RPKI_STATES = ('valid', 'invalid', 'notfound')
1610
1611
1612def _rpki_state(e: Dict[str, Any]) -> Optional[str]:
1613    """``'valid'`` / ``'invalid'`` / ``'notfound'`` from ``rpkiValidationState`` (one prefix: ``'not
1614    found'``) or the ``rpkiValid`` / ``rpkiInvalid`` / ``rpkiNotFound`` booleans (whole table);
1615    ``None`` without RPKI (bgpd started without ``-M rpki``)."""
1616    state = e.get('rpkiValidationState')
1617    if isinstance(state, str):
1618        state = state.replace(' ', '').lower()
1619        return state if state in RPKI_STATES else None
1620    for key, value in (('rpkiValid', 'valid'), ('rpkiInvalid', 'invalid'), ('rpkiNotFound', 'notfound')):
1621        if e.get(key):
1622            return value
1623    return None
1624

1626# -- show bgp ipv4 unicast summary ------------------------------------------
1627
1628def parse_bgp_summary(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
1629    """Parse the JSON of ``show bgp ipv4 unicast summary``.
1630
1631    Accepts the flat address-family object or the ``{'ipv4Unicast': {...}}`` /
1632    ``{'ipv6Unicast': {...}}`` wrapper of ``show bgp summary json`` (IPv4 first).  Peers are
1633    keyed by address, or by interface name for an unnumbered neighbour (``'eth1'``).
1634    Returns ``{}`` when no BGP process answers, else::
1635
1636        {'router_id': '10.0.0.1', 'as': 65001,
1637         'peers': {'10.1.1.2': {'remote_as': 65100, 'state': 'Established', 'established': True,
1638                                'policy_blocked': False,   # eBGP peer without in/out policy (RFC 8212)
1639                                'pfx_rcd': 3, 'pfx_snt': 1, 'description': 'ISP-A',
1640                                'uptime': '00:12:34'}}}
1641    """
1642    if not isinstance(data, dict):
1643        return {}
1644    for key in ('ipv4Unicast', 'ipv6Unicast'):
1645        if key in data and isinstance(data[key], dict):
1646            data = data[key]
1647            break
1648    if 'routerId' not in data and 'peers' not in data:
1649        return {}
1650    peers: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
1651    for ip, p in (data.get('peers') or {}).items():
1652        if not isinstance(p, dict):
1653            continue
1654        state = p.get('state')
1655        peers[ip] = {
1656            'remote_as': _int_or_none(p.get('remoteAs')),
1657            'state': state,
1658            'established': state == 'Established',
1659            'policy_blocked': p.get('peerState') == 'Policy',
1660            'pfx_rcd': _int_or_none(p.get('pfxRcd')) or 0,
1661            'pfx_snt': _int_or_none(p.get('pfxSnt')) or 0,
1662            'description': p.get('desc'),
1663            'uptime': p.get('peerUptime'),
1664            'id_type': p.get('idType'),
1665            'peer_state': p.get('peerState'),
1666            # the session was closed because the peer sent more prefixes than maximum-prefix
1667            'prefix_limit_exceeded': p.get('peerState') == 'PfxCt',
1668        }
1669    return {'router_id': data.get('routerId'), 'as': _int_or_none(data.get('as')), 'peers': peers,
1670            'dampening_enabled': bool(data.get('dampeningEnabled'))}
1671
1672
1673def get_bgp_summary(grade: Grade0, machine_name: str, step: int = 1, allow_error: bool = False,
1674                    afi: str = 'ipv4', vrf: str = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
1675    """Run 'vtysh -c "show bgp ipv4 unicast summary json"' (``afi='ipv6'``: the IPv6 unicast
1676    family; ``vrf``: the instance of that VRF, ``show bgp vrf X ipv4 unicast summary``; see
1677    :func:`parse_bgp_summary`).  Returns {} when BGP is not running, and when no neighbour is
1678    active in that family."""
1679    return parse_bgp_summary(_vtysh_json(grade, machine_name, f'show bgp {_vrf_words(vrf)}{_afi_safi(afi)} summary',
1680                                         step, allow_error))

1682
1683def _vrf_words(vrf: str = None) -> str:
1684    return f"vrf {vrf} " if vrf else ""
1685
1686
1687def get_bgp_vpn_summary(grade: Grade0, machine_name: str, step: int = 1, allow_error: bool = True) -> Dict[str, Any]:
1688    """The neighbours of the IPv4 VPN family (``show bgp ipv4 vpn summary json``, the shape of
1689    :func:`parse_bgp_summary`); {} when no neighbour is active in it."""

1693# -- show bgp neighbors X -----------------------------------------------------
1694
1695def parse_bgp_neighbor(data: Any, peer: str = None, afi: str = 'ipv4') -> Dict[str, Any]:
1696    """Parse the JSON of ``show bgp neighbors <peer>``.
1697
1698    The output is keyed by peer address (interface name for an unnumbered neighbour);
1699    ``peer`` selects an entry (the first one when omitted).  The per-family fields (prefix
1700    counters, policies, next-hop-self...) are those of the unicast family *afi*
1701    (``addressFamilyInfo.ipv4Unicast`` / ``ipv6Unicast``; ``af`` = ``{}`` when the neighbour is
1702    not active in it).  ``nexthop_global`` / ``nexthop_local`` are the IPv6 next hops the
1703    router sends this peer.  Returns ``{}`` when the neighbour does not exist, else::
1704
1705        {'peer': '10.1.1.2', 'remote_as': 65100, 'local_as': 65001, 'state': 'Established',
1706         'established': True, 'link': 'external' | 'internal', 'description': 'ISP-A',
1707         'remote_router_id': '100.100.100.100', 'local_router_id': '10.0.3.1',
1708         'hold_time': 30, 'keepalive': 10,                    # negotiated, seconds
1709         'configured_hold_time': 30, 'configured_keepalive': 10,
1710         'local_host': '10.0.3.1', 'foreign_host': '10.0.3.2', 'update_source': 'lo' | None,
1711         'accepted_prefixes': 3, 'sent_prefixes': 1,
1712         'route_reflector_client': False, 'next_hop_self': False, 'default_originate': False,
1713         'default_originate_route_map': None,
1714         'route_map_in': 'LP-IN', 'route_map_out': None, 'prefix_list_in': None, 'prefix_list_out': None,
1715         'send_community': True, 'nexthop_global': None, 'nexthop_local': None,
1716         'af': {...ipv4Unicast...}, 'raw': {...}}
1717    """
1718    if not isinstance(data, dict) or not data:
1719        return {}
1720    if 'bgpNoSuchNeighbor' in data or 'warning' in data:
1721        return {}
1722    if peer is not None:
1723        entry = data.get(str(peer))
1724    else:
1725        entry = next((v for v in data.values() if isinstance(v, dict)), None)
1726    if not isinstance(entry, dict) or 'bgpState' not in entry:
1727        return {}
1728    af = ((entry.get('addressFamilyInfo') or {}).get(_af_key(afi))) or {}
1729    if not isinstance(af, dict):
1730        af = {}
1731    peer_ip = peer if peer is not None else next(iter(data))
1732
1733    def msecs(key) -> Optional[int]:
1734        v = _int_or_none(entry.get(key))
1735        return None if v is None else v // 1000
1736
1737    if entry.get('nbrExternalLink'):
1738        link = 'external'
1739    elif entry.get('nbrInternalLink'):
1740        link = 'internal'
1741    elif entry.get('nbrConfedExternalLink'):
1742        link = 'confed-external'      # a member AS of the same confederation
1743    elif entry.get('nbrConfedInternalLink'):
1744        link = 'confed-internal'
1745    else:
1746        link = None
1747    restart_ms = _int_or_none(af.get('prefixAllowedRestartIntervalMsecs'))
1748    bfd = entry.get('peerBfdInfo') if isinstance(entry.get('peerBfdInfo'), dict) else {}
1749    return {
1750        'peer': peer_ip,
1751        'remote_as': _int_or_none(entry.get('remoteAs')),
1752        'local_as': _int_or_none(entry.get('localAs')),
1753        'state': entry.get('bgpState'),
1754        'established': entry.get('bgpState') == 'Established',
1755        'link': link,
1756        'description': entry.get('nbrDesc'),
1757        'remote_router_id': entry.get('remoteRouterId'),
1758        'local_router_id': entry.get('localRouterId'),
1759        'hold_time': msecs('bgpTimerHoldTimeMsecs'),
1760        'keepalive': msecs('bgpTimerKeepAliveIntervalMsecs'),
1761        'configured_hold_time': msecs('bgpTimerConfiguredHoldTimeMsecs'),
1762        'configured_keepalive': msecs('bgpTimerConfiguredKeepAliveIntervalMsecs'),
1763        'local_host': entry.get('hostLocal'),
1764        'foreign_host': entry.get('hostForeign'),
1765        'update_source': entry.get('updateSource'),
1766        'accepted_prefixes': _int_or_none(af.get('acceptedPrefixCounter')) or 0,
1767        'sent_prefixes': _int_or_none(af.get('sentPrefixCounter')) or 0,
1768        'route_reflector_client': bool(af.get('routeReflectorClient')),
1769        'next_hop_self': bool(af.get('routerAlwaysNextHop') or af.get('nextHopSelf')),
1770        'default_originate': bool(af.get('defaultSent') or af.get('defaultNotSent')),
1771        'default_originate_route_map': af.get('defaultRouteMap'),
1772        'route_map_in': af.get('routeMapForIncomingAdvertisements'),
1773        'route_map_out': af.get('routeMapForOutgoingAdvertisements'),
1774        'prefix_list_in': af.get('incomingUpdatePrefixFilterList'),
1775        'prefix_list_out': af.get('outgoingUpdatePrefixFilterList'),
1776        'send_community': 'commAttriSentToNbr' in af if af else True,
1777        'nexthop_global': entry.get('nexthopGlobal'),
1778        'nexthop_local': entry.get('nexthopLocal'),
1779        # maximum-prefix (the family's limit) and why the session was last closed
1780        'max_prefix': _int_or_none(af.get('prefixAllowedMax')),
1781        'max_prefix_threshold': _int_or_none(af.get('prefixAllowedWarningThresh')),
1782        'max_prefix_warning_only': bool(af.get('prefixAllowedMaxWarning')),
1783        'max_prefix_restart': None if restart_ms is None else restart_ms // 60000,   # minutes
1784        'max_prefix_exceeded': bool(entry.get('prefixesConfigExceedMax')),
1785        'last_notification': entry.get('lastNotificationReason'),
1786        'last_reset': entry.get('lastResetDueTo'),
1787        'bfd_status': bfd.get('status'),             # 'Up' / 'Down' / None without BFD
1788        'af': af,
1789        'raw': entry,
1790    }
1791
1792
1793def get_bgp_neighbor(grade: Grade0, machine_name: str, peer, step: int = 1, allow_error: bool = False,
1794                     afi: str = 'ipv4') -> Dict[str, Any]:
1795    """Run 'vtysh -c "show bgp neighbors <peer> json"' (see :func:`parse_bgp_neighbor`; *afi*
1796    picks the family of the per-family fields).  Returns {} when BGP is not running or the
1797    neighbour is unknown."""
1798    _afi_safi(afi)
1799    return parse_bgp_neighbor(_vtysh_json(grade, machine_name, f'show bgp neighbors {peer}', step, allow_error),
1800                              peer=str(peer), afi=afi)
1801
1802
1803# -- show bgp ipv4 unicast (whole table) --------------------------------------
1804
1805def _parse_bgp_path_entry(e: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
1806    """Common fields of a path in ``show bgp ipv4 unicast json`` and ``show bgp ipv4 unicast X json``."""
1807    aspath = e.get('aspath')
1808    if isinstance(aspath, dict):
1809        aspath_str = aspath.get('string') or ''
1810    else:
1811        aspath_str = e.get('path') or ''
1812    if aspath_str == 'Local':
1813        aspath_str = ''
1814    best = e.get('bestpath')
1815    if isinstance(best, dict):
1816        reason = best.get('selectionReason')
1817        best = bool(best.get('overall'))
1818    else:
1819        reason = e.get('selectionReason')
1820        best = bool(best)
1821    nexthops = [n for n in (e.get('nexthops') or []) if isinstance(n, dict)]
1822    used = next((n for n in nexthops if n.get('used')), nexthops[0] if nexthops else {})
1823    # IPv6: the global next hop of MP_REACH_NLRI and the link-local one (eBGP on a link; the
1824    # link-local one is ``used``).  An unnumbered peer's link-local comes as ``scope: global``.
1825    global_nh = next((n for n in nexthops if n.get('scope') == 'global'), nexthops[0] if nexthops else {})
1826    link_local_nh = next((n for n in nexthops if n.get('scope') == 'link-local'), {})
1827    peer = e.get('peer')
1828    if isinstance(peer, dict):
1829        peer_id, peer_router_id = peer.get('peerId'), peer.get('routerId')
1830        path_from = peer.get('type') or e.get('pathFrom')
1831    else:
1832        peer_id, peer_router_id = e.get('peerId'), None
1833        path_from = e.get('pathFrom')
1834    community = e.get('community')
1835    if isinstance(community, dict):
1836        communities = list(community.get('list') or [])
1837        if not communities and community.get('string'):
1838            communities = str(community['string']).split()
1839    else:
1840        communities = []
1841    cluster = e.get('clusterList')
1842    if isinstance(cluster, dict):
1843        cluster_list = list(cluster.get('list') or [])
1844    elif isinstance(cluster, list):
1845        cluster_list = list(cluster)
1846    else:
1847        cluster_list = []
1848    return {
1849        'valid': bool(e.get('valid')),
1850        'best': best,
1851        'multipath': bool(e.get('multipath')),
1852        'rpki': _rpki_state(e),
1853        # dampening: suppressed (``damped``) or kept only as flap history (``history``)
1854        'damped': bool(e.get('damped') or e.get('dampeningSuppressed')),
1855        'history': bool(e.get('history') or e.get('dampeningHistoryEntry')),
1856        'dampening_penalty': _int_or_none(e.get('dampeningPenalty')),
1857        'reason': reason,
1858        'path_from': path_from,
1859        'nexthop': used.get('ip'),
1860        'nexthop_used': bool(used.get('used')),
1861        'nexthop_global': global_nh.get('ip'),
1862        'nexthop_link_local': link_local_nh.get('ip'),
1863        'accessible': used.get('accessible'),
1864        'peer': peer_id,
1865        'peer_router_id': peer_router_id,
1866        'aspath': aspath_str,
1867        'as_list': as_list_from_string(aspath_str),
1868        'confed_as_list': confed_as_list_from_string(aspath_str),
1869        'locprf': _int_or_none(e.get('locPrf')),
1870        'med': _int_or_none(e.get('metric')),
1871        'weight': _int_or_none(e.get('weight')) or 0,
1872        'origin': e.get('origin'),
1873        'local': bool(e.get('local') or e.get('sourced') or peer_id in ('(unspec)', '0.0.0.0')),
1874        'originator_id': e.get('originatorId'),
1875        'cluster_list': cluster_list,
1876        'communities': communities,
1877    }
1878
1879
1880def parse_bgp_routes(data: Any) -> Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]]:
1881    """Parse the JSON of ``show bgp ipv4 unicast`` (or ``ipv6 unicast``: the whole BGP table).
1882
1883    Returns ``{prefix: [path, ...]}`` (``{}`` when BGP is not running), each path being::
1884
1885        {'valid': True, 'best': True, 'reason': 'Local Pref', 'path_from': 'internal',
1886         'nexthop': '10.0.3.3', 'nexthop_used': True, 'accessible': None,
1887         'nexthop_global': '10.0.3.3', 'nexthop_link_local': None,   # IPv6: both next hops
1888         'peer': '10.0.3.2', 'peer_router_id': None, 'aspath': '65200 65000',
1889         'as_list': [65200, 65000], 'locprf': 200, 'med': 0, 'weight': 0, 'origin': 'IGP',
1890         'local': False, 'originator_id': None, 'cluster_list': [], 'communities': []}
1891
1892    A ``network`` statement whose prefix has no route in the RIB (``bgp network
1893    import-check``) yields a path with ``valid`` and ``best`` both ``False``.
1894
1895    Every path also has ``multipath`` (installed with the best path, ``=`` in the text),
1896    ``rpki`` (``'valid'`` / ``'invalid'`` / ``'notfound'``, ``None`` without the RPKI module),
1897    ``damped`` / ``history`` / ``dampening_penalty`` (dampening) and ``confed_as_list`` (the member
1898    ASes of a confederation, the ``(65101 65102)`` part of the AS path, also counted in ``as_list``).
1899    """
1900    if not isinstance(data, dict):
1901        return {}
1902    routes = data.get('routes')
1903    if not isinstance(routes, dict):
1904        return {}
1905    result: Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]] = {}
1906    for prefix, entries in routes.items():
1907        if isinstance(entries, dict):
1908            entries = [entries]
1909        if not isinstance(entries, list):
1910            continue
1911        result[prefix] = [_parse_bgp_path_entry(e) for e in entries if isinstance(e, dict)]
1912    return result
1913
1914
1915def get_bgp_routes(grade: Grade0, machine_name: str, step: int = 1, allow_error: bool = False,
1916                   afi: str = 'ipv4', vrf: str = None) -> Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]]:
1917    """Run 'vtysh -c "show bgp ipv4 unicast json"' (``afi='ipv6'``: ``ipv6 unicast``; ``vrf``: the
1918    table of that VRF's instance; see :func:`parse_bgp_routes`). Returns {} on error."""
1919    return parse_bgp_routes(_vtysh_json(grade, machine_name, f'show bgp {_vrf_words(vrf)}{_afi_safi(afi)}', step,
1920                                        allow_error))
1921
1922
1923def parse_bgp_vpn_routes(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]]]:
1924    """The JSON of ``show bgp ipv4 vpn`` (the VPNv4 table) → ``{rd: {prefix: [path, ...]}}``, the
1925    paths of :func:`parse_bgp_routes`; ``{}`` without BGP (``{"warning": ...}``)."""
1926    if not isinstance(data, dict):
1927        return {}
1928    by_rd = (data.get('routes') or {}).get('routeDistinguishers') if isinstance(data.get('routes'), dict) else None
1929    if not isinstance(by_rd, dict):
1930        return {}
1931    return {rd: parse_bgp_routes({'routes': prefixes}) for rd, prefixes in by_rd.items() if isinstance(prefixes, dict)}
1932
1933
1934def get_bgp_vpn_routes(grade: Grade0, machine_name: str, step: int = 1,
1935                       allow_error: bool = True) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]]]:
1936    """The VPNv4 table of *machine_name* (see :func:`parse_bgp_vpn_routes`)."""
1937    return parse_bgp_vpn_routes(_vtysh_json(grade, machine_name, 'show bgp ipv4 vpn', step, allow_error))

1940def bgp_best_path(routes: Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]], prefix) -> Dict[str, Any]:
1941    """Return the best path of ``prefix`` in a :func:`parse_bgp_routes` result (``{}`` when none)."""
1942    for p in routes.get(str(prefix), []):
1943        if p.get('best'):
1944            return p
1945    return {}
1946
1947
1948def bgp_paths(routes: Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]], prefix, nexthop=None, peer=None, first_as: int = None,
1949              ends_with=None, path_from: str = None, valid: bool = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
1950    """Return the paths of ``prefix`` matching every given criterion (``ends_with`` is a
1951    list of AS numbers compared with the end of ``as_list``)."""
1952    result = []
1953    for p in routes.get(str(prefix), []):
1954        if nexthop is not None and p.get('nexthop') != str(nexthop):
1955            continue
1956        if peer is not None and p.get('peer') != str(peer):
1957            continue
1958        if first_as is not None and (not p['as_list'] or p['as_list'][0] != int(first_as)):
1959            continue
1960        if ends_with is not None:
1961            tail = [int(a) for a in ends_with]
1962            if p['as_list'][-len(tail):] != tail:
1963                continue
1964        if path_from is not None and p.get('path_from') != path_from:
1965            continue
1966        if valid is not None and bool(p.get('valid')) != valid:
1967            continue
1968        result.append(p)
1969    return result
1970
1971
1972# -- show bgp ipv4 unicast PREFIX ---------------------------------------------
1973
1974def parse_bgp_prefix(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
1975    """Parse the JSON of ``show bgp ipv4 unicast <prefix>`` (detailed paths).
1976
1977    Returns ``{'prefix': None, 'paths': []}`` when the prefix is unknown, else
1978    ``{'prefix': '10.1.0.0/24', 'paths': [path, ...]}`` with the fields of
1979    :func:`parse_bgp_routes` plus ``accessible``, ``peer_router_id``, ``originator_id``,
1980    ``cluster_list`` (route reflection) and ``communities`` (``['65001:300', ...]``).
1981    """
1982    if not isinstance(data, dict) or not isinstance(data.get('paths'), list):
1983        return {'prefix': None, 'paths': []}
1984    return {'prefix': data.get('prefix'),
1985            'paths': [_parse_bgp_path_entry(e) for e in data['paths'] if isinstance(e, dict)]}
1986
1987
1988def get_bgp_prefix(grade: Grade0, machine_name: str, prefix, step: int = 1, allow_error: bool = False,
1989                   afi: str = 'ipv4') -> Dict[str, Any]:
1990    """Run 'vtysh -c "show bgp ipv4 unicast <prefix> json"' (``afi='ipv6'``: ``ipv6 unicast``;
1991    see :func:`parse_bgp_prefix`)."""
1992    return parse_bgp_prefix(_vtysh_json(grade, machine_name, f'show bgp {_afi_safi(afi)} {prefix}', step,
1993                                        allow_error))

1996# -- show bgp ipv4 unicast neighbors X advertised-routes ------------------------
1997
1998def parse_bgp_advertised_routes(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
1999    """Parse the JSON of ``show bgp ipv4 unicast neighbors <peer> advertised-routes``
2000    (the routes sent to that peer, after the outbound policy).
2001
2002    Returns ``{prefix: {'nexthop', 'aspath', 'as_list', 'locprf', 'med', 'weight', 'origin'}}``
2003    (``{}`` on error or when nothing is advertised); ``nexthop`` is ``nextHop`` (IPv4) or
2004    ``nextHopGlobal`` (IPv6).
2005    """
2006    if not isinstance(data, dict):
2007        return {}
2008    adv = data.get('advertisedRoutes')
2009    if not isinstance(adv, dict):
2010        return {}
2011    result: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
2012    for prefix, e in adv.items():
2013        if not isinstance(e, dict):
2014            continue
2015        path = e.get('path') or ''
2016        result[prefix] = {
2017            'nexthop': e.get('nextHop') if 'nextHop' in e else e.get('nextHopGlobal'),
2018            'aspath': path,
2019            'as_list': as_list_from_string(path),
2020            'locprf': _int_or_none(e.get('locPrf')),
2021            'med': _int_or_none(e.get('metric')),
2022            'weight': _int_or_none(e.get('weight')) or 0,
2023            'origin': e.get('bgpOriginCode') or e.get('origin'),
2024        }
2025    return result
2026
2027
2028def get_bgp_advertised_routes(grade: Grade0, machine_name: str, peer, step: int = 1,
2029                              allow_error: bool = False, afi: str = 'ipv4') -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
2030    """Run 'vtysh -c "show bgp ipv4 unicast neighbors <peer> advertised-routes json"'
2031    (``afi='ipv6'``: ``ipv6 unicast``; see :func:`parse_bgp_advertised_routes`)."""
2032    return parse_bgp_advertised_routes(
2033        _vtysh_json(grade, machine_name, f'show bgp {_afi_safi(afi)} neighbors {peer} advertised-routes', step,
2034                    allow_error))

2037# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
2038# RIP (text output of vtysh: ripd has no json form)
2039# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
2040
2041#: metric of an unreachable route
2042RIP_INFINITY = 16
2043#: sub-codes of `show ip rip`: where the route of the RIP table comes from
2044RIP_SUB_CODES = {'n': 'normal', 's': 'static', 'd': 'default', 'r': 'redistribute', 'i': 'interface'}
2045
2046_RIP_ROUTE_RE = re.compile(
2047    r'^(?P<code>[A-Z])\((?P<sub>[a-z])\)\s+(?P<prefix>\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3}/\d{1,2})\s+'
2048    r'(?P<nexthop>\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3}|blackhole|V6 Address Hidden)\s+(?P<metric>\d+)\s+'
2049    r'(?P<source>self(?:\s+\((?P<external>[^)]*)\))?|\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3})\s+(?P<tag>\d+)'
2050    r'(?:\s+(?P<time>\d\d:\d\d(?::\d\d)?))?\s*$')
2051_RIP_VERSION = r'(?:1 2|1|2|none)'
2052_RIP_INTERFACE_RE = re.compile(
2053    rf'^\s+(?P<name>\S+)\s+(?P<send>{_RIP_VERSION})\s+(?P<receive>{_RIP_VERSION})(?:\s+(?P<key_chain>\S+))?\s*$')
2054_RIP_SOURCE_RE = re.compile(
2055    r'^\s+(?P<gateway>\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3})\s+(?P<bad_packets>\d+)\s+(?P<bad_routes>\d+)\s+'
2056    r'(?P<distance>\d+)\s+(?P<last_update>\S+)\s*$')
2057
2058
2059def parse_rip_routes(output: str) -> Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]]:
2060    """Parse ``show ip rip`` (the RIP table of ripd, not the kernel one).
2061
2062    Returns ``{prefix: [path, ...]}`` — one path per row, an ECMP route has several — with
2063    ``code`` (``'R'`` RIP, ``'C'`` connected, ``'S'`` static, ``'K'`` kernel...), ``sub_code``
2064    (:data:`RIP_SUB_CODES`: ``'n'`` learned from a neighbour, ``'i'`` interface, ``'r'``
2065    redistributed, ``'d'`` default, ``'s'`` static RIP route), ``nexthop`` (``None`` for a local
2066    route), ``metric``, ``source`` (the neighbour the route was learned from, ``None`` for the
2067    router's own routes), ``external`` (``'static:20'`` of ``self (static:20)``), ``tag`` and
2068    ``time`` (the timeout or garbage-collection timer, ``None`` when the route has none).
2069    ``{}`` when ripd has no instance (``% RIP instance not found``) or on the placeholder.
2070    """
2071    result: Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]] = {}
2072    for line in (output or '').splitlines():
2073        m = _RIP_ROUTE_RE.match(line)
2074        if not m:
2075            continue
2076        nexthop = m.group('nexthop')
2077        source = m.group('source')
2078        result.setdefault(m.group('prefix'), []).append({
2079            'code': m.group('code'),
2080            'sub_code': m.group('sub'),
2081            'nexthop': None if nexthop == '0.0.0.0' else nexthop,
2082            'metric': int(m.group('metric')),
2083            'source': None if source.startswith('self') else source,
2084            'external': m.group('external'),
2085            'tag': int(m.group('tag')),
2086            'time': m.group('time'),
2087        })
2088    return result
2089
2090
2091def get_rip_routes(grade: Grade0, machine_name: str, step: int = 1,
2092                   allow_error: bool = False) -> Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]]:
2093    """Run 'vtysh -c "show ip rip"' and parse it (see :func:`parse_rip_routes`). ``{}`` on error."""
2094    output, code = _test(grade, machine_name, 'vtysh -c "show ip rip"', step, allow_error)
2095    if code != 0 or not output:
2096        return {}
2097    return parse_rip_routes(output)
2098
2099
2100def rip_route_metric(routes: Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]], prefix, learned: bool = None) -> Optional[int]:
2101    """Smallest metric of *prefix* in a :func:`parse_rip_routes` result, ``None`` when the prefix
2102    is absent.  ``learned=True`` only looks at the paths learned from a neighbour (code ``R``,
2103    sub-code ``n``), ``learned=False`` at the router's own ones (interface, redistributed...)."""
2104    metrics = [p['metric'] for p in routes.get(str(prefix), [])
2105               if learned is None or learned == (p['source'] is not None)]
2106    return min(metrics) if metrics else None
2107
2108
2109def rip_route_sources(routes: Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]], prefix) -> List[str]:
2110    """Neighbours *prefix* was learned from in a :func:`parse_rip_routes` result (reachable
2111    paths only: a route in garbage collection, metric 16, is left out)."""
2112    return [p['source'] for p in routes.get(str(prefix), [])
2113            if p['source'] is not None and p['metric'] < RIP_INFINITY]
2114

2116def parse_rip_status(output: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
2117    """Parse ``show ip rip status``.
2118
2119    Returns ``{'update', 'timeout', 'garbage'}`` (the three timers of ``timers basic``, seconds),
2120    ``default_metric``, ``redistribute`` (``['connected', 'static']``), ``send_version`` /
2121    ``receive_version`` (``'1'``, ``'2'``, ``'1 2'``), ``interfaces`` (``{name: {'send',
2122    'receive', 'key_chain'}}``: the interfaces RIP runs on, passive ones included), ``networks``
2123    (the ``network`` statements: prefixes and interface names, then the ``neighbor`` addresses),
2124    ``passive_interfaces``, ``sources`` (``{gateway: {'bad_packets', 'bad_routes', 'distance',
2125    'last_update'}}``: every neighbour a packet was received from) and ``distance``.
2126    ``{}`` when ripd has no instance or on the placeholder.
2127    """
2128    text = output or ''
2129    if 'Routing Protocol is "rip"' not in text:
2130        return {}
2131    status: Dict[str, Any] = {
2132        'update': None, 'timeout': None, 'garbage': None, 'default_metric': None, 'redistribute': [],
2133        'send_version': None, 'receive_version': None, 'interfaces': {}, 'networks': [],
2134        'passive_interfaces': [], 'sources': {}, 'distance': None,
2135    }
2136    section = None
2137    for line in text.splitlines():
2138        stripped = line.strip()
2139        if not stripped:
2140            continue
2141        m = re.match(r'Sending updates every (\d+) seconds', stripped)
2142        if m:
2143            status['update'] = int(m.group(1))
2144            continue
2145        m = re.match(r'Timeout after (\d+) seconds, garbage collect after (\d+) seconds', stripped)
2146        if m:
2147            status['timeout'], status['garbage'] = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))
2148            continue
2149        m = re.match(r'Default redistribution metric is (\d+)', stripped)
2150        if m:
2151            status['default_metric'] = int(m.group(1))
2152            continue
2153        if stripped.startswith('Redistributing:'):
2154            status['redistribute'] = stripped[len('Redistributing:'):].split()
2155            continue
2156        m = re.match(r'Default version control: send version (.+?), receive (any version|version (.+?))\s*$',
2157                     stripped)
2158        if m:
2159            status['send_version'] = m.group(1).strip()
2160            status['receive_version'] = '1 2' if m.group(2) == 'any version' else m.group(3).strip()
2161            continue
2162        m = re.match(r'Distance: \(default is (\d+)\)', stripped)
2163        if m:
2164            status['distance'] = int(m.group(1))
2165            section = None
2166            continue
2167        if re.match(r'Interface\s+Send\s+Recv', stripped):
2168            section = 'interfaces'
2169            continue
2170        if stripped == 'Routing for Networks:':
2171            section = 'networks'
2172            continue
2173        if stripped == 'Passive Interface(s):':
2174            section = 'passive'
2175            continue
2176        if stripped == 'Routing Information Sources:':
2177            section = 'sources'
2178            continue
2179        if section == 'interfaces':
2180            m = _RIP_INTERFACE_RE.match(line)
2181            if m:
2182                status['interfaces'][m.group('name')] = {
2183                    'send': m.group('send'), 'receive': m.group('receive'), 'key_chain': m.group('key_chain')}
2184        elif section == 'networks':
2185            status['networks'].append(stripped)
2186        elif section == 'passive':
2187            status['passive_interfaces'].append(stripped)
2188        elif section == 'sources':
2189            m = _RIP_SOURCE_RE.match(line)
2190            if m:
2191                status['sources'][m.group('gateway')] = {
2192                    'bad_packets': int(m.group('bad_packets')), 'bad_routes': int(m.group('bad_routes')),
2193                    'distance': int(m.group('distance')), 'last_update': m.group('last_update')}
2194    return status
2195
2196
2197def get_rip_status(grade: Grade0, machine_name: str, step: int = 1, allow_error: bool = False) -> Dict[str, Any]:
2198    """Run 'vtysh -c "show ip rip status"' and parse it (see :func:`parse_rip_status`).
2199    ``{}`` on error or when RIP is not configured."""
2200    output, code = _test(grade, machine_name, 'vtysh -c "show ip rip status"', step, allow_error)
2201    if code != 0 or not output:
2202        return {}
2203    return parse_rip_status(output)

2206# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
2207# PIM, IGMP, MSDP (pimd) and PIMv6, MLD (pim6d): json output of vtysh
2208# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
2209#
2210# Shapes of FRR 9.1.3 (fixtures tests/mock_data/frr/pim_*.json, captured in the multicast lab).
2211# pimd adds a `pimreg` interface (`pim6reg` for pim6d), left out of every result.  Without
2212# `ip pim` / `ip igmp` anywhere, the show commands print `{}` (exit 0).
2213
2214PIM_REGISTER_INTERFACES = ('pimreg', 'pim6reg')
2215
2216
2217def _str_or_none(value) -> Optional[str]:
2218    return None if value in (None, '', '-', '*') else str(value)
2219
2220
2221def _bool(value) -> bool:
2222    if isinstance(value, str):
2223        return value.strip().lower() in ('true', 'yes', 'local', '1')
2224    return bool(value)
2225
2226
2227def _vrf_default(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
2228    """Some pim6d outputs are wrapped in ``{"default": {...}}`` (the VRF): unwrap it."""
2229    if isinstance(data, dict) and set(data) == {'default'} and isinstance(data['default'], dict):
2230        return data['default']
2231    return data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}

2234def parse_pim_interfaces(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
2235    """``show ip pim interface json`` (or ``show ipv6 pim interface json``) → ``{ifname:
2236    {'address', 'up', 'neighbors' (count), 'dr' (address of the designated router), 'dr_local'}}``
2237    for every interface PIM is enabled on (the register interface left out)."""
2238    result = {}
2239    for ifname, entry in _vrf_default(data).items():
2240        if ifname in PIM_REGISTER_INTERFACES or not isinstance(entry, dict):
2241            continue
2242        result[ifname] = {
2243            'address': _str_or_none(entry.get('address')), 'up': entry.get('state') == 'up',
2244            'neighbors': _int_or_none(entry.get('pimNeighbors')) or 0,
2245            'dr': _str_or_none(entry.get('pimDesignatedRouter')), 'dr_local': _bool(entry.get('pimDesignatedRouterLocal')),
2246        }
2247    return result
2248

2251                       ipv6: bool = False) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
2252    family = 'ipv6' if ipv6 else 'ip'
2253    return parse_pim_interfaces(_vtysh_json(grade, machine_name, f"show {family} pim interface", step, allow_error))

2256def parse_pim_neighbors(data: Any) -> Dict[str, List[str]]:
2257    """``show ip pim neighbor json`` (or the ipv6 one) → ``{ifname: [neighbor addresses]}``
2258    (interfaces without neighbour left out; IPv6 neighbours are link-local addresses)."""
2259    result = {}
2260    for ifname, neighbors in _vrf_default(data).items():
2261        if ifname in PIM_REGISTER_INTERFACES or not isinstance(neighbors, dict):
2262            continue
2263        addresses = []
2264        for key, entry in neighbors.items():
2265            address = entry.get('neighbor', key) if isinstance(entry, dict) else key
2266            if address:
2267                addresses.append(str(address))
2268        if addresses:
2269            result[ifname] = sorted(addresses)
2270    return result

2293            result.append({'rp': str(entry.get('rpAddress', rp)), 'group': _str_or_none(entry.get('group')),

2305def rp_for_group(rp_info: List[Dict[str, Any]], group) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
2306    """The entry of *rp_info* whose range holds *group* with the longest prefix (``None``)."""
2307    try:
2308        address = ip_address(str(group))
2309    except ValueError:
2310        return None
2311    best, best_len = None, -1
2312    for entry in rp_info:
2313        try:
2314            network = ip_network(entry['group'] or '', strict=False)
2315        except ValueError:
2316            continue
2317        if network.version == address.version and address in network and network.prefixlen > best_len:
2318            best, best_len = entry, network.prefixlen
2319    return best

2332def parse_mroutes(data: Any) -> Dict[tuple, Dict[str, Any]]:

2345                'oil': sorted(str(name) for name in oil if name not in PIM_REGISTER_INTERFACES)
2346                if isinstance(oil, dict) else [],
2347                'flags': str(entry.get('flags') or ''), 'installed': _bool(entry.get('installed')),
2348            }

2370                'iif': _str_or_none(entry.get('inboundInterface')),

2379
2380def _seconds(value) -> Optional[float]:
2381    """Seconds of ``"00:02:05"`` / ``"00:00:29.743"`` / a number of seconds."""
2382    if value is None:
2383        return None
2384    if isinstance(value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool):
2385        return float(value)
2386    parts = str(value).strip().split(':')
2387    try:
2388        total = 0.0
2389        for part in parts:
2390            total = total * 60 + float(part)
2391        return total
2392    except ValueError:
2393        return None
2394
2395
2396def parse_igmp_interfaces(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
2397    """``show ip igmp interface [detail] json`` (or ``show ipv6 mld interface json``) →
2398    ``{ifname: {'address', 'up', 'version', 'querier' (this router is the querier),
2399    'querier_ip', 'query_interval' (s), 'query_response_interval' (s), 'last_member_interval'
2400    (s), 'last_member_count', 'robustness', 'mtrace_only'}}``.  The timers come from the
2401    ``detail`` form (``None`` in the short one); an interface with ``mtraceOnly`` has PIM but no
2402    ``ip igmp``."""
2403    result = {}
2404    for ifname, entry in _vrf_default(data).items():
2405        if not isinstance(entry, dict) or 'name' not in entry:
2406            continue
2407        querier = entry.get('querier')
2408        query_interval = entry.get('timerQueryInterval')
2409        if query_interval is None and entry.get('timerQueryIntervalMsec') is not None:
2410            query_interval = (_int_or_none(entry.get('timerQueryIntervalMsec')) or 0) / 1000
2411        response = entry.get('timerQueryResponseIntervalMsec', entry.get('timerQueryResponseTimerMsec'))
2412        last_member = entry.get('timerLastMemberQueryMsec', entry.get('timerLastMemberQueryIntervalMsec'))
2413        result[ifname] = {
2414            'address': _str_or_none(entry.get('address')), 'up': entry.get('state') == 'up',
2415            'version': _int_or_none(entry.get('version')),
2416            'querier': querier is True or str(querier).lower() in ('local', 'true'),
2417            'querier_ip': _str_or_none(entry.get('querierIp')),
2418            'query_interval': None if query_interval is None else float(query_interval),
2419            'query_response_interval': None if response is None else (_int_or_none(response) or 0) / 1000,
2420            'last_member_interval': None if last_member is None else (_int_or_none(last_member) or 0) / 1000,
2421            'last_member_count': _int_or_none(entry.get('lastMemberQueryCount')),
2422            'robustness': _int_or_none(entry.get('timerRobustnessVariable', entry.get('timerRobustnessValue'))),
2423            'mtrace_only': _bool(entry.get('mtraceOnly')),
2424        }
2425    return result
2426

2457                'sources_count': _int_or_none(g.get('sourcesCount')), 'uptime': _seconds(g.get('uptime')),
2458                'reporter': _str_or_none(g.get('source', g.get('lastReporter'))),
2459            }
2460    return result

2474    result: Dict[str, Dict[str, List[str]]] = {}

2476        if not isinstance(entry, dict):

2478        for group, g in entry.items():

2481            sources = [str(s.get('source')) for s in g['sources']
2482                       if isinstance(s, dict) and _str_or_none(s.get('source'))]
2483            if sources:
2484                result.setdefault(ifname, {})[str(g.get('group', group))] = sorted(sources)
2485    return result

2492def parse_msdp_peers(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
2493    """``show ip msdp peer json`` → ``{peer: {'state' (inactive / listen / connecting /
2494    established), 'established', 'local', 'sa_count'}}``."""
2495    result = {}
2496    for peer, entry in _vrf_default(data).items():
2497        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
2498            continue
2499        state = str(entry.get('state') or '').lower()
2500        result[str(entry.get('peer', peer))] = {'state': state, 'established': state == 'established',
2501                                                'local': _str_or_none(entry.get('local')),
2502                                                'sa_count': _int_or_none(entry.get('saCount')) or 0}
2503    return result
2504

2510def parse_msdp_sa(data: Any) -> Dict[tuple, Dict[str, Any]]:
2511    """``show ip msdp sa json`` → ``{(source, group): {'rp' (the RP that originated it), 'local'
2512    (originated by this router), 'spt' (an (S,G) join was sent)}}``."""
2513    result = {}

2520            result[(str(entry.get('source', source)), str(entry.get('group', group)))] = {
2521                'rp': _str_or_none(entry.get('rp')), 'local': _bool(entry.get('local')),
2522                'spt': _bool(entry.get('sptSetup')),
2523            }
2524    return result

2531# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
2532# OSPFv3 (ospf6d: json output, text of show ipv6 ospf6 border-routers)
2533# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
2534#
2535# Captured on FRR 9.1.3 (tests/mock_data/frr/ospf6_*).  Without ospf6d (or without
2536# ``router ospf6``) the json commands print nothing and exit 0: every parser then returns
2537# its empty shape.  The areas of ``show ipv6 ospf6 json`` are keyed as they were typed
2538# (``"0"``, ``"0.0.0.1"``): they are normalised to the dotted form here.
2539
2540#: ``pathType`` of ``show ipv6 ospf6 route json`` -> route type
2541OSPF6_PATH_TYPES = {'IA': 'intra-area', 'IE': 'inter-area', 'E1': 'external-1', 'E2': 'external-2'}
2542
2543
2544def parse_ospf6_info(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
2545    """Parse the JSON of ``show ipv6 ospf6``.
2546
2547    Returns ``{}`` when ospf6d does not answer, else::
2548
2549        {'router_id': '2.2.2.2',          # '0.0.0.0' when none could be chosen
2550         'abr': True,                     # interfaces attached to two areas or more
2551         'areas': {'0.0.0.1': {'stub': True, 'nssa': False, 'no_summary': False,
2552                               'interfaces': ['eth1'], 'lsa_count': 9}},
2553         'as_scoped_lsa_count': 4}
2554
2555    The json has no ABR / ASBR flag: ``abr`` is computed from the areas, and what the other
2556    routers see is in :func:`get_ospf6_border_routers`.
2557    """
2558    if not isinstance(data, dict) or 'routerId' not in data:
2559        return {}
2560    areas: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
2561    for key, a in (data.get('areas') or {}).items():
2562        if not isinstance(a, dict):
2563            continue
2564        areas[normalize_area(key)] = {
2565            'stub': bool(a.get('areaIsStub')),
2566            'nssa': bool(a.get('areaIsNSSA')),
2567            'no_summary': bool(a.get('areaNoSummary')),
2568            'interfaces': [str(i) for i in (a.get('interfacesAttachedToArea') or [])],
2569            'lsa_count': _int_or_none(a.get('numberOfAreaScopedLsa')),
2570        }
2571    return {
2572        'router_id': data.get('routerId'),
2573        'abr': sum(1 for a in areas.values() if a['interfaces']) >= 2,
2574        'areas': areas,
2575        'as_scoped_lsa_count': _int_or_none(data.get('numberOfAsScopedLsa')),
2576    }
2577
2578
2579def get_ospf6_info(grade: Grade0, machine_name: str, step: int = 1, allow_error: bool = False) -> Dict[str, Any]:
2580    """Run 'vtysh -c "show ipv6 ospf6 json"' (see :func:`parse_ospf6_info`)."""
2581    return parse_ospf6_info(_vtysh_json(grade, machine_name, 'show ipv6 ospf6', step, allow_error))

2584def parse_ospf6_neighbors(data: Any) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
2585    """Parse the JSON of ``show ipv6 ospf6 neighbor``: one dict per neighbour, with the keys
2586    of :func:`get_ospf_neighbors` (so :func:`find_neighbor` / :func:`neighbor_is_full` work)::
2587
2588        {'neighbor_id': '1.1.1.1', 'priority': 1, 'state': 'Full',   # Init, Twoway, ExStart...
2589         'role': 'BDR',                   # the neighbour's role on the link
2590         'dead_time': '00:00:37', 'up_time': '00:00:32', 'interface': 'eth0',
2591         'interface_state': 'DR',         # this router's role on the link
2592         'address': None, 'local_address': None}
2593
2594    OSPFv3 neighbours are named by router-id; their (link-local) address is not in the json.
2595    """
2596    if not isinstance(data, dict):
2597        return []
2598    result: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
2599    for n in data.get('neighbors') or []:
2600        if not isinstance(n, dict):
2601            continue
2602        result.append({
2603            'neighbor_id': n.get('neighborId'),
2604            'priority': _int_or_none(n.get('priority')),
2605            'state': n.get('state'),
2606            'role': n.get('ifState'),
2607            'dead_time': n.get('deadTime'),
2608            'up_time': n.get('duration'),
2609            'interface': n.get('interfaceName'),
2610            'interface_state': n.get('interfaceState'),
2611            'address': None,
2612            'local_address': None,
2613        })
2614    return result
2615
2616
2617def get_ospf6_neighbors(grade: Grade0, machine_name: str, step: int = 1,
2618                        allow_error: bool = False) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:

2620    return parse_ospf6_neighbors(_vtysh_json(grade, machine_name, 'show ipv6 ospf6 neighbor', step, allow_error))

2623def parse_ospf6_interfaces(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
2624    """Parse the JSON of ``show ipv6 ospf6 interface``.
2625
2626    Returns ``{ifname: {...}}`` for every interface ospf6d knows; ``enabled`` is false (and the
2627    other keys ``None``) for an interface not attached to an area::
2628
2629        {'enabled': True, 'area': '0.0.0.1', 'cost': 10, 'state': 'DR',  # PointToPoint, Waiting...
2630         'type': 'BROADCAST', 'passive': False, 'mtu': 1500, 'mtu_ignore': False,
2631         'priority': 1, 'hello_interval': 10, 'dead_interval': 40, 'dr': '3.3.3.3', 'bdr': '2.2.2.2',
2632         'addresses': ['fe80::53:52ff:fe48:ead/64', '3fff:550:5cfb:23::3/64'],
2633         'auth_type': 'NULL',             # 'manualkey' / 'keychain' with an authentication trailer
2634         'auth_rx_drops': None}
2635    """
2636    if not isinstance(data, dict):
2637        return {}
2638    result: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
2639    for ifname, e in data.items():
2640        if not isinstance(e, dict):
2641            continue
2642        enabled = bool(e.get('attachedToArea'))
2643        auth = e.get('authInfo') if isinstance(e.get('authInfo'), dict) else {}
2644        detection = e.get('mtuMismatchDetection')
2645        result[ifname] = {
2646            'enabled': enabled,
2647            'area': normalize_area(e['areaId']) if enabled and e.get('areaId') else None,
2648            'cost': _int_or_none(e.get('cost')),
2649            'state': e.get('ospf6InterfaceState'),
2650            'type': e.get('type'),
2651            'passive': bool(e.get('timerPassiveIface')) if enabled else None,
2652            'mtu': _int_or_none(e.get('interfaceMtu')),
2653            'mtu_ignore': (detection != 'enabled') if detection is not None else None,
2654            'priority': _int_or_none(e.get('priority')),
2655            'hello_interval': _int_or_none(e.get('timerIntervalsConfigHello')),
2656            'dead_interval': _int_or_none(e.get('timerIntervalsConfigDead')),
2657            'dr': e.get('dr'),
2658            'bdr': e.get('bdr'),
2659            'addresses': [a.get('address') for a in (e.get('internetAddress') or [])
2660                          if isinstance(a, dict) and a.get('address')],
2661            'auth_type': auth.get('authType'),
2662            'auth_rx_drops': _int_or_none(auth.get('rxPktDrop')),
2663        }
2664    return result
2665
2666
2667def get_ospf6_interfaces(grade: Grade0, machine_name: str, step: int = 1,
2668                         allow_error: bool = False) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
2669    """Run 'vtysh -c "show ipv6 ospf6 interface json"' (see :func:`parse_ospf6_interfaces`)."""
2670    return parse_ospf6_interfaces(_vtysh_json(grade, machine_name, 'show ipv6 ospf6 interface', step, allow_error))

2673def parse_ospf6_routes(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
2674    """Parse the JSON of ``show ipv6 ospf6 route``.
2675
2676    Returns ``{prefix: {'type': 'intra-area' | 'inter-area' | 'external-1' | 'external-2',
2677    'code': 'IA' | 'IE' | 'E1' | 'E2', 'best': bool, 'nexthops': [(nexthop | None, ifname)]}}``;
2678    a directly connected network has the next hop ``None`` (``::`` in the json).  The default
2679    route a stub area receives from its ABR is ``'::/0'`` of type ``inter-area``.
2680    """
2681    if not isinstance(data, dict) or not isinstance(data.get('routes'), dict):
2682        return {}
2683    result: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
2684    for prefix, e in data['routes'].items():
2685        if not isinstance(e, dict):
2686            continue
2687        code = e.get('pathType')
2688        nexthops = []
2689        for n in e.get('nextHops') or []:
2690            if isinstance(n, dict):
2691                nh = n.get('nextHop')
2692                nexthops.append((None if nh in (None, '', '::') else nh, n.get('interfaceName')))
2693        result[prefix] = {
2694            'type': OSPF6_PATH_TYPES.get(code, code),
2695            'code': code,
2696            'best': bool(e.get('isBestRoute')),
2697            'nexthops': nexthops,
2698        }
2699    return result
2700
2701
2702def get_ospf6_routes(grade: Grade0, machine_name: str, step: int = 1,
2703                     allow_error: bool = False) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
2704    """Run 'vtysh -c "show ipv6 ospf6 route json"' (see :func:`parse_ospf6_routes`)."""
2705    return parse_ospf6_routes(_vtysh_json(grade, machine_name, 'show ipv6 ospf6 route', step, allow_error))
2706
2707
2708_OSPF6_BORDER_ROUTER_RE = re.compile(r'^(\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3})\s+(\S{8})\s+\S+\s+(\S+)\s+(\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3})\s*$')
2709
2710
2711def parse_ospf6_border_routers(output: str) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
2712    """Parse the text of ``show ipv6 ospf6 border-routers`` (no json form in FRR 9.1)::
2713
2714        Router-ID       Rtr-Bits Options        Path-Type  Area
2715        1.1.1.1         ------E- --|-|--|-|-|--|R|-|--|E|V6 Intra-Area 0.0.0.0
2716        2.2.2.2         -------B --|-|--|-|-|--|R|-|--|E|V6 Intra-Area 0.0.0.0
2717
2718    Returns ``{router_id: {'abr': bool, 'asbr': bool, 'path_type': 'Intra-Area', 'areas':
2719    ['0.0.0.0', ...]}}`` (an ABR is listed once per area); ``{}`` without ospf6d
2720    (``% OSPFv3 instance not found``).  The router itself appears when it is a border router.
2721    """
2722    result: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
2723    for line in (output or '').splitlines():
2724        m = _OSPF6_BORDER_ROUTER_RE.match(line.strip())
2725        if not m:
2726            continue
2727        rid, bits, path_type, area = m.groups()
2728        entry = result.setdefault(rid, {'abr': False, 'asbr': False, 'path_type': path_type, 'areas': []})
2729        entry['abr'] = entry['abr'] or 'B' in bits
2730        entry['asbr'] = entry['asbr'] or 'E' in bits
2731        if area not in entry['areas']:
2732            entry['areas'].append(area)
2733    return result
2734
2735
2736def get_ospf6_border_routers(grade: Grade0, machine_name: str, step: int = 1,
2737                             allow_error: bool = False) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
2738    """Run 'vtysh -c "show ipv6 ospf6 border-routers"' (see :func:`parse_ospf6_border_routers`)."""
2739    output, code = _test(grade, machine_name, 'vtysh -c "show ipv6 ospf6 border-routers"', step, allow_error)
2740    if code != 0 or not output:
2741        return {}
2742    return parse_ospf6_border_routers(output)
2743

2745# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
2746# MPLS: LDP (ldpd), the label table of zebra, segment routing in OSPF, the RIB with labels
2747# (json output of FRR 10.3; fixtures ldp_*, mpls_table_*, ospf_sr_*, route_* captured in the
2748# MPLS lab).  The kernel side (net.mpls sysctls, ``ip -f mpls route``, MPLS counters) is
2749# read by lib/mpls.py.
2750# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
2751
2752#: label values of the reserved labels as ldpd and zebra write them
2753MPLS_IMPLICIT_NULL = 3
2754MPLS_EXPLICIT_NULL = 0
2755_LABEL_NAMES = {'imp-null': MPLS_IMPLICIT_NULL, 'implicit-null': MPLS_IMPLICIT_NULL,
2756                'exp-null': MPLS_EXPLICIT_NULL, 'explicit-null': MPLS_EXPLICIT_NULL}
2757
2758
2759def mpls_label_value(text) -> Optional[int]:
2760    """A label as ldpd / zebra print it (``"16"``, ``16``, ``"imp-null"``, ``"exp-null"``) → its
2761    value (``imp-null`` = 3, ``exp-null`` = 0); ``None`` for ``-`` or anything else."""
2762    if isinstance(text, int):
2763        return text
2764    word = str(text or '').strip().lower()
2765    if word in _LABEL_NAMES:
2766        return _LABEL_NAMES[word]
2767    return _int_or_none(word) if word.isdigit() else None
2768
2769
2770def parse_ldp_neighbors(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
2771    """``show mpls ldp neighbor json`` → ``{lsr_id: {'state': str, 'operational': bool,
2772    'transport_address': str | None, 'uptime': str | None}}`` (``{}`` without LDP)."""
2773    result: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
2774    for n in (data or {}).get('neighbors', []) if isinstance(data, dict) else []:
2775        if not isinstance(n, dict) or not n.get('neighborId'):
2776            continue
2777        state = str(n.get('state') or '')
2778        result[n['neighborId']] = {'state': state, 'operational': state.upper() == 'OPERATIONAL',
2779                                   'transport_address': n.get('transportAddress'), 'uptime': n.get('upTime')}
2780    return result

2811def parse_ldp_bindings(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
2812    """``show mpls ldp binding json`` (the LIB) → ``{prefix: {'local': int | None, 'remote':
2813    {lsr_id: int | None}, 'in_use': lsr_id | None}}``; labels are values (``imp-null`` = 3,
2814    ``exp-null`` = 0), ``in_use`` the neighbour whose label the router forwards with."""
2815    result: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
2816    for b in (data or {}).get('bindings', []) if isinstance(data, dict) else []:
2817        if not isinstance(b, dict) or not b.get('prefix'):
2818            continue
2819        entry = result.setdefault(b['prefix'], {'local': None, 'remote': {}, 'in_use': None})
2820        entry['local'] = mpls_label_value(b.get('localLabel'))
2821        if b.get('neighborId'):
2822            entry['remote'][b['neighborId']] = mpls_label_value(b.get('remoteLabel'))
2823            if b.get('inUse'):
2824                entry['in_use'] = b['neighborId']
2825    return result

2834def parse_mpls_table(data: Any) -> Dict[int, Dict[str, Any]]:
2835    """``show mpls table json`` (zebra's label table, LDP / SR / static) → ``{in_label:
2836    {'installed': bool, 'nexthops': [{'type': 'LDP' | 'SR (OSPF)' | ..., 'out_labels': [int],
2837    'nexthop': str | None, 'interface': str | None, 'installed': bool}]}}``.  ``installed`` is
2838    zebra's view: the kernel may still have refused the label (``ip -f mpls route``)."""
2839    result: Dict[int, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
2840    for key, entry in (data or {}).items() if isinstance(data, dict) else []:
2841        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
2842            continue
2843        label = _int_or_none(entry.get('inLabel', key))
2844        if label is None:
2845            continue
2846        nexthops = []
2847        for n in entry.get('nexthops', []):
2848            if not isinstance(n, dict):
2849                continue
2850            stack = n.get('outLabelStack')
2851            if not isinstance(stack, list):
2852                stack = [n.get('outLabel')] if n.get('outLabel') is not None else []
2853            nexthops.append({'type': n.get('type'), 'out_labels': [x for x in map(mpls_label_value, stack) if x is not None],
2854                             'nexthop': n.get('nexthop'), 'interface': n.get('interface'),
2855                             'installed': bool(n.get('installed'))})
2856        result[label] = {'installed': bool(entry.get('installed')), 'nexthops': nexthops}
2857    return result
2858
2859
2860def get_mpls_table(grade: Grade0, machine_name: str, step: int = 1,
2861                   allow_error: bool = True) -> Dict[int, Dict[str, Any]]:
2862    """Zebra's label table of *machine_name* (see :func:`parse_mpls_table`)."""
2863    return parse_mpls_table(_vtysh_json(grade, machine_name, "show mpls table", step, allow_error))

2866def parse_ospf_sr_database(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
2867    """``show ip ospf database segment-routing json`` → ``{router_id: {'srgb': (base, size),
2868    'srlb': (base, size), 'prefixes': {prefix: {'index': int, 'input_label': int,
2869    'routes': [{'out_label': int, 'interface': str, 'nexthop': str}]}}}}`` (``{}`` when segment
2870    routing is disabled on the router: FRR answers with a text line).  ``input_label`` and
2871    ``routes`` are those of the router that answers, which also lists itself."""
2872    result: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
2873    for node in (data or {}).get('srNodes', []) if isinstance(data, dict) else []:
2874        if not isinstance(node, dict) or not node.get('routerID'):
2875            continue
2876        prefixes = {}
2877        for p in node.get('extendedPrefix', []):
2878            if not isinstance(p, dict) or not p.get('prefix'):
2879                continue
2880            routes = [{'out_label': mpls_label_value(r.get('outputLabel')), 'interface': r.get('interface'),
2881                       'nexthop': r.get('nexthop')} for r in p.get('prefixRoute', []) if isinstance(r, dict)]
2882            prefixes[p['prefix']] = {'index': _int_or_none(p.get('sid')),
2883                                     'input_label': _int_or_none(p.get('inputLabel')), 'routes': routes}
2884        result[node['routerID']] = {
2885            'srgb': (_int_or_none(node.get('srgbLabel')), _int_or_none(node.get('srgbSize'))),
2886            'srlb': (_int_or_none(node.get('srlbLabel')), _int_or_none(node.get('srlbSize'))),
2887            'prefixes': prefixes,
2888        }
2889    return result
2890
2891
2892def get_ospf_sr_database(grade: Grade0, machine_name: str, step: int = 1,
2893                         allow_error: bool = True) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:

2895    return parse_ospf_sr_database(_vtysh_json(grade, machine_name, "show ip ospf database segment-routing", step,
2896                                              allow_error))
