2904def parse_frr_routes(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
2905    """``show ip route [vrf X] json`` (zebra's RIB) → ``{prefix: {'protocol': str, 'selected':
2906    bool, 'installed': bool, 'metric': int | None, 'nexthops': [{'ip', 'interface', 'labels':
2907    [int], 'active', 'fib'}], 'backups': [same keys]}}``; ``backups`` are the backup next hops
2908    of a protected route (TI-LFA), which zebra keeps but does not install in the kernel.  Of
2909    several routes for a prefix the selected one wins (else the first)."""
2910    result: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
2911    for prefix, routes in (data or {}).items() if isinstance(data, dict) else []:
2912        if not isinstance(routes, list):
2913            continue
2914        candidates = [r for r in routes if isinstance(r, dict)]
2915        if not candidates:
2916            continue
2917        r = next((x for x in candidates if x.get('selected')), candidates[0])
2918        result[prefix] = {
2919            'protocol': r.get('protocol'), 'selected': bool(r.get('selected')), 'installed': bool(r.get('installed')),
2920            'metric': _int_or_none(r.get('metric')),
2921            'nexthops': [_route_nexthop(n) for n in r.get('nexthops', []) if isinstance(n, dict)],
2922            'backups': [_route_nexthop(n) for n in r.get('backupNexthops', []) if isinstance(n, dict)],
2923        }
2924    return result
2925
2926
2927def get_frr_routes(grade: Grade0, machine_name: str, vrf: str = None, step: int = 1,
2928                   allow_error: bool = True) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
2929    """Zebra's IPv4 RIB of *machine_name*, of the VRF *vrf* if given (see :func:`parse_frr_routes`)."""
2930    command = f"show ip route vrf {vrf}" if vrf else "show ip route"
2931    return parse_frr_routes(_vtysh_json(grade, machine_name, command, step, allow_error))
2932
2933
2934# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
2935# IS-IS (isisd) and BFD (bfdd), FRR 10.3 (fixtures isis_*, bfd_*, config_isis_* captured on Debian 13).
2936# ``show isis neighbor [detail] json`` keeps one adjacency per broadcast circuit (the others are
2937# lost), so the neighbours come from the text of ``show isis neighbor detail``; the interfaces,
2938# the link-state database and the routes from the json output.  Segment routing over IS-IS is
2939# read from the database (SRGB, prefix-SIDs) and from the label tables (MPLS section above).
2940# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
2941
2942#: kernel route protocol values that mean "installed by isisd"
2943ISIS_ROUTE_PROTOCOLS = ('isis', '187')
2944#: FRR defaults of an IS-IS interface: hello interval (s), hello multiplier, metric, priority
2945ISIS_DEFAULT_HELLO_INTERVAL = 3
2946ISIS_DEFAULT_HELLO_MULTIPLIER = 10
2947ISIS_DEFAULT_METRIC = 10
2948ISIS_DEFAULT_PRIORITY = 64
2949#: FRR's default SRGB (``segment-routing global-block`` is not shown when it has this value)
2950ISIS_DEFAULT_SRGB = (16000, 23999)
2951#: FRR defaults of a BFD session: detect multiplier, receive and transmit intervals (ms)
2952BFD_DEFAULT_DETECT_MULTIPLIER = 3
2953BFD_DEFAULT_INTERVAL = 300
2954
2955_SYSTEM_ID_RE = re.compile(r'^[0-9a-f]{4}\.[0-9a-f]{4}\.[0-9a-f]{4}$')
2956_NET_RE = re.compile(r'^(?P<area>[0-9a-f]{2}(?:\.[0-9a-f]{4}){0,6})\.(?P<sysid>[0-9a-f]{4}\.[0-9a-f]{4}\.[0-9a-f]{4})'
2957                     r'\.(?P<nsel>[0-9a-f]{2})$')
2958_LSP_ID_RE = re.compile(r'^(?P<node>.+)\.(?P<pseudonode>[0-9a-fA-F]{2})-(?P<fragment>[0-9a-fA-F]{2})$')
2959_ISIS_LEVEL_KEYS = {'level-1': 1, 'level-2': 2, 'level-2-only': 2, 'level-1-2': 3}
2960
2961
2962def is_isis_protocol(protocol) -> bool:
2963    """True when a kernel route ``protocol`` field (``ip -j route``) denotes an IS-IS route."""
2964    return str(protocol) in ISIS_ROUTE_PROTOCOLS
2965
2966
2967def isis_system_id_from_ipv4(address) -> str:
2968    """The system-id made from an IPv4 address by the usual convention: each byte on three
2969    decimal digits, the twelve digits grouped by four (``10.0.31.2`` → ``0100.0003.1002``)."""
2970    digits = "".join(f"{int(b):03d}" for b in str(ip_address(str(address).split('/')[0])).split('.'))
2971    return f"{digits[0:4]}.{digits[4:8]}.{digits[8:12]}"
2972
2973
2974def isis_net(area: str, system_id: str, nsel: str = '00') -> str:
2975    """The NET of a router: ``isis_net('49.0001', '0100.0003.1002')`` → ``49.0001.0100.0003.1002.00``."""
2976    return f"{area}.{system_id}.{nsel}"
2977
2978
2979def parse_isis_net(net) -> Optional[Dict[str, str]]:
2980    """``'49.0001.0100.0003.1002.00'`` → ``{'area': '49.0001', 'system_id': '0100.0003.1002',
2981    'nsel': '00'}`` (lower case); ``None`` when *net* is not a NET."""
2982    m = _NET_RE.match(str(net or '').strip().lower())
2983    if not m:
2984        return None
2985    return {'area': m.group('area'), 'system_id': m.group('sysid'), 'nsel': m.group('nsel')}
2986
2987
2988def normalize_system_id(text) -> Optional[str]:
2989    """A system-id as typed (``0100.0003.1002``, ``010000031002``, upper case) in FRR's form, or
2990    ``None``."""
2991    word = str(text or '').strip().lower().replace('.', '')
2992    if len(word) != 12 or any(c not in '0123456789abcdef' for c in word):
2993        return None
2994    return f"{word[0:4]}.{word[4:8]}.{word[8:12]}"
2995
2996
2997def _isis_level(text) -> Optional[int]:
2998    """``'1'`` / ``'L1'`` → 1, ``'2'`` / ``'L2'`` → 2, ``'3'`` / ``'L1L2'`` → 3 (both levels)."""
2999    word = str(text or '').strip().upper()
3000    return {'1': 1, 'L1': 1, '2': 2, 'L2': 2, '3': 3, 'L1L2': 3}.get(word)
3001
3002
3003def _level_matches(level: Optional[int], wanted: Optional[int]) -> bool:
3004    """True when an adjacency / circuit of *level* (1, 2 or 3 = both) covers *wanted*
3005    (``None``: any level; 3: both levels required)."""
3006    if level is None:
3007        return False
3008    if wanted is None:
3009        return True
3010    return (level & wanted) == wanted
3011
3012
3013_NEIGHBOR_TABLE_RE = re.compile(r'^\s(?P<name>\S+)\s+(?P<ifname>\S+)\s+(?P<level>[123])\s+(?P<state>\S+)\s+'
3014                                r'(?P<hold>\d+)\s+(?P<snpa>\S+)\s*$')
3015_NEIGHBOR_ITEM_RE = re.compile(r'Interface:\s*(?P<ifname>[^,]+),\s*Level:\s*(?P<level>\d),\s*State:\s*(?P<state>[^,]+)'
3016                               r'(?:,\s*Expires in\s*(?P<hold>\d+)s)?')
3017
3018
3019def parse_isis_neighbors(output: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
3020    """Parse ``show isis neighbor detail`` (or the plain ``show isis neighbor`` table).
3021
3022    Returns one dict per adjacency (a broadcast circuit lists one per neighbour and level):
3023    ``{'name': hostname or system-id, 'interface': str, 'level': 1 | 2 | 3 (both), 'state': 'Up' |
3024    'Initializing' | 'Down', 'up': bool, 'holdtime': int | None, 'snpa': str | None, and, from the
3025    detail form only: 'circuit_type': 'L1' | 'L2' | 'L1L2' | None, 'speaks': ['IPv4', 'IPv6'],
3026    'topologies': [str], 'lan_id': str | None, 'priority': int | None, 'is_dis': bool | None,
3027    'areas': [str], 'ipv4': [str], 'ipv6': [str] (link-local), 'ipv6_global': [str],
3028    'bfd': 'Up' | 'Down' | ... | None}``.  ``[]`` on an empty or placeholder output.
3029    """
3030    result: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
3031    lines = (output or '').splitlines()
3032    if any(_NEIGHBOR_TABLE_RE.match(line) for line in lines) and not any('Interface:' in line for line in lines):
3033        for line in lines:
3034            m = _NEIGHBOR_TABLE_RE.match(line)
3035            if m and m.group('name') != 'System':
3036                state = m.group('state')
3037                result.append({'name': m.group('name'), 'interface': m.group('ifname'),
3038                               'level': int(m.group('level')), 'state': state, 'up': state == 'Up',
3039                               'holdtime': int(m.group('hold')), 'snpa': m.group('snpa')})
3040        return result
3041
3042    current: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
3043    pending_name: Optional[str] = None
3044    list_key: Optional[str] = None
3045    lists = {'Area Address(es):': 'areas', 'IPv4 Address(es):': 'ipv4', 'IPv6 Address(es):': 'ipv6',
3046             'Global IPv6 Address(es):': 'ipv6_global', 'Topologies:': 'topologies'}
3047    for raw in lines:
3048        stripped = raw.strip()
3049        indent = len(raw) - len(raw.lstrip())
3050        if not stripped or indent == 0 and stripped.startswith('Area ') and stripped.endswith(':'):
3051            list_key = None
3052            continue
3053        if indent <= 2 and ' ' not in stripped:
3054            pending_name, current, list_key = stripped, None, None
3055            continue
3056        m = _NEIGHBOR_ITEM_RE.search(stripped)
3057        if m and pending_name:
3058            state = m.group('state').strip()
3059            current = {'name': pending_name, 'interface': m.group('ifname').strip(),
3060                       'level': int(m.group('level')), 'state': state, 'up': state == 'Up',
3061                       'holdtime': _int_or_none(m.group('hold')), 'snpa': None, 'circuit_type': None,
3062                       'speaks': [], 'topologies': [], 'lan_id': None, 'priority': None, 'is_dis': None,
3063                       'areas': [], 'ipv4': [], 'ipv6': [], 'ipv6_global': [], 'bfd': None}
3064            result.append(current)
3065            list_key = None
3066            continue
3067        if current is None:
3068            continue
3069        if stripped in lists:
3070            list_key = lists[stripped]
3071            continue
3072        if stripped.startswith('Circuit type:'):
3073            list_key = None
3074            ct, _, speaks = stripped.partition(',')
3075            current['circuit_type'] = ct.split(':', 1)[1].strip()
3076            if 'Speaks:' in speaks:
3077                current['speaks'] = [s.strip() for s in speaks.split(':', 1)[1].split(',') if s.strip()]
3078        elif stripped.startswith('SNPA:'):
3079            list_key = None
3080            snpa, _, lan = stripped.partition(',')
3081            current['snpa'] = snpa.split(':', 1)[1].strip()
3082            if 'LAN id:' in lan:
3083                current['lan_id'] = lan.split(':', 1)[1].strip()
3084        elif stripped.startswith('LAN Priority:'):
3085            list_key = None
3086            parts = [p.strip() for p in stripped.split(',')]
3087            current['priority'] = _int_or_none(parts[0].split(':', 1)[1])
3088            current['is_dis'] = any(p == 'is DIS' for p in parts)
3089        elif stripped.startswith('BFD is'):
3090            list_key = None
3091            m = re.search(r'status\s+(\S+)', stripped)
3092            current['bfd'] = m.group(1) if m else stripped
3093        elif list_key and indent >= 6:
3094            # the items of a list (areas, addresses, topologies) are the lines indented by six
3095            current[list_key].append(stripped)
3096        else:
3097            list_key = None
3098    return result
3099
3100
3101def get_isis_neighbors(grade: Grade0, machine_name: str, step: int = 1,
3102                       allow_error: bool = True) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
3103    """The IS-IS adjacencies of *machine_name* (``show isis neighbor detail``, see
3104    :func:`parse_isis_neighbors`)."""
3105    output, code = _test(grade, machine_name, 'vtysh -c "show isis neighbor detail"', step, allow_error)
3106    return parse_isis_neighbors(output) if code == 0 else []
3107
3108
3109def isis_adjacencies(neighbors: List[Dict[str, Any]], name=None, interface: str = None,
3110                     level: int = None, up: bool = True) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
3111    """The adjacencies of :func:`parse_isis_neighbors` with neighbour *name* (its hostname or its
3112    system-id), on *interface*, covering *level* (1, 2, or 3 for both), Up unless ``up=False``."""
3113    names = {str(n) for n in (name if isinstance(name, (list, tuple, set)) else [name]) if n is not None}
3114    result = []
3115    for n in neighbors:
3116        if names and n.get('name') not in names:
3117            continue
3118        if interface is not None and n.get('interface') != interface:
3119            continue
3120        if up and not n.get('up'):
3121            continue
3122        result.append(n)
3123    if level is None:
3124        return result
3125    # a broadcast circuit lists one adjacency per level: combine them before testing *level*
3126    by_key: Dict[tuple, int] = {}
3127    for n in result:
3128        key = (n.get('name'), n.get('interface'))
3129        by_key[key] = by_key.get(key, 0) | (n.get('level') or 0)
3130    return [n for n in result if _level_matches(by_key[(n.get('name'), n.get('interface'))], level)]
3131
3132
3133def isis_adjacency_up(neighbors: List[Dict[str, Any]], name=None, interface: str = None,
3134                      level: int = None) -> bool:
3135    """True when :func:`isis_adjacencies` finds an Up adjacency (see there for the filters)."""
3136    return bool(isis_adjacencies(neighbors, name=name, interface=interface, level=level))
3137
3138
3139def isis_adjacency_levels(neighbors: List[Dict[str, Any]], name=None, interface: str = None) -> int:
3140    """The levels of the Up adjacencies with *name* (on *interface*): 0, 1, 2 or 3 (both)."""
3141    levels = 0
3142    for n in isis_adjacencies(neighbors, name=name, interface=interface):
3143        levels |= n.get('level') or 0
3144    return levels
3145

3147def _json_with_duplicates(output: str) -> Any:
3148    """Decode FRR json in which an object may repeat a key (several area addresses, several
3149    prefixes of an interface): a repeated key holds the list of its values."""
3150    def hook(pairs):
3151        obj: Dict[str, Any] = {}
3152        for key, value in pairs:
3153            if key in obj:
3154                if not isinstance(obj[key], list) or not getattr(obj[key], '_dup', False):
3155                    obj[key] = _DupList([obj[key]])
3156                obj[key].append(value)
3157            else:
3158                obj[key] = value
3159        return obj
3160    start = min([i for i in (output.find('{'), output.find('[')) if i >= 0], default=-1)
3161    if start < 0:
3162        return None
3163    try:
3164        return json.loads(output[start:], object_pairs_hook=hook)
3165    except (ValueError, TypeError):
3166        return None
3167
3168
3169class _DupList(list):
3170    """The values of a key repeated in a json object (see :func:`_json_with_duplicates`)."""
3171    _dup = True
3172
3173
3174def _as_list(value) -> List[Any]:
3175    if value is None:
3176        return []
3177    return list(value) if isinstance(value, list) else [value]
3178
3179
3180def _vtysh_json_any(grade: Grade0, machine_name: str, command: str, step: int, allow_error: bool) -> Any:
3181    """Run ``vtysh -c "<command> json"`` and decode it with :func:`_json_with_duplicates`
3182    (``None`` on an error, a placeholder or a text answer)."""
3183    output, code = _test(grade, machine_name, f'vtysh -c "{command} json"', step, allow_error)
3184    if code != 0 or not output:
3185        return None
3186    return _json_with_duplicates(output)
3187
3188
3189def _isis_circuits(data: Any) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
3190    circuits = []
3191    if isinstance(data, dict):
3192        for area in _as_list(data.get('areas')):
3193            if isinstance(area, dict):
3194                for c in _as_list(area.get('circuits')):
3195                    if isinstance(c, dict):
3196                        circuits.append((area.get('area'), c))
3197    return circuits
3198
3199
3200def parse_isis_interfaces(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
3201    """``show isis interface detail json`` → ``{ifname: {'area': str, 'state': str, 'passive': bool,
3202    'type': 'p2p' | 'lan' | 'loopback', 'level': 1 | 2 | 3, 'circuit_id': str, 'levels': {1 | 2:
3203    {'metric': int, 'hello_interval': int | None, 'hello_multiplier': int | None, 'padding': bool,
3204    'csnp_interval': int | None, 'neighbors': int | None, 'priority': int | None, 'is_dis': bool |
3205    None}}, 'ipv4': [prefix], 'ipv6': [prefix], 'ipv6_link_local': [prefix]}}``; ``{}`` when IS-IS
3206    does not run.  ``priority`` / ``is_dis`` are those of a broadcast circuit (``None`` on a point
3207    to point one)."""
3208    result: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
3209    for area, c in _isis_circuits(data):
3210        i = c.get('interface')
3211        if not isinstance(i, dict) or not i.get('name'):
3212            continue
3213        levels: Dict[int, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
3214        for lv in _as_list(i.get('levels')):
3215            if not isinstance(lv, dict):
3216                continue
3217            number = _isis_level(lv.get('level'))
3218            if number not in (1, 2):
3219                continue
3220            hold = lv.get('holddown') if isinstance(lv.get('holddown'), dict) else {}
3221            lan = lv.get('lan') if isinstance(lv.get('lan'), dict) else {}
3222            levels[number] = {
3223                'metric': _int_or_none(lv.get('metric')), 'hello_interval': _int_or_none(lv.get('hello-interval')),
3224                'hello_multiplier': _int_or_none(hold.get('count')), 'padding': hold.get('pad') == 'yes',
3225                'csnp_interval': _int_or_none(lv.get('cnsp-interval', lv.get('csnp-interval'))),
3226                'neighbors': _int_or_none(lv.get('active-neighbors')),
3227                'priority': _int_or_none(lan.get('priority')) if lan else None,
3228                'is_dis': (lan.get('is-dis') == 'yes') if lan else None,
3229            }
3230
3231        def prefixes(key, sub):
3232            value = i.get(key)
3233            if not isinstance(value, dict):
3234                return []
3235            return [str(x) for x in _as_list(value.get(sub))]
3236        result[i['name']] = {
3237            'area': area, 'state': i.get('state'), 'passive': i.get('is-passive') == 'passive',
3238            'type': i.get('type'), 'level': _isis_level(i.get('level')), 'circuit_id': i.get('circuit-id'),
3239            'levels': levels, 'ipv4': prefixes('ip-prefix', 'ip'), 'ipv6': prefixes('ipv6-prefixes', 'ipv6'),
3240            'ipv6_link_local': prefixes('ipv6-link-locals', 'ipv6'),
3241        }
3242    return result
3243
3244
3245def get_isis_interfaces(grade: Grade0, machine_name: str, step: int = 1,
3246                        allow_error: bool = True) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
3247    """The IS-IS circuits of *machine_name* (see :func:`parse_isis_interfaces`)."""
3248    return parse_isis_interfaces(_vtysh_json_any(grade, machine_name, "show isis interface detail", step,
3249                                                 allow_error))
3250
3251
3252def isis_lsp_node(lsp_id: str):
3253    """``'r3.4d-00'`` → ``('r3', '4d', '00')`` (node = hostname or system-id, pseudonode id,
3254    fragment); ``None`` when *lsp_id* is not an LSP-ID."""
3255    m = _LSP_ID_RE.match(str(lsp_id or ''))
3256    if not m:
3257        return None
3258    return m.group('node'), m.group('pseudonode').lower(), m.group('fragment').lower()
3259
3260
3261def _flags_att_p_ol(text) -> tuple:
3262    parts = str(text or '').split('/')
3263    if len(parts) != 3:
3264        return False, False, False
3265    return tuple(p.strip() == '1' for p in parts)
3266
3267
3268def _mt_name(entry: Dict[str, Any]) -> Optional[str]:
3269    """``None`` for the standard topology, ``'ipv6-unicast'`` for a multi-topology entry."""
3270    name = entry.get('mtName') or entry.get('mt-name')
3271    if name:
3272        return str(name)
3273    return None if str(entry.get('mtId', '')).lower() in ('', 'extended', 'standard') else str(entry.get('mtId'))
3274
3275
3276def parse_isis_database(data: Any) -> Dict[int, Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]]:
3277    """``show isis database detail json`` (or the plain form, with fewer keys) → ``{level: {lsp_id:
3278    {'node': hostname or system-id, 'pseudonode': bool, 'own': bool, 'seq': int | None,
3279    'holdtime': int | None, 'att': bool, 'p': bool, 'ol': bool, 'hostname': str | None, 'areas':
3280    [str], 'protocols': [str], 'topologies': [int], 'router_id': str | None, 'srgb': (base, size) |
3281    None, 'srlb': (base, size) | None, 'is_reach': [{'id': system-id.pseudonode, 'metric': int,
3282    'mt': None | 'ipv6-unicast', 'adj_sids': [int]}], 'ip_reach': [{'prefix', 'metric', 'down',
3283    'sid': {'index', 'no_php', 'explicit_null'} | None}], 'ipv6_reach': [{'prefix', 'metric', 'mt',
3284    'external', 'down'}]}}}``; ``{}`` when IS-IS does not run."""
3285    result: Dict[int, Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]] = {}
3286    if not isinstance(data, dict):
3287        return result
3288    for area in _as_list(data.get('areas')):
3289        if not isinstance(area, dict):
3290            continue
3291        for lv in _as_list(area.get('levels')):
3292            if not isinstance(lv, dict):
3293                continue
3294            level = _int_or_none(lv.get('id'))
3295            if level not in (1, 2):
3296                continue
3297            db = result.setdefault(level, {})
3298            for e in _as_list(lv.get('lsps')):
3299                if not isinstance(e, dict) or not isinstance(e.get('lsp'), dict):
3300                    continue
3301                lsp_id = e['lsp'].get('id')
3302                parts = isis_lsp_node(lsp_id)
3303                if not parts:
3304                    continue
3305                att, p, ol = _flags_att_p_ol(e.get('attPOl'))
3306                gb = e.get('segmentRoutingGb') if isinstance(e.get('segmentRoutingGb'), dict) else None
3307                lb = e.get('segmentRoutingLb') if isinstance(e.get('segmentRoutingLb'), dict) else None
3308                protocols = e.get('supportedProtocols')
3309                is_reach = []
3310                for r in _as_list(e.get('extReach')) + _as_list(e.get('isReach')):
3311                    if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get('id'):
3312                        is_reach.append({'id': str(r['id']), 'metric': _int_or_none(r.get('metric')), 'mt': _mt_name(r),
3313                                         'adj_sids': [_int_or_none(s.get('sid')) for s in _as_list(r.get('adjSid'))
3314                                                      if isinstance(s, dict)]})
3315                ip_reach = []
3316                for r in _as_list(e.get('extIpReach')) + _as_list(e.get('ipReach')):
3317                    if not isinstance(r, dict):
3318                        continue
3319                    prefix = r.get('ipReach') if isinstance(r.get('ipReach'), str) else r.get('prefix')
3320                    if not prefix:
3321                        continue
3322                    sid = None
3323                    subtlvs = r.get('subtlvs') if isinstance(r.get('subtlvs'), dict) else {}
3324                    for s in _as_list(subtlvs.get('sr')):
3325                        if isinstance(s, dict) and s.get('index') is not None:
3326                            flags = s.get('flags') if isinstance(s.get('flags'), dict) else {}
3327                            sid = {'index': _int_or_none(s.get('index')), 'no_php': bool(flags.get('noPHP')),
3328                                   'explicit_null': bool(flags.get('explicitNull'))}
3329                    ip_reach.append({'prefix': str(prefix), 'metric': _int_or_none(r.get('ipReachMetric', r.get('metric'))),
3330                                     'down': bool(r.get('down')), 'sid': sid})
3331                ipv6_reach = []
3332                for r in _as_list(e.get('ipv6Reach')):
3333                    if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get('prefix'):
3334                        ipv6_reach.append({'prefix': str(r['prefix']), 'metric': _int_or_none(r.get('metric')),
3335                                           'mt': _mt_name(r), 'external': bool(r.get('external')),
3336                                           'down': bool(r.get('down'))})
3337                db[lsp_id] = {
3338                    'node': parts[0], 'pseudonode': parts[1] != '00', 'own': bool(e['lsp'].get('ownLSP')),
3339                    'seq': int(e['seqNumber'], 16) if isinstance(e.get('seqNumber'), str)
3340                    and e['seqNumber'].startswith('0x') else _int_or_none(e.get('seqNumber')),
3341                    'holdtime': _int_or_none(e.get('holdtime')), 'att': att, 'p': p, 'ol': ol,
3342                    'hostname': e.get('hostname'), 'areas': [str(a) for a in _as_list(e.get('areaAddr'))],
3343                    'protocols': [str(v) for v in protocols.values()] if isinstance(protocols, dict) else [],
3344                    'topologies': [_int_or_none(t.get('mtid')) for t in _as_list(e.get('mt')) if isinstance(t, dict)],
3345                    'router_id': e.get('teRouterId'),
3346                    'srgb': (_int_or_none(gb.get('globalBlockBase')), _int_or_none(gb.get('globalBlockRange')))
3347                    if gb else None,
3348                    'srlb': (_int_or_none(lb.get('globalBlockBase')), _int_or_none(lb.get('globalBlockRange')))
3349                    if lb else None,
3350                    'is_reach': is_reach, 'ip_reach': ip_reach, 'ipv6_reach': ipv6_reach,
3351                }
3352    return result

3362def isis_lsps_of(database: Dict[int, Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]], level: int, node,
3363                 pseudonode: bool = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
3364    """The LSPs of *level* whose node is *node* (a hostname or a system-id, or a list of them);
3365    ``pseudonode=False`` keeps the router's own LSPs, ``True`` its pseudonode LSPs."""
3366    nodes = {str(n) for n in (node if isinstance(node, (list, tuple, set)) else [node])}
3367    return [lsp for lsp in (database.get(level) or {}).values()
3368            if lsp['node'] in nodes and (pseudonode is None or lsp['pseudonode'] == pseudonode)]

3371def parse_isis_routes(data: Any, ipv6: bool = False) -> Dict[int, Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]]:
3372    """``show isis route json`` → ``{level: {prefix: {'metric': int | None, 'nexthops': [(address |
3373    None, ifname | None)], 'labels': [str | None]}}}`` for IPv4, or IPv6 with ``ipv6=True``.  An
3374    ECMP route lists every next hop; the router's own prefixes have no next hop."""
3375    result: Dict[int, Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]] = {}
3376    family = 'ipv6' if ipv6 else 'ipv4'
3377    for area in _as_list(data):
3378        if not isinstance(area, dict):
3379            continue
3380        for key, level in (('level-1', 1), ('level-2', 2)):
3381            block = area.get(key)
3382            if not isinstance(block, dict):
3383                continue
3384            table = result.setdefault(level, {})
3385            for r in _as_list(block.get(family)):
3386                if not isinstance(r, dict) or not r.get('prefix'):
3387                    continue
3388                entry = table.setdefault(str(r['prefix']), {'metric': _int_or_none(r.get('metric')),
3389                                                            'nexthops': [], 'labels': []})
3390                hop = r.get('nextHop')
3391                ifname = r.get('interface')
3392                if hop and hop != '-':
3393                    entry['nexthops'].append((str(hop), ifname if ifname and ifname != '-' else None))
3394                    label = r.get('label(s)')
3395                    entry['labels'].append(None if label in (None, '-') else str(label))
3396    return result
3397
3398
3399def get_isis_routes(grade: Grade0, machine_name: str, step: int = 1, allow_error: bool = True,
3400                    ipv6: bool = False) -> Dict[int, Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]]:
3401    """The routes IS-IS computed on *machine_name*, per level (see :func:`parse_isis_routes`)."""
3402    return parse_isis_routes(_vtysh_json_any(grade, machine_name, "show isis route", step, allow_error),
3403                             ipv6=ipv6)

3406def parse_bfd_peers(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
3407    """``show bfd peers json`` → ``{peer address: {'status': 'up' | 'down' | 'init' | ...,
3408    'up': bool, 'local': str | None, 'interface': str | None, 'multihop': bool, 'receive_interval':
3409    int, 'transmit_interval': int, 'detect_multiplier': int, 'remote_receive_interval': int,
3410    'remote_transmit_interval': int, 'remote_detect_multiplier': int, 'uptime': int | None}}``
3411    (intervals in ms); ``{}`` without session."""
3412    result: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
3413    for p in _as_list(data):
3414        if not isinstance(p, dict) or not p.get('peer'):
3415            continue
3416        status = str(p.get('status') or '')
3417        result[str(p['peer'])] = {
3418            'status': status, 'up': status == 'up', 'local': p.get('local'), 'interface': p.get('interface'),
3419            'multihop': bool(p.get('multihop')),
3420            'receive_interval': _int_or_none(p.get('receive-interval')),
3421            'transmit_interval': _int_or_none(p.get('transmit-interval')),
3422            'detect_multiplier': _int_or_none(p.get('detect-multiplier')),
3423            'remote_receive_interval': _int_or_none(p.get('remote-receive-interval')),
3424            'remote_transmit_interval': _int_or_none(p.get('remote-transmit-interval')),
3425            'remote_detect_multiplier': _int_or_none(p.get('remote-detect-multiplier')),
3426            'uptime': _int_or_none(p.get('uptime')),
3427        }
3428    return result
3429

3432                  allow_error: bool = True) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:

3437def bfd_detection_time(peer: Dict[str, Any]) -> Optional[int]:
3438    """The detection time (ms) of the local end of a session of :func:`parse_bfd_peers`: the
3439    remote multiplier times the interval at which the packets really arrive (the larger of our
3440    receive interval and the peer's transmit interval)."""
3441    try:
3442        return peer['remote_detect_multiplier'] * max(peer['receive_interval'], peer['remote_transmit_interval'])
3443    except (KeyError, TypeError):
3444        return None

3463def _isis_level_key(words: List[str]) -> str:
3464    """``'level-1'`` / ``'level-2'`` when the statement names one, else ``'all'``."""
3465    for w in words:
3466        if w in ('level-1', 'level-2'):
3467            return w

3471def isis_interface_value(isis_cfg: Dict[str, Any], key: str, level: int):
3472    """The value of a per-level interface statement (``metric``, ``priority``,
3473    ``hello_interval``, ``hello_multiplier``) of *isis_cfg* for *level*: the level's own
3474    statement, else the statement for both levels, else ``None``."""
3475    values = isis_cfg.get(key) or {}

3478
3479def _parse_isis_interface_line(ic: Dict[str, Any], w: List[str], negated: bool) -> None:
3480    """``ip router isis X`` / ``ipv6 router isis X`` / ``isis <w...>`` of an interface block."""
3481    if w[:3] == ['ip', 'router', 'isis']:
3482        ic['ipv4'] = None if negated else (w[3] if len(w) >= 4 else '')
3483        return
3484    if w[:3] == ['ipv6', 'router', 'isis']:
3485        ic['ipv6'] = None if negated else (w[3] if len(w) >= 4 else '')
3486        return
3487    if not w or w[0] != 'isis' or len(w) < 2:
3488        return
3489    sub, args = w[1], w[2:]
3490    if sub == 'circuit-type':
3491        ic['circuit_type'] = None if negated or not args else args[0]
3492    elif sub == 'network':
3493        ic['network_type'] = None if negated or not args else args[0]
3494    elif sub == 'passive':
3495        ic['passive'] = not negated
3496    elif sub in ('metric', 'priority', 'hello-interval', 'hello-multiplier'):
3497        key = sub.replace('-', '_')
3498        level = _isis_level_key(args)
3499        if negated:
3500            ic[key].pop(level, None)
3501        elif args and args[0].isdigit():
3502            ic[key][level] = int(args[0])
3503    elif sub == 'password':
3504        ic['password'] = None if negated or len(args) < 2 else {'type': args[0], 'key': args[1]}
3505    elif sub == 'bfd':
3506        if args[:1] == ['profile']:
3507            ic['bfd_profile'] = None if negated or len(args) < 2 else args[1]
3508        else:
3509            ic['bfd'] = not negated
3510    elif sub == 'fast-reroute' and args[:1] == ['ti-lfa']:
3511        level = _isis_level_key(args)
3512        if negated:
3513            ic['fast_reroute'].pop(level, None)
3514        else:
3515            ic['fast_reroute'][level] = 'node' if 'node-protection' in args else 'link'
3516
3517
3518def _parse_router_isis_line(ri: Dict[str, Any], w: List[str]) -> None:
3519    """A statement of a ``router isis NAME`` block applied to *ri*."""
3520    negated = w[0] == 'no'
3521    if negated:
3522        w = w[1:]
3523    if not w:
3524        return
3525    kw = w[0]
3526    if kw == 'net' and len(w) >= 2:
3527        if negated:
3528            if w[1] in ri['nets']:
3529                ri['nets'].remove(w[1])
3530        elif w[1] not in ri['nets']:
3531            ri['nets'].append(w[1])
3532    elif kw == 'is-type':
3533        ri['is_type'] = None if negated or len(w) < 2 else w[1]
3534    elif kw == 'metric-style':
3535        ri['metric_style'] = None if negated or len(w) < 2 else w[1]
3536    elif kw == 'set-overload-bit':
3537        ri['overload'] = not negated
3538    elif kw in ('area-password', 'domain-password'):
3539        key = kw.replace('-', '_')
3540        ri[key] = None if negated or len(w) < 3 else {'type': w[1], 'key': w[2]}
3541    elif kw == 'redistribute' and len(w) >= 4:
3542        entry = (w[1], w[2], w[3])
3543        if negated:
3544            ri['redistribute'] = [r for r in ri['redistribute'] if r != entry]
3545        elif entry not in ri['redistribute']:
3546            ri['redistribute'].append(entry)
3547    elif w[:2] == ['default-information', 'originate'] and len(w) >= 4:
3548        if negated:
3549            ri['default_information'] = [d for d in ri['default_information']
3550                                         if (d['afi'], d['level']) != (w[2], w[3])]
3551        else:
3552            ri['default_information'].append({'afi': w[2], 'level': w[3], 'always': 'always' in w[4:]})
3553    elif kw == 'topology' and len(w) >= 2:
3554        if negated:
3555            if w[1] in ri['topologies']:
3556                ri['topologies'].remove(w[1])
3557        elif w[1] not in ri['topologies']:
3558            ri['topologies'].append(w[1])
3559    elif w[:2] == ['hostname', 'dynamic']:
3560        ri['hostname_dynamic'] = not negated
3561    elif kw == 'lsp-gen-interval':
3562        values = [int(x) for x in w[1:] if x.isdigit()]
3563        ri['lsp_gen_interval'] = None if negated or not values else values[-1]
3564    elif kw == 'log-adjacency-changes':
3565        ri['log_adjacency_changes'] = not negated
3566    elif kw == 'segment-routing' and len(w) >= 2:
3567        if negated and w[1] == 'on':
3568            ri['segment_routing']['enabled'] = False
3569        elif not negated:
3570            _parse_ospf_sr_line(ri['segment_routing'], w[1:])
3571
3572
3573def _parse_bfd_line(bfd: Dict[str, Any], profile: Optional[Dict[str, Any]], w: List[str]) -> None:
3574    """A statement of a ``profile NAME`` (or ``peer X``) block of ``bfd``."""
3575    if profile is None or not w:
3576        return
3577    if w[0] in ('detect-multiplier', 'receive-interval', 'transmit-interval', 'echo-interval',
3578                'echo-receive-interval', 'echo-transmit-interval') and len(w) >= 2 and w[1].isdigit():
3579        profile[w[0].replace('-', '_')] = int(w[1])
3580    elif w[0] == 'echo-mode':
3581        profile['echo_mode'] = True
3582    elif w[0] == 'passive-mode':
3583        profile['passive_mode'] = True
3584    elif w[0] == 'shutdown':
3585        profile['shutdown'] = True
3586
3587
3588def bfd_profile_value(profile: Optional[Dict[str, Any]], key: str):
3589    """A setting of a BFD profile of ``parse_frr_config(...)['bfd']['profiles']`` with FRR's
3590    default when the profile does not set it (``show running-config`` leaves the defaults out):
3591    ``detect_multiplier`` 3, ``receive_interval`` / ``transmit_interval`` 300 ms."""
3592    if profile is None:
3593        return None
3594    if profile.get(key) is not None:
3595        return profile[key]
3596    return {'detect_multiplier': BFD_DEFAULT_DETECT_MULTIPLIER, 'receive_interval': BFD_DEFAULT_INTERVAL,
3597            'transmit_interval': BFD_DEFAULT_INTERVAL}.get(key)

3600def isis_srgb(router_isis: Dict[str, Any]) -> Optional[tuple]:
3601    """The SRGB of ``parse_frr_config(...)['router_isis']``: the configured block, FRR's default
3602    (16000, 23999) when segment routing is on without ``global-block``, ``None`` when it is off."""
3603    sr = (router_isis or {}).get('segment_routing') or {}
3604    if not sr.get('enabled'):
3605        return None
3606    return sr.get('srgb') or ISIS_DEFAULT_SRGB

3609# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
3610# EVPN (bgpd l2vpn evpn family, zebra's VNI tables): the VXLAN / EVPN labs
3611# (lab/sre/_DRAFT_misc/vxlan-evpn.py, evpn-mpls.py; fixtures tests/mock_data/frr/*evpn*, captured on
3612# FRR 10.3 / Debian 13; facts in .claude/rules/lib-vxlan.md).  The kernel side is lib/vxlan.py.
3613# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
3614
3615_EVPN_TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r'\[([^\]]*)\]')
3616
3617
3618def get_bgp_evpn_summary(grade: Grade0, machine_name: str, step: int = 1, allow_error: bool = True) -> Dict[str, Any]:
3619    """The neighbours of the ``l2vpn evpn`` family (``show bgp l2vpn evpn summary json``, the shape
3620    of :func:`parse_bgp_summary`: ``policy_blocked`` for an eBGP neighbour without route-maps, RFC
3621    8212 applies to this family too); {} when no neighbour is active in it."""
3622    return parse_bgp_summary(_vtysh_json(grade, machine_name, 'show bgp l2vpn evpn summary', step, allow_error))
3623
3624
3625def parse_evpn_prefix(prefix: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
3626    """An EVPN prefix as bgpd prints it → its fields::
3627
3628        '[2]:[0]:[48]:[aa:bb:…]'                  → {'type': 2, 'eth_tag': 0, 'mac': 'aa:bb:…', 'ip': None}
3629        '[2]:[0]:[48]:[aa:bb:…]:[32]:[10.1.1.5]'  → {'type': 2, …, 'ip': '10.1.1.5'}
3630        '[3]:[0]:[32]:[10.255.0.11]'              → {'type': 3, 'eth_tag': 0, 'vtep': '10.255.0.11'}
3631        '[5]:[0]:[24]:[203.0.113.0]'              → {'type': 5, 'eth_tag': 0, 'network': '203.0.113.0/24'}
3632
3633    ``{}`` when the text is not an EVPN prefix; other route types keep ``type`` and ``fields``."""
3634    tokens = _EVPN_TOKEN_RE.findall(str(prefix or ''))
3635    if not tokens or not tokens[0].isdigit():
3636        return {}
3637    rtype = int(tokens[0])
3638    eth_tag = _int_or_none(tokens[1]) if len(tokens) > 1 else None
3639    if rtype == 2 and len(tokens) >= 4:
3640        return {'type': 2, 'eth_tag': eth_tag, 'mac': tokens[3].lower(),
3641                'ip': tokens[5] if len(tokens) >= 6 else None}
3642    if rtype == 3 and len(tokens) >= 4:
3643        return {'type': 3, 'eth_tag': eth_tag, 'vtep': tokens[3]}
3644    if rtype == 5 and len(tokens) >= 4:
3645        return {'type': 5, 'eth_tag': eth_tag, 'network': f"{tokens[3]}/{tokens[2]}"}
3646    return {'type': rtype, 'eth_tag': eth_tag, 'fields': tokens[1:]}
3647
3648
3649def _evpn_vnis(value) -> List[int]:
3650    return [int(x) for x in re.findall(r'\d+', str(value))] if value not in (None, '') else []
3651
3652
3653def _evpn_path(rd: str, prefix: str, entry: Dict[str, Any], path: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
3654    fields = parse_evpn_prefix(prefix)
3655    communities = str(((path.get('extendedCommunity') or {}).get('string')) or '').split()
3656    best = path.get('bestpath')
3657    nexthops = [n.get('ip') for n in (path.get('nexthops') or []) if isinstance(n, dict)]
3658    peer = path.get('peer') if isinstance(path.get('peer'), dict) else {}
3659    return {
3660        'rd': rd, 'prefix': prefix, 'type': fields.get('type'),
3661        'mac': fields.get('mac'), 'ip': fields.get('ip'), 'vtep': fields.get('vtep'), 'network': fields.get('network'),
3662        'vnis': _evpn_vnis(path.get('vni')),
3663        'rts': [c[3:] for c in communities if c.startswith('RT:')],
3664        'router_mac': next((c[5:].lower() for c in communities if c.startswith('Rmac:')), None),
3665        'nexthop': nexthops[0] if nexthops else None,
3666        'best': bool(best.get('overall')) if isinstance(best, dict) else bool(best),
3667        'valid': bool(path.get('valid')),
3668        'local': bool(path.get('local')) or path.get('peerId') == '(unspec)',
3669        'peer': peer.get('peerId') or path.get('peerId'),
3670        'pmsi': (path.get('pmsi') or {}).get('tunnelType'),
3671    }
3672
3673
3674def parse_bgp_evpn_routes(data: Any) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
3675    """Parse the JSON of ``show bgp l2vpn evpn route [detail]``: one dict per path::
3676
3677        {'rd': '10.255.0.12:3', 'type': 2 | 3 | 5, 'prefix': '[2]:[0]:[48]:[…]:[32]:[…]',
3678         'mac': str | None, 'ip': str | None,          # type 2 (ip only for a MAC+IP route)
3679         'vtep': str | None,                           # type 3: the originating VTEP
3680         'network': '203.0.113.0/24' | None,           # type 5
3681         'vnis': [200, 4000],     # detail form only: L2VNI, and the L3VNI of a MAC+IP route
3682         'rts': ['65000:200', '65000:4000'], 'router_mac': str | None,
3683         'nexthop': '10.255.0.12', 'best': bool, 'valid': bool,
3684         'local': bool,           # originated by this router
3685         'peer': '10.255.0.1', 'pmsi': 'Ingress Replication' | None}
3686
3687    ``[]`` when there is no route (or when bgpd printed its invalid JSON of a router without
3688    EVPN)."""
3689    routes: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
3690    if not isinstance(data, dict):
3691        return routes
3692    for rd, block in data.items():
3693        if not isinstance(block, dict):
3694            continue
3695        for prefix, entry in block.items():
3696            if not isinstance(entry, dict) or 'paths' not in entry:
3697                continue
3698            for group in entry.get('paths') or []:
3699                for path in (group if isinstance(group, list) else [group]):
3700                    if isinstance(path, dict):
3701                        routes.append(_evpn_path(block.get('rd', rd), prefix, entry, path))
3702    return routes
3703
3704
3705def get_bgp_evpn_routes(grade: Grade0, machine_name: str, step: int = 1, allow_error: bool = True) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
3706    """Every path of the EVPN table (``show bgp l2vpn evpn route detail json``, see
3707    :func:`parse_bgp_evpn_routes`; filter with :func:`evpn_routes`)."""
3708    return parse_bgp_evpn_routes(_vtysh_json(grade, machine_name, 'show bgp l2vpn evpn route detail', step,
3709                                             allow_error))
3710
3711
3712def evpn_routes(routes: List[Dict[str, Any]], route_type: int = None, mac=None, ip=None, network=None, vtep=None,
3713                nexthop=None, rt: str = None, best_only: bool = True, local: bool = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
3714    """The paths of a :func:`parse_bgp_evpn_routes` result that match every given criterion
3715    (*mac* compared case-insensitively; ``ip=False`` keeps the MAC-only type-2 routes);
3716    *best_only* keeps the best paths."""
3717    result = []
3718    for r in routes:
3719        if best_only and not r['best']:
3720            continue
3721        if route_type is not None and r['type'] != route_type:
3722            continue
3723        if mac is not None and (r['mac'] or '') != str(mac).lower():
3724            continue
3725        if ip is False and r['ip']:
3726            continue
3727        if ip not in (None, False) and r['ip'] != str(ip):
3728            continue
3729        if network is not None and r['network'] != str(network):
3730            continue
3731        if vtep is not None and r['vtep'] != str(vtep):
3732            continue
3733        if nexthop is not None and r['nexthop'] != str(nexthop):
3734            continue
3735        if rt is not None and rt not in r['rts']:
3736            continue
3737        if local is not None and r['local'] != local:
3738            continue
3739        result.append(r)
3740    return result
3741

3743def parse_evpn_vnis(data: Any) -> Dict[int, Dict[str, Any]]:
3744    """Parse ``show evpn vni detail json`` (a list; ``{}`` without VNI) or ``show evpn vni json``
3745    (an object keyed by VNI) → ``{vni: {...}}``::
3746
3747        {100: {'type': 'L2', 'vrf': 'TENANT', 'vxlan_if': 'vxlan100', 'svi': 'br100',
3748               'vtep_ip': '10.255.0.11', 'mcast_group': None, 'remote_vteps': ['10.255.0.12', …],
3749               'flood': {'10.255.0.12': 'HER'}, 'num_macs': 3, 'num_arp': 3,
3750               'state': None, 'router_mac': None, 'l2_vnis': []},
3751         4000: {'type': 'L3', 'vrf': 'TENANT', 'vxlan_if': 'vxlan4000', 'svi': 'br4000',
3752                'vtep_ip': '10.255.0.11', 'state': 'Up', 'router_mac': 'ce:d2:…', 'l2_vnis': [100, 200], …}}
3753
3754    The brief form has no ``svi`` / ``vtep_ip`` / ``state``; ``mcast_group`` is ``None`` for
3755    ``0.0.0.0`` (head-end replication)."""
3756    items = data if isinstance(data, list) else list(data.values()) if isinstance(data, dict) else []
3757    result: Dict[int, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
3758    for v in items:
3759        if not isinstance(v, dict) or _int_or_none(v.get('vni')) is None:
3760            continue
3761        remotes = v.get('remoteVteps') if isinstance(v.get('remoteVteps'), list) else []
3762        flood = {}
3763        for r in remotes:
3764            if isinstance(r, dict):
3765                flood[r.get('ip')] = r.get('flood')
3766            else:
3767                flood[str(r)] = None
3768        group = v.get('mcastGroup')
3769        result[int(v['vni'])] = {
3770            'type': v.get('type'), 'vrf': v.get('tenantVrf'),
3771            'vxlan_if': v.get('vxlanInterface') or v.get('vxlanIntf') or v.get('vxlanIf'),
3772            'svi': v.get('sviInterface') or v.get('sviIntf'),
3773            'vtep_ip': v.get('vtepIp') or v.get('localVtepIp'),
3774            'mcast_group': None if group in (None, '', '0.0.0.0') else group,
3775            'remote_vteps': sorted(flood), 'flood': flood,
3776            'num_macs': _int_or_none(v.get('numMacs')), 'num_arp': _int_or_none(v.get('numArpNd')),
3777            'state': v.get('state'), 'router_mac': (v.get('routerMac') or None),
3778            'l2_vnis': [int(x) for x in (v.get('l2Vnis') or []) if _int_or_none(x) is not None],
3779        }
3780    return result
3781

3877def _evpn_af(af: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
3878    """The ``l2vpn evpn`` keys of a per-family dict of ``parse_frr_config`` (added on first use)."""
3879    for key, default in (('advertise_all_vni', False), ('advertise_ipv4_unicast', False), ('autort_rfc8365', False),
3880                         ('advertise_svi_ip', False), ('advertise_default_gw', False), ('rd', None)):
3881        af.setdefault(key, default)
3882    af.setdefault('rt_import', [])
3883    af.setdefault('rt_export', [])
3884    af.setdefault('vnis', {})
3885    return af

3888def _apply_route_target(target: Dict[str, Any], w: List[str], negated: bool) -> None:
3889    # route-target import|export|both RT...
3890    keys = ['rt_import', 'rt_export'] if w[1] == 'both' else [f"rt_{w[1]}"]
3891    for key in keys:
3892        if negated:
3893            target[key] = [x for x in target[key] if x not in w[2:]] if w[2:] else []
3894        else:
3895            target[key] += [x for x in w[2:] if x not in target[key]]
3896
3897
3898def _parse_evpn_line(rb: Dict[str, Any], words: List[str], open_vni: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]):
3899    """An ``address-family l2vpn evpn`` statement of a ``router bgp`` block (default instance or
3900    VRF instance) → ``(handled, open_vni)``; ``open_vni`` is the dict of the open ``vni N`` block
3901    (its ``rd`` / ``route-target`` lines), ``None`` outside one.  Neighbour statements are left to
3902    the generic per-family code (``handled`` False)."""
3903    negated = bool(words) and words[0] == 'no'
3904    w = words[1:] if negated else words
3905    if not w or w[0] in ('neighbor', 'address-family', 'exit-address-family'):
3906        return False, open_vni
3907    af = _evpn_af(rb['address_families'].setdefault('l2vpn evpn', _empty_bgp_af_config()))
3908    if w[0] == 'exit-vni':
3909        return True, None
3910    if w[0] == 'vni' and len(w) >= 2 and w[1].isdigit():
3911        if negated:
3912            af['vnis'].pop(int(w[1]), None)
3913            return True, None
3914        vni = af['vnis'].setdefault(int(w[1]), {'rd': None, 'rt_import': [], 'rt_export': []})
3915        return True, vni
3916    target = open_vni if open_vni is not None else af
3917    if w[0] == 'rd' and len(w) >= 2:
3918        target['rd'] = None if negated else w[1]
3919    elif w[0] == 'route-target' and len(w) >= 2 and w[1] in ('import', 'export', 'both'):
3920        _apply_route_target(target, w, negated)
3921    elif w[0] == 'advertise-all-vni':
3922        af['advertise_all_vni'] = not negated
3923    elif w[:3] == ['advertise', 'ipv4', 'unicast']:
3924        af['advertise_ipv4_unicast'] = not negated
3925    elif w[:2] == ['autort', 'rfc8365-compatible']:
3926        af['autort_rfc8365'] = not negated
3927    elif w[0] == 'advertise-svi-ip':
3928        af['advertise_svi_ip'] = not negated
3929    elif w[0] == 'advertise-default-gw':
3930        af['advertise_default_gw'] = not negated
3931    else:
3932        return False, open_vni
3933    return True, open_vni
3934

3936def evpn_family(router_bgp: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
3937    """The ``l2vpn evpn`` view of a ``router_bgp`` (or ``router_bgp_vrfs[X]``) of
3938    :func:`parse_frr_config`, with every EVPN key present: ``advertise_all_vni``,
3939    ``advertise_ipv4_unicast``, ``autort_rfc8365``, ``advertise_svi_ip``, ``advertise_default_gw``,
3940    ``rd``, ``rt_import``, ``rt_export`` (the L3VNI of a VRF instance), ``vnis`` (``{vni: {'rd',
3941    'rt_import', 'rt_export'}}``, the ``vni N`` blocks) and ``neighbors``."""
3942    af = dict(((router_bgp or {}).get('address_families') or {}).get('l2vpn evpn') or _empty_bgp_af_config())
3943    return _evpn_af(af)

3950def parse_rpki_cache_connection(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
3951    """The JSON of ``show rpki cache-connection``: ``{'connected': bool, 'error': str | None,
3952    'connections': [{'mode', 'host', 'port', 'preference', 'state'}]}`` (``connected``: one cache
3953    server at least in state ``connected``; the error is FRR's message when none is,
3954    ``"No connection to RPKI cache server."``)."""
3955    result = {'connected': False, 'error': None, 'connections': []}
3956    if not isinstance(data, dict):
3957        return result
3958    result['error'] = data.get('error') if isinstance(data.get('error'), str) else None
3959    for c in data.get('connections') or []:
3960        if isinstance(c, dict):
3961            result['connections'].append({'mode': c.get('mode'), 'host': c.get('host'),
3962                                          'port': _int_or_none(c.get('port')),
3963                                          'preference': _int_or_none(c.get('preference')),
3964                                          'state': c.get('state')})
3965    result['connected'] = any(c['state'] == 'connected' for c in result['connections'])
3966    return result
3967

3977def parse_rpki_prefix_table(data: Any) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
3978    """The JSON of ``show rpki prefix-table``: the validated ROA payloads (VRPs) the router got from
3979    its cache, ``[{'prefix': '172.16.4.0/22', 'max_length': 24, 'asn': 65002}]`` (``[]`` without

3989                       'max_length': _int_or_none(v.get('prefixLenMax')), 'asn': _int_or_none(v.get('asn'))})
3990    return result

3999def rpki_origin_state(vrps: List[Dict[str, Any]], prefix, origin_as: int) -> str:
4000    """Route origin validation (RFC 6811) of *prefix* announced by *origin_as* against a list of
4001    VRPs (:func:`parse_rpki_prefix_table`, or the ROAs of a validator file in the same shape):
4002    ``'notfound'`` when no VRP covers the prefix, ``'valid'`` when one covering VRP has this origin
4003    and a max length at least the prefix length, else ``'invalid'``."""
4004    net = ip_network(str(prefix), strict=False)
4005    covered = False
4006    for v in vrps:
4007        try:
4008            vnet = ip_network(v["prefix"], strict=False)
4009        except (KeyError, ValueError):
4010            continue
4011        if vnet.version != net.version or not net.subnet_of(vnet):
4012            continue
4013        covered = True
4014        max_length = v.get('max_length') if v.get('max_length') is not None else vnet.prefixlen
4015        if v.get('asn') == origin_as and net.prefixlen <= max_length:
4016            return 'valid'
4017    return 'invalid' if covered else 'notfound'
4018

4020def parse_bgp_dampening_parameters(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
4021    """The JSON of ``show bgp ipv4 unicast dampening parameters``: ``{'half_life': 15, 'reuse': 750,
4022    'suppress': 2000, 'max_suppress': 60}`` (half-life and max-suppress in minutes, as configured
4023    with ``bgp dampening``); ``{}`` when dampening is off."""
4024    if not isinstance(data, dict) or 'halfLifeSecs' not in data:
4025        return {}
4026    half, max_suppress = _int_or_none(data.get('halfLifeSecs')), _int_or_none(data.get('maxSuppressTimeSecs'))
4027    return {'half_life': None if half is None else half // 60, 'reuse': _int_or_none(data.get('reusePenalty')),
4028            'suppress': _int_or_none(data.get('suppressPenalty')),
4029            'max_suppress': None if max_suppress is None else max_suppress // 60,
4030            'max_penalty': _int_or_none(data.get('maxSuppressPenalty'))}
4031

4041def parse_bgp_dampening_paths(data: Any) -> Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]]:

4043    ``{prefix: [{'peer', 'aspath', 'damped', 'history', 'flaps', 'reuse_ms'}]}`` (``flaps``: only in
4044    the flap statistics; ``{}`` when nothing is listed or dampening is off)."""

4053                continue
4054            result.setdefault(prefix, []).append({
4055                'peer': e.get('peerHost') or e.get('peerId'), 'aspath': e.get('asPath') or e.get('path') or '',
4056                'damped': bool(e.get('damped')), 'history': bool(e.get('history')),
4057                'flaps': _int_or_none(e.get('bdiFlap')), 'reuse_ms': _int_or_none(e.get('reuseTimerMsecs'))})
4058    return result

def parse_ospf_interfaces(output: str) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]: 
 80def parse_ospf_interfaces(output: str) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
 81    """Parse the text of ``show ip ospf interface`` (see :func:`get_ospf_interfaces`)."""
 82    result: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
 83    current: Dict[str, Any] | None = None
 84
 85    for line in output.splitlines():
 86        # Interface header: "ethX is up"
 87        m = re.match(r'^(\S+) is (up|down)', line)
 88        if m:
 89            current = {
 90                'state': m.group(2),
 91                'ospf_enabled': True,
 92                'mtu': None, 'bandwidth': None,
 93                'internet_address': None, 'broadcast': None, 'area': None,
 94                'router_id': None, 'network_type': None, 'cost': None,
 95                'ospf_state': None, 'priority': None, 'passive': False,
 96                'hello_interval': None, 'dead_interval': None, 'retransmit_interval': None,
 97                'neighbor_count': None, 'adjacent_neighbor_count': None,
 98                'dr_id': None, 'dr_address': None,
 99                'bdr_id': None, 'bdr_address': None,
100            }
101            result[m.group(1)] = current
102            continue
103
104        if current is None:
105            continue
106
107        if 'OSPF not enabled on this interface' in line:
108            current['ospf_enabled'] = False
109            continue
110
111        # ifindex 13, MTU 1500 bytes, BW 10000 Mbit <UP,LOWER_UP,BROADCAST,RUNNING,MULTICAST>
112        m = re.search(r'MTU (\d+) bytes,\s*BW (\d+) Mbit', line)
113        if m:
114            current['mtu'] = int(m.group(1))
115            current['bandwidth'] = int(m.group(2))
116            continue
117
118        # Internet Address 10.150.180.224/28, Broadcast 10.150.180.239, Area 0.0.0.0
119        m = re.search(r'Internet Address (\S+?),\s*Broadcast (\S+?),\s*Area (\S+)', line)
120        if m:
121            current['internet_address'] = m.group(1)
122            current['broadcast'] = m.group(2)
123            current['area'] = m.group(3)
124            continue
125
126        # Internet Address 10.0.0.1/30, Area 0.0.0.0   (point-to-point, no broadcast)
127        m = re.search(r'Internet Address (\S+?),\s*Area (\S+)', line)
128        if m:
129            current['internet_address'] = m.group(1)
130            current['area'] = m.group(2)
131            continue
132
133        # Router ID 10.150.180.224, Network Type BROADCAST, Cost: 10
134        m = re.search(r'Router ID (\S+?),\s*Network Type (\S+?),\s*Cost:\s*(\d+)', line)
135        if m:
136            current['router_id'] = m.group(1)
137            current['network_type'] = m.group(2)
138            current['cost'] = int(m.group(3))
139            continue
140
141        # Transmit Delay is 1 sec, State Backup, Priority 1
142        m = re.search(r'State (\S+?),\s*Priority (\d+)', line)
143        if m:
144            current['ospf_state'] = m.group(1).rstrip(',')
145            current['priority'] = int(m.group(2))
146            continue
147
148        # Designated Router (ID) 172.23.52.228 Interface Address 10.150.180.230/28
149        m = re.search(r'Designated Router \(ID\) (\S+)\s+Interface Address (\S+)', line)
150        if m and 'Backup' not in line:
151            current['dr_id'] = m.group(1)
152            current['dr_address'] = m.group(2)
153            continue
154
155        # Backup Designated Router (ID) 10.150.180.224, Interface Address 10.150.180.224
156        m = re.search(r'Backup Designated Router \(ID\) (\S+?),\s*Interface Address (\S+)', line)
157        if m:
158            current['bdr_id'] = m.group(1)
159            current['bdr_address'] = m.group(2)
160            continue
161
162        # Timer intervals configured, Hello 10s, Dead 40s, Wait 40s, Retransmit 5
163        m = re.search(r'Hello (\d+)s,\s*Dead (\d+)s,.*Retransmit (\d+)', line)
164        if m:
165            current['hello_interval'] = int(m.group(1))
166            current['dead_interval'] = int(m.group(2))
167            current['retransmit_interval'] = int(m.group(3))
168            continue
169
170        # No Hellos (Passive interface)
171        if 'No Hellos (Passive interface)' in line:
172            current['passive'] = True
173            continue
174
175        # Neighbor Count is 1, Adjacent neighbor count is 1
176        m = re.search(r'Neighbor Count is (\d+),\s*Adjacent neighbor count is (\d+)', line)
177        if m:
178            current['neighbor_count'] = int(m.group(1))
179            current['adjacent_neighbor_count'] = int(m.group(2))
180            continue
181
182    return result

Parse the text of show ip ospf interface (see get_ospf_interfaces()).

def get_ospf_interfaces( grade: SRE.lib_sre.Grade0, machine_name: str, step: int = 1, allow_error: bool = False) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]: 
185def get_ospf_interfaces(grade: Grade0, machine_name: str, step: int = 1,
186                        allow_error: bool = False) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
187    """Run 'vtysh -c "show ip ospf interface"' and parse the output.
188
189    Returns a dict mapping interface name -> dict of parsed fields:
190      state            : 'up' | 'down'
191      ospf_enabled     : bool  (False for "OSPF not enabled on this interface" entries)
192      mtu              : int
193      bandwidth        : int   (Mbit, the "BW" field: interface speed or `bandwidth` setting)
194      internet_address : str  e.g. '10.150.180.224/28'
195      broadcast        : str  e.g. '10.150.180.239'
196      area             : str  e.g. '0.0.0.0'
197      router_id        : str
198      network_type     : str  e.g. 'BROADCAST'
199      cost             : int
200      ospf_state       : str  e.g. 'Backup', 'DR', 'DROther'
201      priority         : int
202      passive          : bool ("No Hellos (Passive interface)")
203      hello_interval   : int  (seconds)
204      dead_interval    : int  (seconds)
205      retransmit_interval : int (seconds)
206      neighbor_count          : int
207      adjacent_neighbor_count : int
208      dr_id            : str | None
209      dr_address       : str | None
210      bdr_id           : str | None
211      bdr_address      : str | None
212
213    Returns {} on error or empty output.
214    """
215    output, code = _test(grade, machine_name, 'vtysh -c "show ip ospf interface"', step, allow_error)
216    if code != 0 or not output:
217        return {}
218    return parse_ospf_interfaces(output)

Returns a dict mapping interface name -> dict of parsed fields: state : 'up' | 'down' ospf_enabled : bool (False for "OSPF not enabled on this interface" entries) mtu : int bandwidth : int (Mbit, the "BW" field: interface speed or bandwidth setting) internet_address : str e.g. '10.150.180.224/28' broadcast : str e.g. '10.150.180.239' area : str e.g. '0.0.0.0' router_id : str network_type : str e.g. 'BROADCAST' cost : int ospf_state : str e.g. 'Backup', 'DR', 'DROther' priority : int passive : bool ("No Hellos (Passive interface)") hello_interval : int (seconds) dead_interval : int (seconds) retransmit_interval : int (seconds) neighbor_count : int adjacent_neighbor_count : int dr_id : str | None dr_address : str | None bdr_id : str | None bdr_address : str | None

Returns {} on error or empty output.

def parse_ospf_neighbors(output: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]: 
225def parse_ospf_neighbors(output: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
226    """Parse the text of ``show ip ospf neighbor``.
227
228    Data rows look like (the "Up Time" column exists in FRR >= 7.5 only)::
229
230        Neighbor ID     Pri State           Up Time         Dead Time Address         Interface                        RXmtL RqstL DBsmL
231        10.0.0.2          1 Full/DR         2m34s             36.245s 10.0.12.2       eth0:10.0.12.1                       0     0     0
232
233    Rows are parsed from the end (three counters, interface, address, dead time) so
234    both layouts work.  Non-data lines are skipped.
235    """
236    result: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
237    for line in output.splitlines():
238        fields = line.split()
239        if len(fields) < 9 or not _IPV4_RE.match(fields[0]):
240            continue
241        state, _, role = fields[2].partition('/')
242        interface, _, local_address = fields[-4].partition(':')
243        try:
244            priority: Optional[int] = int(fields[1])
245        except ValueError:
246            priority = None
247        result.append({
248            'neighbor_id': fields[0],
249            'priority': priority,
250            'state': state,
251            'role': role or None,
252            'up_time': fields[3] if len(fields) >= 10 else None,
253            'dead_time': fields[-6],
254            'address': fields[-5],
255            'interface': interface,
256            'local_address': local_address or None,
257        })
258    return result

Parse the text of show ip ospf neighbor.

Data rows look like (the "Up Time" column exists in FRR >= 7.5 only)::

Neighbor ID     Pri State           Up Time         Dead Time Address         Interface                        RXmtL RqstL DBsmL
10.0.0.2          1 Full/DR         2m34s             36.245s 10.0.12.2       eth0:10.0.12.1                       0     0     0

Rows are parsed from the end (three counters, interface, address, dead time) so both layouts work. Non-data lines are skipped.

262                       allow_error: bool = False) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
263    """Run 'vtysh -c "show ip ospf neighbor"' and return one dict per neighbour:
264    ``neighbor_id, priority, state ('Full', '2-Way', ...), role ('DR', 'Backup',
265    'DROther', '-'), up_time, dead_time, address, interface, local_address``.

def find_neighbor( neighbors: List[Dict[str, Any]], neighbor_id: str = None, interface: str = None, address: str = None) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]: 
273def find_neighbor(neighbors: List[Dict[str, Any]], neighbor_id: str = None, interface: str = None,
274                  address: str = None) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
275    """Return the first neighbour of :func:`get_ospf_neighbors` matching every given criterion."""
276    for n in neighbors:
277        if neighbor_id is not None and n['neighbor_id'] != str(neighbor_id):
278            continue
279        if interface is not None and n['interface'] != interface:
280            continue
281        if address is not None and n['address'] != str(address):
282            continue
283        return n
284    return None

Return the first neighbour of get_ospf_neighbors() matching every given criterion.

def neighbor_is_full( neighbors: List[Dict[str, Any]], neighbor_id: str = None, interface: str = None, address: str = None) -> bool: 
287def neighbor_is_full(neighbors: List[Dict[str, Any]], neighbor_id: str = None, interface: str = None,
288                     address: str = None) -> bool:
289    """True when a neighbour matching the criteria exists and is in state Full."""
290    n = find_neighbor(neighbors, neighbor_id=neighbor_id, interface=interface, address=address)
291    return n is not None and n['state'] == 'Full'

def parse_ospf_info(output: str) -> Dict[str, Any]: 
298def parse_ospf_info(output: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
299    """Parse the text of ``show ip ospf``.
300
301    Returns ``{}`` when no router id is found (OSPF not running), else::
302
303        {'router_id': '10.0.0.4', 'abr': True, 'asbr': False,
304         'areas': {'0.0.0.0': {'type': 'backbone', 'no_summary': False, 'interfaces': 3,
305                               'active_interfaces': 3, 'full_neighbors': 2,
306                               'authentication': 'no'}, ...}}
307
308    ``type`` is ``'backbone'``, ``'stub'``, ``'nssa'`` or ``'normal'``;
309    ``authentication`` is ``'no'``, ``'simple password'`` or ``'message digest'``.
310    """
311    info: Dict[str, Any] = {'router_id': None, 'abr': False, 'asbr': False, 'areas': {}}
312    current: Dict[str, Any] | None = None
313
314    for line in output.splitlines():
315        m = re.search(r'OSPF Routing Process, Router ID:\s*(\S+)', line)
316        if m:
317            info['router_id'] = m.group(1)
318            continue
319        if 'This router is an ABR' in line:
320            info['abr'] = True
321            continue
322        if 'This router is an ASBR' in line:
323            info['asbr'] = True
324            continue
325        m = re.match(r'^\s*Area ID:\s*(\S+)(?:\s*\((.*?)\))?', line)
326        if m:
327            desc = (m.group(2) or '').strip()
328            low = desc.lower()
329            if low.startswith('backbone'):
330                area_type = 'backbone'
331            elif low.startswith('stub'):
332                area_type = 'stub'
333            elif low.startswith('nssa'):
334                area_type = 'nssa'
335            else:
336                area_type = 'normal'
337            current = {
338                'type': area_type,
339                'no_summary': 'no summary' in low,
340                'interfaces': None, 'active_interfaces': None,
341                'full_neighbors': None, 'authentication': None,
342            }
343            info['areas'][m.group(1)] = current
344            continue
345        if current is None:
346            continue
347        m = re.search(r'Number of interfaces in this area:\s*Total:\s*(\d+),\s*Active:\s*(\d+)', line)
348        if m:
349            current['interfaces'] = int(m.group(1))
350            current['active_interfaces'] = int(m.group(2))
351            continue
352        m = re.search(r'Number of fully adjacent neighbors in this area:\s*(\d+)', line)
353        if m:
354            current['full_neighbors'] = int(m.group(1))
355            continue
356        m = re.search(r'Area has (.+?) authentication', line)
357        if m:
358            current['authentication'] = m.group(1).strip()
359            continue
360
361    if info['router_id'] is None:
362        return {}
363    return info

Parse the text of show ip ospf.

Returns {} when no router id is found (OSPF not running), else::

{'router_id': '10.0.0.4', 'abr': True, 'asbr': False,
 'areas': {'0.0.0.0': {'type': 'backbone', 'no_summary': False, 'interfaces': 3,
                       'active_interfaces': 3, 'full_neighbors': 2,
                       'authentication': 'no'}, ...}}

type is 'backbone', 'stub', 'nssa' or 'normal'; authentication is 'no', 'simple password' or 'message digest'.

375def router_id_map(grade: Grade0, machine_names, step: int = 1, allow_error: bool = True) -> Dict[str, str]:

def parse_ospf_routes(output: str) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]: 
401def parse_ospf_routes(output: str) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
402    """Parse the text of ``show ip ospf route``.
403
404    Network entries (``N``) and discard entries (``D``, created by ``area range``) are
405    keyed by prefix, router entries (``R``) by router id::
406
407        {'10.0.5.0/24': {'kind': 'N', 'type': 'IA', 'cost': 30, 'ext_cost': None, 'tag': None,
408                         'area': '0.0.0.0', 'abr': False, 'asbr': False,
409                         'nexthops': [('10.0.12.3', 'eth0')]},
410         '203.0.113.0/24': {'kind': 'N', 'type': 'E2', 'cost': 10, 'ext_cost': 20, 'tag': 0, ...},
411         '10.0.0.3': {'kind': 'R', 'type': 'intra', 'cost': 10, 'area': '0.0.0.0', 'abr': True, ...}}
412
413    ``type`` is ``'intra'`` for plain intra-area entries, ``'IA'``, ``'E1'``, ``'E2'``,
414    ``'N1'`` or ``'N2'``.  ``nexthops`` holds ``(ip, interface)`` pairs, ``ip`` being
415    ``None`` for ``directly attached to`` entries.
416    """
417    result: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
418    current: Dict[str, Any] | None = None
419
420    for line in output.splitlines():
421        m = _OSPF_ROUTE_RE.match(line.strip())
422        if m:
423            rest = m.group('rest') or ''
424            area_m = re.search(r'area:\s*(\S+?)(?:,|\s|$)', rest)
425            tag_m = re.search(r'tag:\s*(\d+)', rest)
426            current = {
427                'kind': m.group('kind'),
428                'type': m.group('type') or m.group('type2') or 'intra',
429                'cost': int(m.group('cost')) if m.group('cost') else None,
430                'ext_cost': int(m.group('ext_cost')) if m.group('ext_cost') else None,
431                'tag': int(tag_m.group(1)) if tag_m else None,
432                'area': area_m.group(1) if area_m else None,
433                'abr': 'ABR' in rest,
434                'asbr': 'ASBR' in rest,
435                'discard': bool(m.group('discard')),
436                'nexthops': [],
437            }
438            result[m.group('dest')] = current
439            continue
440        if current is None:
441            continue
442        m = re.search(r'via (\S+?),\s*(\S+)', line)
443        if m:
444            current['nexthops'].append((m.group(1), m.group(2)))
445            continue
446        m = re.search(r'directly attached to (\S+)', line)
447        if m:
448            current['nexthops'].append((None, m.group(1)))
449            continue
450
451    return result

Parse the text of show ip ospf route.

Network entries (N) and discard entries (D, created by area range) are keyed by prefix, router entries (R) by router id::

{'10.0.5.0/24': {'kind': 'N', 'type': 'IA', 'cost': 30, 'ext_cost': None, 'tag': None,
                 'area': '0.0.0.0', 'abr': False, 'asbr': False,
                 'nexthops': [('10.0.12.3', 'eth0')]},
 '203.0.113.0/24': {'kind': 'N', 'type': 'E2', 'cost': 10, 'ext_cost': 20, 'tag': 0, ...},
 '10.0.0.3': {'kind': 'R', 'type': 'intra', 'cost': 10, 'area': '0.0.0.0', 'abr': True, ...}}

type is 'intra' for plain intra-area entries, 'IA', 'E1', 'E2', 'N1' or 'N2'. nexthops holds (ip, interface) pairs, ip being None for directly attached to entries.
