def parse_igmp_interfaces(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]: 
2397def parse_igmp_interfaces(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
2398    """``show ip igmp interface [detail] json`` (or ``show ipv6 mld interface json``) →
2399    ``{ifname: {'address', 'up', 'version', 'querier' (this router is the querier),
2400    'querier_ip', 'query_interval' (s), 'query_response_interval' (s), 'last_member_interval'
2401    (s), 'last_member_count', 'robustness', 'mtrace_only'}}``.  The timers come from the
2402    ``detail`` form (``None`` in the short one); an interface with ``mtraceOnly`` has PIM but no
2403    ``ip igmp``."""
2404    result = {}
2405    for ifname, entry in _vrf_default(data).items():
2406        if not isinstance(entry, dict) or 'name' not in entry:
2407            continue
2408        querier = entry.get('querier')
2409        query_interval = entry.get('timerQueryInterval')
2410        if query_interval is None and entry.get('timerQueryIntervalMsec') is not None:
2411            query_interval = (_int_or_none(entry.get('timerQueryIntervalMsec')) or 0) / 1000
2412        response = entry.get('timerQueryResponseIntervalMsec', entry.get('timerQueryResponseTimerMsec'))
2413        last_member = entry.get('timerLastMemberQueryMsec', entry.get('timerLastMemberQueryIntervalMsec'))
2414        result[ifname] = {
2415            'address': _str_or_none(entry.get('address')), 'up': entry.get('state') == 'up',
2416            'version': _int_or_none(entry.get('version')),
2417            'querier': querier is True or str(querier).lower() in ('local', 'true'),
2418            'querier_ip': _str_or_none(entry.get('querierIp')),
2419            'query_interval': None if query_interval is None else float(query_interval),
2420            'query_response_interval': None if response is None else (_int_or_none(response) or 0) / 1000,
2421            'last_member_interval': None if last_member is None else (_int_or_none(last_member) or 0) / 1000,
2422            'last_member_count': _int_or_none(entry.get('lastMemberQueryCount')),
2423            'robustness': _int_or_none(entry.get('timerRobustnessVariable', entry.get('timerRobustnessValue'))),
2424            'mtrace_only': _bool(entry.get('mtraceOnly')),
2425        }
2426    return result

show ip igmp interface [detail] json (or show ipv6 mld interface json) → {ifname: {'address', 'up', 'version', 'querier' (this router is the querier), 'querier_ip', 'query_interval' (s), 'query_response_interval' (s), 'last_member_interval' (s), 'last_member_count', 'robustness', 'mtrace_only'}}. The timers come from the detail form (None in the short one); an interface with mtraceOnly has PIM but no ip igmp.

def parse_igmp_groups(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]]: 
2445def parse_igmp_groups(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]]:
2446    """``show ip igmp groups json`` (or ``show ipv6 mld groups json``) → ``{ifname: {group:
2447    {'version', 'mode' (INCL / EXCL), 'sources_count', 'uptime' (s), 'reporter'}}}``."""
2448    result: Dict[str, Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]] = {}
2449    for ifname, entry in _vrf_default(data).items():
2450        if not isinstance(entry, dict) or not isinstance(entry.get('groups'), list):
2451            continue
2452        groups = result.setdefault(ifname, {})
2453        for g in entry['groups']:
2454            if not isinstance(g, dict) or not g.get('group'):
2455                continue
2456            groups[str(g['group'])] = {
2457                'version': _int_or_none(g.get('version')), 'mode': _str_or_none(g.get('mode')),
2458                'sources_count': _int_or_none(g.get('sourcesCount')), 'uptime': _seconds(g.get('uptime')),
2459                'reporter': _str_or_none(g.get('source', g.get('lastReporter'))),
2460            }
2461    return result

def parse_igmp_sources(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, List[str]]]: 
2472def parse_igmp_sources(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, List[str]]]:
2473    """``show ip igmp sources json`` → ``{ifname: {group: [sources]}}`` (the (S,G) records of the
2474    IGMPv3 INCLUDE reports; ``*`` for an EXCLUDE {} / IGMPv2 group is left out)."""
2475    result: Dict[str, Dict[str, List[str]]] = {}
2476    for ifname, entry in _vrf_default(data).items():
2477        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
2478            continue
2479        for group, g in entry.items():
2480            if not isinstance(g, dict) or not isinstance(g.get('sources'), list):
2481                continue
2482            sources = [str(s.get('source')) for s in g['sources']
2483                       if isinstance(s, dict) and _str_or_none(s.get('source'))]
2484            if sources:
2485                result.setdefault(ifname, {})[str(g.get('group', group))] = sorted(sources)
2486    return result

def parse_ospf6_info(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]: 
2545def parse_ospf6_info(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
2546    """Parse the JSON of ``show ipv6 ospf6``.
2547
2548    Returns ``{}`` when ospf6d does not answer, else::
2549
2550        {'router_id': '2.2.2.2',          # '0.0.0.0' when none could be chosen
2551         'abr': True,                     # interfaces attached to two areas or more
2552         'areas': {'0.0.0.1': {'stub': True, 'nssa': False, 'no_summary': False,
2553                               'interfaces': ['eth1'], 'lsa_count': 9}},
2554         'as_scoped_lsa_count': 4}
2555
2556    The json has no ABR / ASBR flag: ``abr`` is computed from the areas, and what the other
2557    routers see is in :func:`get_ospf6_border_routers`.
2558    """
2559    if not isinstance(data, dict) or 'routerId' not in data:
2560        return {}
2561    areas: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
2562    for key, a in (data.get('areas') or {}).items():
2563        if not isinstance(a, dict):
2564            continue
2565        areas[normalize_area(key)] = {
2566            'stub': bool(a.get('areaIsStub')),
2567            'nssa': bool(a.get('areaIsNSSA')),
2568            'no_summary': bool(a.get('areaNoSummary')),
2569            'interfaces': [str(i) for i in (a.get('interfacesAttachedToArea') or [])],
2570            'lsa_count': _int_or_none(a.get('numberOfAreaScopedLsa')),
2571        }
2572    return {
2573        'router_id': data.get('routerId'),
2574        'abr': sum(1 for a in areas.values() if a['interfaces']) >= 2,
2575        'areas': areas,
2576        'as_scoped_lsa_count': _int_or_none(data.get('numberOfAsScopedLsa')),
2577    }

Parse the JSON of show ipv6 ospf6.

Returns {} when ospf6d does not answer, else::

{'router_id': '2.2.2.2',          # '0.0.0.0' when none could be chosen
 'abr': True,                     # interfaces attached to two areas or more
 'areas': {'0.0.0.1': {'stub': True, 'nssa': False, 'no_summary': False,
                       'interfaces': ['eth1'], 'lsa_count': 9}},
 'as_scoped_lsa_count': 4}

The json has no ABR / ASBR flag: abr is computed from the areas, and what the other routers see is in get_ospf6_border_routers().

def parse_ospf6_neighbors(data: Any) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]: 
2585def parse_ospf6_neighbors(data: Any) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
2586    """Parse the JSON of ``show ipv6 ospf6 neighbor``: one dict per neighbour, with the keys
2587    of :func:`get_ospf_neighbors` (so :func:`find_neighbor` / :func:`neighbor_is_full` work)::
2588
2589        {'neighbor_id': '1.1.1.1', 'priority': 1, 'state': 'Full',   # Init, Twoway, ExStart...
2590         'role': 'BDR',                   # the neighbour's role on the link
2591         'dead_time': '00:00:37', 'up_time': '00:00:32', 'interface': 'eth0',
2592         'interface_state': 'DR',         # this router's role on the link
2593         'address': None, 'local_address': None}
2594
2595    OSPFv3 neighbours are named by router-id; their (link-local) address is not in the json.
2596    """
2597    if not isinstance(data, dict):
2598        return []
2599    result: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
2600    for n in data.get('neighbors') or []:
2601        if not isinstance(n, dict):
2602            continue
2603        result.append({
2604            'neighbor_id': n.get('neighborId'),
2605            'priority': _int_or_none(n.get('priority')),
2606            'state': n.get('state'),
2607            'role': n.get('ifState'),
2608            'dead_time': n.get('deadTime'),
2609            'up_time': n.get('duration'),
2610            'interface': n.get('interfaceName'),
2611            'interface_state': n.get('interfaceState'),
2612            'address': None,
2613            'local_address': None,
2614        })
2615    return result

def parse_ospf6_interfaces(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]: 
2624def parse_ospf6_interfaces(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
2625    """Parse the JSON of ``show ipv6 ospf6 interface``.
2626
2627    Returns ``{ifname: {...}}`` for every interface ospf6d knows; ``enabled`` is false (and the
2628    other keys ``None``) for an interface not attached to an area::
2629
2630        {'enabled': True, 'area': '0.0.0.1', 'cost': 10, 'state': 'DR',  # PointToPoint, Waiting...
2631         'type': 'BROADCAST', 'passive': False, 'mtu': 1500, 'mtu_ignore': False,
2632         'priority': 1, 'hello_interval': 10, 'dead_interval': 40, 'dr': '3.3.3.3', 'bdr': '2.2.2.2',
2633         'addresses': ['fe80::53:52ff:fe48:ead/64', '3fff:550:5cfb:23::3/64'],
2634         'auth_type': 'NULL',             # 'manualkey' / 'keychain' with an authentication trailer
2635         'auth_rx_drops': None}
2636    """
2637    if not isinstance(data, dict):
2638        return {}
2639    result: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
2640    for ifname, e in data.items():
2641        if not isinstance(e, dict):
2642            continue
2643        enabled = bool(e.get('attachedToArea'))
2644        auth = e.get('authInfo') if isinstance(e.get('authInfo'), dict) else {}
2645        detection = e.get('mtuMismatchDetection')
2646        result[ifname] = {
2647            'enabled': enabled,
2648            'area': normalize_area(e['areaId']) if enabled and e.get('areaId') else None,
2649            'cost': _int_or_none(e.get('cost')),
2650            'state': e.get('ospf6InterfaceState'),
2651            'type': e.get('type'),
2652            'passive': bool(e.get('timerPassiveIface')) if enabled else None,
2653            'mtu': _int_or_none(e.get('interfaceMtu')),
2654            'mtu_ignore': (detection != 'enabled') if detection is not None else None,
2655            'priority': _int_or_none(e.get('priority')),
2656            'hello_interval': _int_or_none(e.get('timerIntervalsConfigHello')),
2657            'dead_interval': _int_or_none(e.get('timerIntervalsConfigDead')),
2658            'dr': e.get('dr'),
2659            'bdr': e.get('bdr'),
2660            'addresses': [a.get('address') for a in (e.get('internetAddress') or [])
2661                          if isinstance(a, dict) and a.get('address')],
2662            'auth_type': auth.get('authType'),
2663            'auth_rx_drops': _int_or_none(auth.get('rxPktDrop')),
2664        }
2665    return result

Parse the JSON of show ipv6 ospf6 interface.

 'type': 'BROADCAST', 'passive': False, 'mtu': 1500, 'mtu_ignore': False,
 'priority': 1, 'hello_interval': 10, 'dead_interval': 40, 'dr': '3.3.3.3', 'bdr': '2.2.2.2',
 'addresses': ['fe80::53:52ff:fe48:ead/64', '3fff:550:5cfb:23::3/64'],
 'auth_type': 'NULL',             # 'manualkey' / 'keychain' with an authentication trailer

def parse_ospf6_routes(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]: 
2674def parse_ospf6_routes(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
2675    """Parse the JSON of ``show ipv6 ospf6 route``.
2676
2677    Returns ``{prefix: {'type': 'intra-area' | 'inter-area' | 'external-1' | 'external-2',
2678    'code': 'IA' | 'IE' | 'E1' | 'E2', 'best': bool, 'nexthops': [(nexthop | None, ifname)]}}``;
2679    a directly connected network has the next hop ``None`` (``::`` in the json).  The default
2680    route a stub area receives from its ABR is ``'::/0'`` of type ``inter-area``.
2681    """
2682    if not isinstance(data, dict) or not isinstance(data.get('routes'), dict):
2683        return {}
2684    result: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
2685    for prefix, e in data['routes'].items():
2686        if not isinstance(e, dict):
2687            continue
2688        code = e.get('pathType')
2689        nexthops = []
2690        for n in e.get('nextHops') or []:
2691            if isinstance(n, dict):
2692                nh = n.get('nextHop')
2693                nexthops.append((None if nh in (None, '', '::') else nh, n.get('interfaceName')))
2694        result[prefix] = {
2695            'type': OSPF6_PATH_TYPES.get(code, code),
2696            'code': code,
2697            'best': bool(e.get('isBestRoute')),
2698            'nexthops': nexthops,
2699        }
2700    return result

Parse the JSON of show ipv6 ospf6 route.

Returns {prefix: {'type': 'intra-area' | 'inter-area' | 'external-1' | 'external-2', 'code': 'IA' | 'IE' | 'E1' | 'E2', 'best': bool, 'nexthops': [(nexthop | None, ifname)]}}; a directly connected network has the next hop None (:: in the json). The default route a stub area receives from its ABR is '::/0' of type inter-area.

def parse_ospf6_border_routers(output: str) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]: 
2712def parse_ospf6_border_routers(output: str) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
2713    """Parse the text of ``show ipv6 ospf6 border-routers`` (no json form in FRR 9.1)::
2714
2715        Router-ID       Rtr-Bits Options        Path-Type  Area
2716        1.1.1.1         ------E- --|-|--|-|-|--|R|-|--|E|V6 Intra-Area 0.0.0.0
2717        2.2.2.2         -------B --|-|--|-|-|--|R|-|--|E|V6 Intra-Area 0.0.0.0
2718
2719    Returns ``{router_id: {'abr': bool, 'asbr': bool, 'path_type': 'Intra-Area', 'areas':
2720    ['0.0.0.0', ...]}}`` (an ABR is listed once per area); ``{}`` without ospf6d
2721    (``% OSPFv3 instance not found``).  The router itself appears when it is a border router.
2722    """
2723    result: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
2724    for line in (output or '').splitlines():
2725        m = _OSPF6_BORDER_ROUTER_RE.match(line.strip())
2726        if not m:
2727            continue
2728        rid, bits, path_type, area = m.groups()
2729        entry = result.setdefault(rid, {'abr': False, 'asbr': False, 'path_type': path_type, 'areas': []})
2730        entry['abr'] = entry['abr'] or 'B' in bits
2731        entry['asbr'] = entry['asbr'] or 'E' in bits
2732        if area not in entry['areas']:
2733            entry['areas'].append(area)
2734    return result

Parse the text of show ipv6 ospf6 border-routers (no json form in FRR 9.1)::

Router-ID       Rtr-Bits Options        Path-Type  Area
1.1.1.1         ------E- --|-|--|-|-|--|R|-|--|E|V6 Intra-Area 0.0.0.0
2.2.2.2         -------B --|-|--|-|-|--|R|-|--|E|V6 Intra-Area 0.0.0.0

Returns {router_id: {'abr': bool, 'asbr': bool, 'path_type': 'Intra-Area', 'areas': ['0.0.0.0', ...]}} (an ABR is listed once per area); {} without ospf6d (% OSPFv3 instance not found). The router itself appears when it is a border router.

2760def mpls_label_value(text) -> Optional[int]:
2761    """A label as ldpd / zebra print it (``"16"``, ``16``, ``"imp-null"``, ``"exp-null"``) → its

def parse_mpls_table(data: Any) -> Dict[int, Dict[str, Any]]: 
2835def parse_mpls_table(data: Any) -> Dict[int, Dict[str, Any]]:
2836    """``show mpls table json`` (zebra's label table, LDP / SR / static) → ``{in_label:
2837    {'installed': bool, 'nexthops': [{'type': 'LDP' | 'SR (OSPF)' | ..., 'out_labels': [int],
2838    'nexthop': str | None, 'interface': str | None, 'installed': bool}]}}``.  ``installed`` is
2839    zebra's view: the kernel may still have refused the label (``ip -f mpls route``)."""
2840    result: Dict[int, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
2841    for key, entry in (data or {}).items() if isinstance(data, dict) else []:
2842        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
2843            continue
2844        label = _int_or_none(entry.get('inLabel', key))
2845        if label is None:
2846            continue
2847        nexthops = []
2848        for n in entry.get('nexthops', []):
2849            if not isinstance(n, dict):
2850                continue
2851            stack = n.get('outLabelStack')
2852            if not isinstance(stack, list):
2853                stack = [n.get('outLabel')] if n.get('outLabel') is not None else []
2854            nexthops.append({'type': n.get('type'), 'out_labels': [x for x in map(mpls_label_value, stack) if x is not None],
2855                             'nexthop': n.get('nexthop'), 'interface': n.get('interface'),
2856                             'installed': bool(n.get('installed'))})
2857        result[label] = {'installed': bool(entry.get('installed')), 'nexthops': nexthops}
2858    return result

show mpls table json (zebra's label table, LDP / SR / static) → {in_label: {'installed': bool, 'nexthops': [{'type': 'LDP' | 'SR (OSPF)' | ..., 'out_labels': [int], 'nexthop': str | None, 'interface': str | None, 'installed': bool}]}}. installed is zebra's view: the kernel may still have refused the label (ip -f mpls route).

def parse_ospf_sr_database(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]: 
2867def parse_ospf_sr_database(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
2868    """``show ip ospf database segment-routing json`` → ``{router_id: {'srgb': (base, size),
2869    'srlb': (base, size), 'prefixes': {prefix: {'index': int, 'input_label': int,
2870    'routes': [{'out_label': int, 'interface': str, 'nexthop': str}]}}}}`` (``{}`` when segment
2871    routing is disabled on the router: FRR answers with a text line).  ``input_label`` and
2872    ``routes`` are those of the router that answers, which also lists itself."""
2873    result: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
2874    for node in (data or {}).get('srNodes', []) if isinstance(data, dict) else []:
2875        if not isinstance(node, dict) or not node.get('routerID'):
2876            continue
2877        prefixes = {}
2878        for p in node.get('extendedPrefix', []):
2879            if not isinstance(p, dict) or not p.get('prefix'):
2880                continue
2881            routes = [{'out_label': mpls_label_value(r.get('outputLabel')), 'interface': r.get('interface'),
2882                       'nexthop': r.get('nexthop')} for r in p.get('prefixRoute', []) if isinstance(r, dict)]
2883            prefixes[p['prefix']] = {'index': _int_or_none(p.get('sid')),
2884                                     'input_label': _int_or_none(p.get('inputLabel')), 'routes': routes}
2885        result[node['routerID']] = {
2886            'srgb': (_int_or_none(node.get('srgbLabel')), _int_or_none(node.get('srgbSize'))),
2887            'srlb': (_int_or_none(node.get('srlbLabel')), _int_or_none(node.get('srlbSize'))),
2888            'prefixes': prefixes,
2889        }
2890    return result

show ip ospf database segment-routing json → {router_id: {'srgb': (base, size), 'srlb': (base, size), 'prefixes': {prefix: {'index': int, 'input_label': int, 'routes': [{'out_label': int, 'interface': str, 'nexthop': str}]}}}} ({} when segment routing is disabled on the router: FRR answers with a text line). input_label and routes are those of the router that answers, which also lists itself.

def parse_frr_routes(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]: 
2905def parse_frr_routes(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
2906    """``show ip route [vrf X] json`` (zebra's RIB) → ``{prefix: {'protocol': str, 'selected':
2907    bool, 'installed': bool, 'metric': int | None, 'nexthops': [{'ip', 'interface', 'labels':
2908    [int], 'active', 'fib'}], 'backups': [same keys]}}``; ``backups`` are the backup next hops
2909    of a protected route (TI-LFA), which zebra keeps but does not install in the kernel.  Of
2910    several routes for a prefix the selected one wins (else the first)."""
2911    result: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
2912    for prefix, routes in (data or {}).items() if isinstance(data, dict) else []:
2913        if not isinstance(routes, list):
2914            continue
2915        candidates = [r for r in routes if isinstance(r, dict)]
2916        if not candidates:
2917            continue
2918        r = next((x for x in candidates if x.get('selected')), candidates[0])
2919        result[prefix] = {
2920            'protocol': r.get('protocol'), 'selected': bool(r.get('selected')), 'installed': bool(r.get('installed')),
2921            'metric': _int_or_none(r.get('metric')),
2922            'nexthops': [_route_nexthop(n) for n in r.get('nexthops', []) if isinstance(n, dict)],
2923            'backups': [_route_nexthop(n) for n in r.get('backupNexthops', []) if isinstance(n, dict)],
2924        }
2925    return result

show ip route [vrf X] json (zebra's RIB) → {prefix: {'protocol': str, 'selected': bool, 'installed': bool, 'metric': int | None, 'nexthops': [{'ip', 'interface', 'labels': [int], 'active', 'fib'}], 'backups': [same keys]}}; backups are the backup next hops of a protected route (TI-LFA), which zebra keeps but does not install in the kernel. Of several routes for a prefix the selected one wins (else the first).

def normalize_system_id(text) -> Optional[str]: 
2989def normalize_system_id(text) -> Optional[str]:
2990    """A system-id as typed (``0100.0003.1002``, ``010000031002``, upper case) in FRR's form, or
2991    ``None``."""
2992    word = str(text or '').strip().lower().replace('.', '')

2994        return None
2995    return f"{word[0:4]}.{word[4:8]}.{word[8:12]}"

def parse_isis_neighbors(output: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]: 
3020def parse_isis_neighbors(output: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
3021    """Parse ``show isis neighbor detail`` (or the plain ``show isis neighbor`` table).
3022
3023    Returns one dict per adjacency (a broadcast circuit lists one per neighbour and level):
3024    ``{'name': hostname or system-id, 'interface': str, 'level': 1 | 2 | 3 (both), 'state': 'Up' |
3025    'Initializing' | 'Down', 'up': bool, 'holdtime': int | None, 'snpa': str | None, and, from the
3026    detail form only: 'circuit_type': 'L1' | 'L2' | 'L1L2' | None, 'speaks': ['IPv4', 'IPv6'],
3027    'topologies': [str], 'lan_id': str | None, 'priority': int | None, 'is_dis': bool | None,
3028    'areas': [str], 'ipv4': [str], 'ipv6': [str] (link-local), 'ipv6_global': [str],
3029    'bfd': 'Up' | 'Down' | ... | None}``.  ``[]`` on an empty or placeholder output.
3030    """
3031    result: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
3032    lines = (output or '').splitlines()
3033    if any(_NEIGHBOR_TABLE_RE.match(line) for line in lines) and not any('Interface:' in line for line in lines):
3034        for line in lines:
3035            m = _NEIGHBOR_TABLE_RE.match(line)
3036            if m and m.group('name') != 'System':
3037                state = m.group('state')
3038                result.append({'name': m.group('name'), 'interface': m.group('ifname'),
3039                               'level': int(m.group('level')), 'state': state, 'up': state == 'Up',
3040                               'holdtime': int(m.group('hold')), 'snpa': m.group('snpa')})
3041        return result
3042
3043    current: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
3044    pending_name: Optional[str] = None
3045    list_key: Optional[str] = None
3046    lists = {'Area Address(es):': 'areas', 'IPv4 Address(es):': 'ipv4', 'IPv6 Address(es):': 'ipv6',
3047             'Global IPv6 Address(es):': 'ipv6_global', 'Topologies:': 'topologies'}
3048    for raw in lines:
3049        stripped = raw.strip()
3050        indent = len(raw) - len(raw.lstrip())
3051        if not stripped or indent == 0 and stripped.startswith('Area ') and stripped.endswith(':'):
3052            list_key = None
3053            continue
3054        if indent <= 2 and ' ' not in stripped:
3055            pending_name, current, list_key = stripped, None, None
3056            continue
3057        m = _NEIGHBOR_ITEM_RE.search(stripped)
3058        if m and pending_name:
3059            state = m.group('state').strip()
3060            current = {'name': pending_name, 'interface': m.group('ifname').strip(),
3061                       'level': int(m.group('level')), 'state': state, 'up': state == 'Up',
3062                       'holdtime': _int_or_none(m.group('hold')), 'snpa': None, 'circuit_type': None,
3063                       'speaks': [], 'topologies': [], 'lan_id': None, 'priority': None, 'is_dis': None,
3064                       'areas': [], 'ipv4': [], 'ipv6': [], 'ipv6_global': [], 'bfd': None}
3065            result.append(current)
3066            list_key = None
3067            continue
3068        if current is None:
3069            continue
3070        if stripped in lists:
3071            list_key = lists[stripped]
3072            continue
3073        if stripped.startswith('Circuit type:'):
3074            list_key = None
3075            ct, _, speaks = stripped.partition(',')
3076            current['circuit_type'] = ct.split(':', 1)[1].strip()
3077            if 'Speaks:' in speaks:
3078                current['speaks'] = [s.strip() for s in speaks.split(':', 1)[1].split(',') if s.strip()]
3079        elif stripped.startswith('SNPA:'):
3080            list_key = None
3081            snpa, _, lan = stripped.partition(',')
3082            current['snpa'] = snpa.split(':', 1)[1].strip()
3083            if 'LAN id:' in lan:
3084                current['lan_id'] = lan.split(':', 1)[1].strip()
3085        elif stripped.startswith('LAN Priority:'):
3086            list_key = None
3087            parts = [p.strip() for p in stripped.split(',')]
3088            current['priority'] = _int_or_none(parts[0].split(':', 1)[1])
3089            current['is_dis'] = any(p == 'is DIS' for p in parts)
3090        elif stripped.startswith('BFD is'):
3091            list_key = None
3092            m = re.search(r'status\s+(\S+)', stripped)
3093            current['bfd'] = m.group(1) if m else stripped
3094        elif list_key and indent >= 6:
3095            # the items of a list (areas, addresses, topologies) are the lines indented by six
3096            current[list_key].append(stripped)
3097        else:
3098            list_key = None
3099    return result

Parse show isis neighbor detail (or the plain show isis neighbor table).

[] on an empty or placeholder output.

def isis_adjacencies( neighbors: List[Dict[str, Any]], name=None, interface: str = None, level: int = None, up: bool = True) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]: 
3110def isis_adjacencies(neighbors: List[Dict[str, Any]], name=None, interface: str = None,
3111                     level: int = None, up: bool = True) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
3112    """The adjacencies of :func:`parse_isis_neighbors` with neighbour *name* (its hostname or its
3113    system-id), on *interface*, covering *level* (1, 2, or 3 for both), Up unless ``up=False``."""
3114    names = {str(n) for n in (name if isinstance(name, (list, tuple, set)) else [name]) if n is not None}
3115    result = []
3116    for n in neighbors:
3117        if names and n.get('name') not in names:
3118            continue
3119        if interface is not None and n.get('interface') != interface:
3120            continue
3121        if up and not n.get('up'):
3122            continue
3123        result.append(n)
3124    if level is None:
3125        return result
3126    # a broadcast circuit lists one adjacency per level: combine them before testing *level*
3127    by_key: Dict[tuple, int] = {}
3128    for n in result:
3129        key = (n.get('name'), n.get('interface'))
3130        by_key[key] = by_key.get(key, 0) | (n.get('level') or 0)
3131    return [n for n in result if _level_matches(by_key[(n.get('name'), n.get('interface'))], level)]

The adjacencies of parse_isis_neighbors() with neighbour name (its hostname or its system-id), on interface, covering level (1, 2, or 3 for both), Up unless up=False.

3135                      level: int = None) -> bool:

3137    return bool(isis_adjacencies(neighbors, name=name, interface=interface, level=level))

3144        levels |= n.get('level') or 0

def parse_isis_interfaces(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]: 
3201def parse_isis_interfaces(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
3202    """``show isis interface detail json`` → ``{ifname: {'area': str, 'state': str, 'passive': bool,
3203    'type': 'p2p' | 'lan' | 'loopback', 'level': 1 | 2 | 3, 'circuit_id': str, 'levels': {1 | 2:
3204    {'metric': int, 'hello_interval': int | None, 'hello_multiplier': int | None, 'padding': bool,
3205    'csnp_interval': int | None, 'neighbors': int | None, 'priority': int | None, 'is_dis': bool |
3206    None}}, 'ipv4': [prefix], 'ipv6': [prefix], 'ipv6_link_local': [prefix]}}``; ``{}`` when IS-IS
3207    does not run.  ``priority`` / ``is_dis`` are those of a broadcast circuit (``None`` on a point
3208    to point one)."""
3209    result: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
3210    for area, c in _isis_circuits(data):
3211        i = c.get('interface')
3212        if not isinstance(i, dict) or not i.get('name'):
3213            continue
3214        levels: Dict[int, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
3215        for lv in _as_list(i.get('levels')):
3216            if not isinstance(lv, dict):
3217                continue
3218            number = _isis_level(lv.get('level'))
3219            if number not in (1, 2):
3220                continue
3221            hold = lv.get('holddown') if isinstance(lv.get('holddown'), dict) else {}
3222            lan = lv.get('lan') if isinstance(lv.get('lan'), dict) else {}
3223            levels[number] = {
3224                'metric': _int_or_none(lv.get('metric')), 'hello_interval': _int_or_none(lv.get('hello-interval')),
3225                'hello_multiplier': _int_or_none(hold.get('count')), 'padding': hold.get('pad') == 'yes',
3226                'csnp_interval': _int_or_none(lv.get('cnsp-interval', lv.get('csnp-interval'))),
3227                'neighbors': _int_or_none(lv.get('active-neighbors')),
3228                'priority': _int_or_none(lan.get('priority')) if lan else None,
3229                'is_dis': (lan.get('is-dis') == 'yes') if lan else None,
3230            }
3231
3232        def prefixes(key, sub):
3233            value = i.get(key)
3234            if not isinstance(value, dict):
3235                return []
3236            return [str(x) for x in _as_list(value.get(sub))]
3237        result[i['name']] = {
3238            'area': area, 'state': i.get('state'), 'passive': i.get('is-passive') == 'passive',
3239            'type': i.get('type'), 'level': _isis_level(i.get('level')), 'circuit_id': i.get('circuit-id'),
3240            'levels': levels, 'ipv4': prefixes('ip-prefix', 'ip'), 'ipv6': prefixes('ipv6-prefixes', 'ipv6'),
3241            'ipv6_link_local': prefixes('ipv6-link-locals', 'ipv6'),
3242        }
3243    return result

show isis interface detail json → {ifname: {'area': str, 'state': str, 'passive': bool, 'type': 'p2p' | 'lan' | 'loopback', 'level': 1 | 2 | 3, 'circuit_id': str, 'levels': {1 | 2: {'metric': int, 'hello_interval': int | None, 'hello_multiplier': int | None, 'padding': bool, 'csnp_interval': int | None, 'neighbors': int | None, 'priority': int | None, 'is_dis': bool | None}}, 'ipv4': [prefix], 'ipv6': [prefix], 'ipv6_link_local': [prefix]}}; {} when IS-IS does not run. priority / is_dis are those of a broadcast circuit (None on a point to point one).

def isis_lsp_node(lsp_id: str): 
3253def isis_lsp_node(lsp_id: str):
3254    """``'r3.4d-00'`` → ``('r3', '4d', '00')`` (node = hostname or system-id, pseudonode id,
3255    fragment); ``None`` when *lsp_id* is not an LSP-ID."""
3256    m = _LSP_ID_RE.match(str(lsp_id or ''))
3257    if not m:
3258        return None
3259    return m.group('node'), m.group('pseudonode').lower(), m.group('fragment').lower()

def parse_isis_database(data: Any) -> Dict[int, Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]]: 
3277def parse_isis_database(data: Any) -> Dict[int, Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]]:
3278    """``show isis database detail json`` (or the plain form, with fewer keys) → ``{level: {lsp_id:
3279    {'node': hostname or system-id, 'pseudonode': bool, 'own': bool, 'seq': int | None,
3280    'holdtime': int | None, 'att': bool, 'p': bool, 'ol': bool, 'hostname': str | None, 'areas':
3281    [str], 'protocols': [str], 'topologies': [int], 'router_id': str | None, 'srgb': (base, size) |
3282    None, 'srlb': (base, size) | None, 'is_reach': [{'id': system-id.pseudonode, 'metric': int,
3283    'mt': None | 'ipv6-unicast', 'adj_sids': [int]}], 'ip_reach': [{'prefix', 'metric', 'down',
3284    'sid': {'index', 'no_php', 'explicit_null'} | None}], 'ipv6_reach': [{'prefix', 'metric', 'mt',
3285    'external', 'down'}]}}}``; ``{}`` when IS-IS does not run."""
3286    result: Dict[int, Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]] = {}
3287    if not isinstance(data, dict):
3288        return result
3289    for area in _as_list(data.get('areas')):
3290        if not isinstance(area, dict):
3291            continue
3292        for lv in _as_list(area.get('levels')):
3293            if not isinstance(lv, dict):
3294                continue
3295            level = _int_or_none(lv.get('id'))
3296            if level not in (1, 2):
3297                continue
3298            db = result.setdefault(level, {})
3299            for e in _as_list(lv.get('lsps')):
3300                if not isinstance(e, dict) or not isinstance(e.get('lsp'), dict):
3301                    continue
3302                lsp_id = e['lsp'].get('id')
3303                parts = isis_lsp_node(lsp_id)
3304                if not parts:
3305                    continue
3306                att, p, ol = _flags_att_p_ol(e.get('attPOl'))
3307                gb = e.get('segmentRoutingGb') if isinstance(e.get('segmentRoutingGb'), dict) else None
3308                lb = e.get('segmentRoutingLb') if isinstance(e.get('segmentRoutingLb'), dict) else None
3309                protocols = e.get('supportedProtocols')
3310                is_reach = []
3311                for r in _as_list(e.get('extReach')) + _as_list(e.get('isReach')):
3312                    if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get('id'):
3313                        is_reach.append({'id': str(r['id']), 'metric': _int_or_none(r.get('metric')), 'mt': _mt_name(r),
3314                                         'adj_sids': [_int_or_none(s.get('sid')) for s in _as_list(r.get('adjSid'))
3315                                                      if isinstance(s, dict)]})
3316                ip_reach = []
3317                for r in _as_list(e.get('extIpReach')) + _as_list(e.get('ipReach')):
3318                    if not isinstance(r, dict):
3319                        continue
3320                    prefix = r.get('ipReach') if isinstance(r.get('ipReach'), str) else r.get('prefix')
3321                    if not prefix:
3322                        continue
3323                    sid = None
3324                    subtlvs = r.get('subtlvs') if isinstance(r.get('subtlvs'), dict) else {}
3325                    for s in _as_list(subtlvs.get('sr')):
3326                        if isinstance(s, dict) and s.get('index') is not None:
3327                            flags = s.get('flags') if isinstance(s.get('flags'), dict) else {}
3328                            sid = {'index': _int_or_none(s.get('index')), 'no_php': bool(flags.get('noPHP')),
3329                                   'explicit_null': bool(flags.get('explicitNull'))}
3330                    ip_reach.append({'prefix': str(prefix), 'metric': _int_or_none(r.get('ipReachMetric', r.get('metric'))),
3331                                     'down': bool(r.get('down')), 'sid': sid})
3332                ipv6_reach = []
3333                for r in _as_list(e.get('ipv6Reach')):
3334                    if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get('prefix'):
3335                        ipv6_reach.append({'prefix': str(r['prefix']), 'metric': _int_or_none(r.get('metric')),
3336                                           'mt': _mt_name(r), 'external': bool(r.get('external')),
3337                                           'down': bool(r.get('down'))})
3338                db[lsp_id] = {
3339                    'node': parts[0], 'pseudonode': parts[1] != '00', 'own': bool(e['lsp'].get('ownLSP')),
3340                    'seq': int(e['seqNumber'], 16) if isinstance(e.get('seqNumber'), str)
3341                    and e['seqNumber'].startswith('0x') else _int_or_none(e.get('seqNumber')),
3342                    'holdtime': _int_or_none(e.get('holdtime')), 'att': att, 'p': p, 'ol': ol,
3343                    'hostname': e.get('hostname'), 'areas': [str(a) for a in _as_list(e.get('areaAddr'))],
3344                    'protocols': [str(v) for v in protocols.values()] if isinstance(protocols, dict) else [],
3345                    'topologies': [_int_or_none(t.get('mtid')) for t in _as_list(e.get('mt')) if isinstance(t, dict)],
3346                    'router_id': e.get('teRouterId'),
3347                    'srgb': (_int_or_none(gb.get('globalBlockBase')), _int_or_none(gb.get('globalBlockRange')))
3348                    if gb else None,
3349                    'srlb': (_int_or_none(lb.get('globalBlockBase')), _int_or_none(lb.get('globalBlockRange')))
3350                    if lb else None,
3351                    'is_reach': is_reach, 'ip_reach': ip_reach, 'ipv6_reach': ipv6_reach,
3352                }
3353    return result

show isis database detail json (or the plain form, with fewer keys) → {level: {lsp_id: {'node': hostname or system-id, 'pseudonode': bool, 'own': bool, 'seq': int | None, 'holdtime': int | None, 'att': bool, 'p': bool, 'ol': bool, 'hostname': str | None, 'areas': [str], 'protocols': [str], 'topologies': [int], 'router_id': str | None, 'srgb': (base, size) | None, 'srlb': (base, size) | None, 'is_reach': [{'id': system-id.pseudonode, 'metric': int, 'mt': None | 'ipv6-unicast', 'adj_sids': [int]}], 'ip_reach': [{'prefix', 'metric', 'down', 'sid': {'index', 'no_php', 'explicit_null'} | None}], 'ipv6_reach': [{'prefix', 'metric', 'mt', 'external', 'down'}]}}}; {} when IS-IS does not run.

def isis_lsps_of( database: Dict[int, Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]], level: int, node, pseudonode: bool = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]: 
3363def isis_lsps_of(database: Dict[int, Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]], level: int, node,
3364                 pseudonode: bool = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
3365    """The LSPs of *level* whose node is *node* (a hostname or a system-id, or a list of them);

def parse_isis_routes(data: Any, ipv6: bool = False) -> Dict[int, Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]]: 
3372def parse_isis_routes(data: Any, ipv6: bool = False) -> Dict[int, Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]]:
3373    """``show isis route json`` → ``{level: {prefix: {'metric': int | None, 'nexthops': [(address |
3374    None, ifname | None)], 'labels': [str | None]}}}`` for IPv4, or IPv6 with ``ipv6=True``.  An
3375    ECMP route lists every next hop; the router's own prefixes have no next hop."""
3376    result: Dict[int, Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]] = {}
3377    family = 'ipv6' if ipv6 else 'ipv4'
3378    for area in _as_list(data):
3379        if not isinstance(area, dict):
3380            continue
3381        for key, level in (('level-1', 1), ('level-2', 2)):
3382            block = area.get(key)
3383            if not isinstance(block, dict):
3384                continue
3385            table = result.setdefault(level, {})
3386            for r in _as_list(block.get(family)):
3387                if not isinstance(r, dict) or not r.get('prefix'):
3388                    continue
3389                entry = table.setdefault(str(r['prefix']), {'metric': _int_or_none(r.get('metric')),
3390                                                            'nexthops': [], 'labels': []})
3391                hop = r.get('nextHop')
3392                ifname = r.get('interface')
3393                if hop and hop != '-':
3394                    entry['nexthops'].append((str(hop), ifname if ifname and ifname != '-' else None))
3395                    label = r.get('label(s)')
3396                    entry['labels'].append(None if label in (None, '-') else str(label))
3397    return result

show isis route json → {level: {prefix: {'metric': int | None, 'nexthops': [(address | None, ifname | None)], 'labels': [str | None]}}} for IPv4, or IPv6 with ipv6=True. An ECMP route lists every next hop; the router's own prefixes have no next hop.

3438def bfd_detection_time(peer: Dict[str, Any]) -> Optional[int]:
3439    """The detection time (ms) of the local end of a session of :func:`parse_bfd_peers`: the

3444    except (KeyError, TypeError):

def bfd_profile_value(profile: Optional[Dict[str, Any]], key: str): 
3589def bfd_profile_value(profile: Optional[Dict[str, Any]], key: str):
3590    """A setting of a BFD profile of ``parse_frr_config(...)['bfd']['profiles']`` with FRR's
3591    default when the profile does not set it (``show running-config`` leaves the defaults out):
3592    ``detect_multiplier`` 3, ``receive_interval`` / ``transmit_interval`` 300 ms."""
3593    if profile is None:
3594        return None
3595    if profile.get(key) is not None:
3596        return profile[key]
3597    return {'detect_multiplier': BFD_DEFAULT_DETECT_MULTIPLIER, 'receive_interval': BFD_DEFAULT_INTERVAL,
3598            'transmit_interval': BFD_DEFAULT_INTERVAL}.get(key)

A setting of a BFD profile of parse_frr_config(...)['bfd']['profiles'] with FRR's default when the profile does not set it (show running-config leaves the defaults out): detect_multiplier 3, receive_interval / transmit_interval 300 ms.

def parse_evpn_prefix(prefix: str) -> Dict[str, Any]: 
3626def parse_evpn_prefix(prefix: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
3627    """An EVPN prefix as bgpd prints it → its fields::
3628
3629        '[2]:[0]:[48]:[aa:bb:…]'                  → {'type': 2, 'eth_tag': 0, 'mac': 'aa:bb:…', 'ip': None}
3630        '[2]:[0]:[48]:[aa:bb:…]:[32]:[10.1.1.5]'  → {'type': 2, …, 'ip': '10.1.1.5'}
3631        '[3]:[0]:[32]:[10.255.0.11]'              → {'type': 3, 'eth_tag': 0, 'vtep': '10.255.0.11'}
3632        '[5]:[0]:[24]:[203.0.113.0]'              → {'type': 5, 'eth_tag': 0, 'network': '203.0.113.0/24'}
3633
3634    ``{}`` when the text is not an EVPN prefix; other route types keep ``type`` and ``fields``."""
3635    tokens = _EVPN_TOKEN_RE.findall(str(prefix or ''))
3636    if not tokens or not tokens[0].isdigit():
3637        return {}
3638    rtype = int(tokens[0])
3639    eth_tag = _int_or_none(tokens[1]) if len(tokens) > 1 else None
3640    if rtype == 2 and len(tokens) >= 4:
3641        return {'type': 2, 'eth_tag': eth_tag, 'mac': tokens[3].lower(),
3642                'ip': tokens[5] if len(tokens) >= 6 else None}
3643    if rtype == 3 and len(tokens) >= 4:
3644        return {'type': 3, 'eth_tag': eth_tag, 'vtep': tokens[3]}
3645    if rtype == 5 and len(tokens) >= 4:
3646        return {'type': 5, 'eth_tag': eth_tag, 'network': f"{tokens[3]}/{tokens[2]}"}
3647    return {'type': rtype, 'eth_tag': eth_tag, 'fields': tokens[1:]}

An EVPN prefix as bgpd prints it → its fields::

'[2]:[0]:[48]:[aa:bb:…]'                  → {'type': 2, 'eth_tag': 0, 'mac': 'aa:bb:…', 'ip': None}
'[2]:[0]:[48]:[aa:bb:…]:[32]:[10.1.1.5]'  → {'type': 2, …, 'ip': '10.1.1.5'}
'[3]:[0]:[32]:[10.255.0.11]'              → {'type': 3, 'eth_tag': 0, 'vtep': '10.255.0.11'}
'[5]:[0]:[24]:[203.0.113.0]'              → {'type': 5, 'eth_tag': 0, 'network': '203.0.113.0/24'}

{} when the text is not an EVPN prefix; other route types keep type and fields.

def parse_bgp_evpn_routes(data: Any) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]: 
3675def parse_bgp_evpn_routes(data: Any) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
3676    """Parse the JSON of ``show bgp l2vpn evpn route [detail]``: one dict per path::
3677
3678        {'rd': '10.255.0.12:3', 'type': 2 | 3 | 5, 'prefix': '[2]:[0]:[48]:[…]:[32]:[…]',
3679         'mac': str | None, 'ip': str | None,          # type 2 (ip only for a MAC+IP route)
3680         'vtep': str | None,                           # type 3: the originating VTEP
3681         'network': '203.0.113.0/24' | None,           # type 5
3682         'vnis': [200, 4000],     # detail form only: L2VNI, and the L3VNI of a MAC+IP route
3683         'rts': ['65000:200', '65000:4000'], 'router_mac': str | None,
3684         'nexthop': '10.255.0.12', 'best': bool, 'valid': bool,
3685         'local': bool,           # originated by this router
3686         'peer': '10.255.0.1', 'pmsi': 'Ingress Replication' | None}
3687
3688    ``[]`` when there is no route (or when bgpd printed its invalid JSON of a router without
3689    EVPN)."""
3690    routes: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
3691    if not isinstance(data, dict):
3692        return routes
3693    for rd, block in data.items():
3694        if not isinstance(block, dict):
3695            continue
3696        for prefix, entry in block.items():
3697            if not isinstance(entry, dict) or 'paths' not in entry:
3698                continue
3699            for group in entry.get('paths') or []:
3700                for path in (group if isinstance(group, list) else [group]):
3701                    if isinstance(path, dict):
3702                        routes.append(_evpn_path(block.get('rd', rd), prefix, entry, path))
3703    return routes

Parse the JSON of show bgp l2vpn evpn route [detail]: one dict per path::

{'rd': '10.255.0.12:3', 'type': 2 | 3 | 5, 'prefix': '[2]:[0]:[48]:[…]:[32]:[…]',
 'mac': str | None, 'ip': str | None,          # type 2 (ip only for a MAC+IP route)
 'vtep': str | None,                           # type 3: the originating VTEP
 'network': '203.0.113.0/24' | None,           # type 5
 'vnis': [200, 4000],     # detail form only: L2VNI, and the L3VNI of a MAC+IP route
 'rts': ['65000:200', '65000:4000'], 'router_mac': str | None,
 'nexthop': '10.255.0.12', 'best': bool, 'valid': bool,
 'local': bool,           # originated by this router
 'peer': '10.255.0.1', 'pmsi': 'Ingress Replication' | None}

[] when there is no route (or when bgpd printed its invalid JSON of a router without EVPN).

def evpn_routes( routes: List[Dict[str, Any]], route_type: int = None, mac=None, ip=None, network=None, vtep=None, nexthop=None, rt: str = None, best_only: bool = True, local: bool = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]: 
3713def evpn_routes(routes: List[Dict[str, Any]], route_type: int = None, mac=None, ip=None, network=None, vtep=None,
3714                nexthop=None, rt: str = None, best_only: bool = True, local: bool = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
3715    """The paths of a :func:`parse_bgp_evpn_routes` result that match every given criterion
3716    (*mac* compared case-insensitively; ``ip=False`` keeps the MAC-only type-2 routes);
3717    *best_only* keeps the best paths."""
3718    result = []
3719    for r in routes:
3720        if best_only and not r['best']:
3721            continue
3722        if route_type is not None and r['type'] != route_type:
3723            continue
3724        if mac is not None and (r['mac'] or '') != str(mac).lower():
3725            continue
3726        if ip is False and r['ip']:
3727            continue
3728        if ip not in (None, False) and r['ip'] != str(ip):
3729            continue
3730        if network is not None and r['network'] != str(network):
3731            continue
3732        if vtep is not None and r['vtep'] != str(vtep):
3733            continue
3734        if nexthop is not None and r['nexthop'] != str(nexthop):
3735            continue
3736        if rt is not None and rt not in r['rts']:
3737            continue
3738        if local is not None and r['local'] != local:
3739            continue
3740        result.append(r)
3741    return result

The paths of a parse_bgp_evpn_routes() result that match every given criterion (mac compared case-insensitively; ip=False keeps the MAC-only type-2 routes); best_only keeps the best paths.

def parse_evpn_vnis(data: Any) -> Dict[int, Dict[str, Any]]: 
3744def parse_evpn_vnis(data: Any) -> Dict[int, Dict[str, Any]]:
3745    """Parse ``show evpn vni detail json`` (a list; ``{}`` without VNI) or ``show evpn vni json``
3746    (an object keyed by VNI) → ``{vni: {...}}``::
3747
3748        {100: {'type': 'L2', 'vrf': 'TENANT', 'vxlan_if': 'vxlan100', 'svi': 'br100',
3749               'vtep_ip': '10.255.0.11', 'mcast_group': None, 'remote_vteps': ['10.255.0.12', …],
3750               'flood': {'10.255.0.12': 'HER'}, 'num_macs': 3, 'num_arp': 3,
3751               'state': None, 'router_mac': None, 'l2_vnis': []},
3752         4000: {'type': 'L3', 'vrf': 'TENANT', 'vxlan_if': 'vxlan4000', 'svi': 'br4000',
3753                'vtep_ip': '10.255.0.11', 'state': 'Up', 'router_mac': 'ce:d2:…', 'l2_vnis': [100, 200], …}}
3754
3755    The brief form has no ``svi`` / ``vtep_ip`` / ``state``; ``mcast_group`` is ``None`` for
3756    ``0.0.0.0`` (head-end replication)."""
3757    items = data if isinstance(data, list) else list(data.values()) if isinstance(data, dict) else []
3758    result: Dict[int, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
3759    for v in items:
3760        if not isinstance(v, dict) or _int_or_none(v.get('vni')) is None:
3761            continue
3762        remotes = v.get('remoteVteps') if isinstance(v.get('remoteVteps'), list) else []
3763        flood = {}
3764        for r in remotes:
3765            if isinstance(r, dict):
3766                flood[r.get('ip')] = r.get('flood')
3767            else:
3768                flood[str(r)] = None
3769        group = v.get('mcastGroup')
3770        result[int(v['vni'])] = {
3771            'type': v.get('type'), 'vrf': v.get('tenantVrf'),
3772            'vxlan_if': v.get('vxlanInterface') or v.get('vxlanIntf') or v.get('vxlanIf'),
3773            'svi': v.get('sviInterface') or v.get('sviIntf'),
3774            'vtep_ip': v.get('vtepIp') or v.get('localVtepIp'),
3775            'mcast_group': None if group in (None, '', '0.0.0.0') else group,
3776            'remote_vteps': sorted(flood), 'flood': flood,
3777            'num_macs': _int_or_none(v.get('numMacs')), 'num_arp': _int_or_none(v.get('numArpNd')),
3778            'state': v.get('state'), 'router_mac': (v.get('routerMac') or None),
3779            'l2_vnis': [int(x) for x in (v.get('l2Vnis') or []) if _int_or_none(x) is not None],
3780        }
3781    return result

Parse show evpn vni detail json (a list; {} without VNI) or show evpn vni json (an object keyed by VNI) → {vni: {...}}::

{100: {'type': 'L2', 'vrf': 'TENANT', 'vxlan_if': 'vxlan100', 'svi': 'br100',
       'vtep_ip': '10.255.0.11', 'mcast_group': None, 'remote_vteps': ['10.255.0.12', …],
       'flood': {'10.255.0.12': 'HER'}, 'num_macs': 3, 'num_arp': 3,
       'state': None, 'router_mac': None, 'l2_vnis': []},
 4000: {'type': 'L3', 'vrf': 'TENANT', 'vxlan_if': 'vxlan4000', 'svi': 'br4000',
        'vtep_ip': '10.255.0.11', 'state': 'Up', 'router_mac': 'ce:d2:…', 'l2_vnis': [100, 200], …}}

The brief form has no svi / vtep_ip / state; mcast_group is None for 0.0.0.0 (head-end replication).

3789def parse_evpn_macs(data: Any) -> Dict[int, Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]]:

3791    None, 'remote_vtep': str | None}}}``."""

def parse_rpki_cache_connection(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]: 
3951def parse_rpki_cache_connection(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
3952    """The JSON of ``show rpki cache-connection``: ``{'connected': bool, 'error': str | None,
3953    'connections': [{'mode', 'host', 'port', 'preference', 'state'}]}`` (``connected``: one cache
3954    server at least in state ``connected``; the error is FRR's message when none is,
3955    ``"No connection to RPKI cache server."``)."""
3956    result = {'connected': False, 'error': None, 'connections': []}
3957    if not isinstance(data, dict):
3958        return result
3959    result['error'] = data.get('error') if isinstance(data.get('error'), str) else None
3960    for c in data.get('connections') or []:
3961        if isinstance(c, dict):
3962            result['connections'].append({'mode': c.get('mode'), 'host': c.get('host'),
3963                                          'port': _int_or_none(c.get('port')),
3964                                          'preference': _int_or_none(c.get('preference')),
3965                                          'state': c.get('state')})
3966    result['connected'] = any(c['state'] == 'connected' for c in result['connections'])
3967    return result

The JSON of show rpki cache-connection: {'connected': bool, 'error': str | None, 'connections': [{'mode', 'host', 'port', 'preference', 'state'}]} (connected: one cache server at least in state connected; the error is FRR's message when none is, "No connection to RPKI cache server.").

def parse_rpki_prefix_table(data: Any) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]: 
3978def parse_rpki_prefix_table(data: Any) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
3979    """The JSON of ``show rpki prefix-table``: the validated ROA payloads (VRPs) the router got from
3980    its cache, ``[{'prefix': '172.16.4.0/22', 'max_length': 24, 'asn': 65002}]`` (``[]`` without
3981    connection: ``{"error": ...}``)."""
3982    if not isinstance(data, dict):
3983        return []
3984    result = []
3985    for v in data.get('prefixes') or []:
3986        if not isinstance(v, dict) or not v.get('prefix'):
3987            continue
3988        low = _int_or_none(v.get('prefixLenMin'))
3989        result.append({'prefix': f"{v['prefix']}/{low}" if low is not None else str(v['prefix']),
3990                       'max_length': _int_or_none(v.get('prefixLenMax')), 'asn': _int_or_none(v.get('asn'))})
3991    return result

The JSON of show rpki prefix-table: the validated ROA payloads (VRPs) the router got from its cache, [{'prefix': '172.16.4.0/22', 'max_length': 24, 'asn': 65002}] ([] without connection: {"error": ...}).

def rpki_origin_state(vrps: List[Dict[str, Any]], prefix, origin_as: int) -> str: 
4000def rpki_origin_state(vrps: List[Dict[str, Any]], prefix, origin_as: int) -> str:
4001    """Route origin validation (RFC 6811) of *prefix* announced by *origin_as* against a list of
4002    VRPs (:func:`parse_rpki_prefix_table`, or the ROAs of a validator file in the same shape):
4003    ``'notfound'`` when no VRP covers the prefix, ``'valid'`` when one covering VRP has this origin
4004    and a max length at least the prefix length, else ``'invalid'``."""
4005    net = ip_network(str(prefix), strict=False)
4006    covered = False
4007    for v in vrps:
4008        try:
4009            vnet = ip_network(v["prefix"], strict=False)
4010        except (KeyError, ValueError):
4011            continue
4012        if vnet.version != net.version or not net.subnet_of(vnet):
4013            continue
4014        covered = True
4015        max_length = v.get('max_length') if v.get('max_length') is not None else vnet.prefixlen
4016        if v.get('asn') == origin_as and net.prefixlen <= max_length:
4017            return 'valid'
4018    return 'invalid' if covered else 'notfound'

Route origin validation (RFC 6811) of prefix announced by origin_as against a list of VRPs (parse_rpki_prefix_table(), or the ROAs of a validator file in the same shape): 'notfound' when no VRP covers the prefix, 'valid' when one covering VRP has this origin and a max length at least the prefix length, else 'invalid'.

def parse_bgp_dampening_parameters(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]: 
4021def parse_bgp_dampening_parameters(data: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
4022    """The JSON of ``show bgp ipv4 unicast dampening parameters``: ``{'half_life': 15, 'reuse': 750,
4023    'suppress': 2000, 'max_suppress': 60}`` (half-life and max-suppress in minutes, as configured
4024    with ``bgp dampening``); ``{}`` when dampening is off."""
4025    if not isinstance(data, dict) or 'halfLifeSecs' not in data:
4026        return {}
4027    half, max_suppress = _int_or_none(data.get('halfLifeSecs')), _int_or_none(data.get('maxSuppressTimeSecs'))
4028    return {'half_life': None if half is None else half // 60, 'reuse': _int_or_none(data.get('reusePenalty')),
4029            'suppress': _int_or_none(data.get('suppressPenalty')),
4030            'max_suppress': None if max_suppress is None else max_suppress // 60,
4031            'max_penalty': _int_or_none(data.get('maxSuppressPenalty'))}

The JSON of show bgp ipv4 unicast dampening parameters: {'half_life': 15, 'reuse': 750, 'suppress': 2000, 'max_suppress': 60} (half-life and max-suppress in minutes, as configured with bgp dampening); {} when dampening is off.

def parse_bgp_dampening_paths(data: Any) -> Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]]: 
4042def parse_bgp_dampening_paths(data: Any) -> Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]]:
4043    """The JSON of ``show bgp ipv4 unicast dampening dampened-paths`` or ``... flap-statistics``:
4044    ``{prefix: [{'peer', 'aspath', 'damped', 'history', 'flaps', 'reuse_ms'}]}`` (``flaps``: only in
4045    the flap statistics; ``{}`` when nothing is listed or dampening is off)."""
4046    if not isinstance(data, dict) or not isinstance(data.get('routes'), dict):
4047        return {}
4048    result: Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]] = {}
4049    for prefix, entries in data['routes'].items():
4050        if isinstance(entries, dict):
4051            entries = [entries]
4052        for e in entries or []:
4053            if not isinstance(e, dict):
4054                continue
4055            result.setdefault(prefix, []).append({
4056                'peer': e.get('peerHost') or e.get('peerId'), 'aspath': e.get('asPath') or e.get('path') or '',
4057                'damped': bool(e.get('damped')), 'history': bool(e.get('history')),
4058                'flaps': _int_or_none(e.get('bdiFlap')), 'reuse_ms': _int_or_none(e.get('reuseTimerMsecs'))})
4059    return result

The JSON of show bgp ipv4 unicast dampening dampened-paths or ... flap-statistics: {prefix: [{'peer', 'aspath', 'damped', 'history', 'flaps', 'reuse_ms'}]} (flaps: only in the flap statistics; {} when nothing is listed or dampening is off).
